articleTitle: uFood – Your Meal, Your Way : Say Goodbye to Food Waste
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: uFood is a project aimed at reducing food wastage in restaurants and food service systems by enabling customers to customize the quantity of individual food components. The proposed solution leverages IoT technology, accessible via a mobile application, to facilitate this customizable food-ordering experience.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Delta Modulaton Transceiver in MATLAB, SIMULINK and DSP Processor
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: With an emphasis on its ease of use and effectiveness in analog-to-digital conversion, this study investigates the design and implementation of a Delta Modulation (DM) system. Unlike traditional Pulse Code Modulation (PCM), DM encodes the difference between successive samples, reducing hardware complexity and bandwidth usage. The system was developed and tested through MATLAB simulations and real-time processing on a TMS320C6713 DSP board. Results highlight the capability of DM to effectively reconstruct analog signals, though minor errors were observed due to quantization noise. This study shows how DM can be used in real-time and low-bandwidth signal processing, where compact and effective design is crucial.

articleTitle: Automated Test Equipment of Power Distribution Unit for Unmanned Aerial Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In modern avionics system Testing and Verification are very important criteria. With the advantage of Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA), power sub systems are more intelligent with advance features. Advance power systems testing is usually more complicated and repetitive, with various modes of operation to be tested. Automated test equipment based testing is best suited for testing the Power Distribution Unit. The serial communication protocol is very important for interfacing the Power distribution unit with the On board computer. This paper discusses about automated test equipment with MIL 1553-B based communication protocol which has been deployed successfully for testing the PDU with On board computer. Automated Test Equipment consists of PCI based ADC, DAC, MIL 1553-B, DOP and serial ADD On cards for automated testing of all health parameters of Power Distribution Unit.

articleTitle: IOT Based Smart Water Distribution
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative solution to modernize water distribution systems by integrating RFID technology with a 12V DC pump, a microcontroller, and a billing feature displayed through a mobile application. The integration of these components aims to address common challenges such as unequal distribution, wastage, and unauthorized access faced by traditional systems. Each household is provided with a unique RFID card corresponding to an RFID tag installed at a central water tank, ensuring secure and authorized access to water resources. The 12V DC pump, coupled with optimized piping infrastructure, regulates water flow, enhancing reliability and efficiency. The microcontroller serves as the central control unit, managing RFID operations, monitoring water flow, and facilitating communication with a central server for billing data. Key objectives include promoting equitable access, minimizing wastage through continuous monitoring, and supporting sustainable management practices. Additionally, the project incorporates a billing feature displayed on a mobile application, allowing users to view and manage their water consumption data conveniently. By integrating RFID technology, a microcontroller, and a billing feature accessible through a mobile application, the system offers a comprehensive solution to the challenges of water distribution, promoting efficiency, equity, and sustainability in communities.

articleTitle: Development and Performance Evaluation of a 13GHz Ultra Wide Band Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Antennas are crucial components in modern communication systems, serving as the foundation for establishing communication links. Wireless communication applications extensively make use of patch antennas. This article presents the design, analysis, and simulation of a high-frequency 13 GHz rectangular patch antenna and a single feed 1X2 antenna tailored for wireless communication. The performance of the antenna array was simulated and optimized using CST software. The design employs an FR-4 substrate with a height of 1.6 mm, a dielectric constant of 4.2. The operating frequency is 13 GHz, meeting the requirements for efficient wireless communication in the Ku band. The designed and fabricated single-element antennas delivered satisfactory results. The simulated result for single antenna for bandwidth was doubled when used as single feed 1X2 antenna. It also showed improvement in efficiency from 58.8% to 69.8%.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Scheme to Classify Chest X-ray into Pneumonia/Covid19: A Study
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Lung is a major organ in the respiratory system and the disease in lung will cause various health issues and lead to severe berating issues, when left untreated. The lung infection due to pneumonia/Covid19 will lead to harsh health problem if left untreated. Medical imaging based detection and treatment of lung illness is commonly executed in the hospitals and the chest radiograph (X-ray) is a common modality for lung abnormality screening. This research aims to implement the Deep-Learning (DL) method to detect the lung abnormality using X-ray images. The different sections in the proposed method includes; image collection and converting it to 224x224 pixels, feature extraction using chosen DL-model, feature optimization using Elephant-Herd-Algorithm (EHA) and fused-features generation, and binary classification with 5-fold cross validation. This work considered the ResNet-variant model to examine the X-ray and the achieved result confirms that this scheme presents a detection accuracy up to 98% when SoftMax based classification is executed.

articleTitle: Enhancing the performance of a grid-integrated fuel cell system through distortion factor regulation under dynamic load fluctuations
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Due to sheer global energy crisis, concerns about fuel deuteriation, electricity shortages, power quality enhance and global warming are the major challenges becoming increasingly severe. The tremendous scarcity of conventional power is hoping to accept pollution free renewable sources at distribution level performing as microgrid. These sources make easier integration with grid located near the point of consumption. The current distribution system relies heavily on power converters and non-linear loads, resulting in voltage drops and supply current distortion. Elevated distortion of voltage and current can lead to equipment damage and overheating. Classic filters may exhibit performance degradation under dynamic load scenarios. This study evaluates the effectiveness of PI and Fuzzy-based Active Tunable Shunt Active Power Filter (AT-SHAPF) in reducing harmonic distortion, improving current distortion factor (CDF) there by improving power factor. The MATLAB/Simulink results suggests that Instantaneous Reactive Power Theory (IRPT) based AT-SHAPF gives efficient results under fast varying conditions.

articleTitle: Detection of DDoS Attacks in Fog Computing using Interpretable Quantum-based 2Q Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: It is seen that there is a rapid increase in Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and fog computing has emerged as an efficient and viable solution to reduce latency by performing computations closer to the edge. However, this nature of fog computing makes it vulnerable to Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks, which can disrupt services. DDoS causes major impact over the fog performance which include resource saturation, increased latency, reduced resource availability, decrease in processing capacity of the fog nodes, and many more. There have been various works proposed to detect DDoS attacks in fog computing, but they lack scalability and have high response times. In this paper, a novel Quantum-based-2QLearning (Q2QL) framework is designed to efficiently detect and mitigate DDoS attacks in fog computing. This framework using quantum-enhanced reinforcement learning reduces overestimation bias and improve speed of convergence. Q2QL framework also achieves high detection accuracy and reduces response time. The results show that the proposed framework performs well across critical metrics, including latency, attack detection time, and overall system performance.

articleTitle: Advanced Traffic Control System using AI
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: As the number of vehicles rises, there is a problem with traffic congestion on the roads. This problem is characterized by slower speeds, greater time spent travelling, and more congestion in the traffic lanes. In addition to raising resource prices, accidents, and environmental harm, it affects a country's economic growth. Using traffic control signals at crossings is one of the most feasible solutions to this issue. At the moment, static cycle time control are used to implement the majority of signal controllers. Conventional traffic signal control techniques are not very successful at managing circumstances with heavy traffic. Thus, the Expert System (ES), a subfield of Artificial Intelligence (AI), sometimes referred to as the Rule-Based System (RBS), is used in this work. The researchers developed a novel expert system called the Traffic Lights Expert System (TLES). TLES uses evidential reasoning as its inference engine and a rule-based knowledge representation. This technology may assign the proper dynamic cycle time at intersections.

articleTitle: Intelligent Question Generator System using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Question generation system in most educational institutes is not automated. There are various methods in which objective and subjective question generation is existing, but not those algorithms are not very accurate. Automation of question generation systems can assist learners to discover the levels of their expertise and increase their knowledge by helping them in clarifying their queries. It can also be widely used in various other fields such as for placement activities. In this paper, the proposed model main objective is to design and implement an automated question generator using Natural Language Processing(NLP) techniques. The proposed system will use T5 transformer and Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) technique. The performance of the automated question generator is evaluated using accuracy, relevance, and fluency of the generated questions. The results of the system will Incorporate user feedback to improve the performance and effectiveness of the question generator.

articleTitle: Automated Retinal Disease Classification Using Fine-Tuned ResNet50: A Deep Learning Approach for Early Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper presents a deep learning-based solution for retinal illness categorization using ResNet50 convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture. Retinal diseases including age-related macular degeneration, diabetic retinopathy, diabetic neuropathy, macular hole, and optic disc cupping account globally for most causes of visual loss. Effective treatment depends on early retinal imaging diagnosis; nonetheless, manual ophthalmologist diagnosis can be timeconsuming and error-prone. The researchers enhanced the ResNet50 model for fundus imaging retinal disease classification to help solve this. A total dataset used for model training and validation consisted in five illness categories. Pretrained ResNet50 acted as a feature extractor using extra layers catered for the specific work. Model performance was evaluated by means of accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and a confusion matrix, therefore assessing classification accuracy across the disease categories. Strong generalizing ability were shown by the results showing that, after 20 epochs, the tuned ResNet50 attained over 90% accuracy both in training and validation. This work highlights CNN's potential in medical picture categorization and proposes that automated systems such as this could enable early retinal disease diagnosis, therefore enhancing diagnostic accuracy and patient outcomes.

articleTitle: A Novel Watermarking Approach for Video Objects
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This study proposes a robust method for video watermarking combining guided filter and motion-frame-based approaches to safeguard the legal identification of the video object from illegal tampering, unauthorized access, and copyright protection for social security. Using the guided filtering paradigm, the proposed method aims to preserve the excellence of the investigated video object by including a watermark in video frames safeguarding the feature of blind watermark recognition. The guided filter helps the watermark to be more resistant against numerous attacks including noise, frame-specific, and compression. Using the motion frames, the keyframes have been selected to minimize distortion by pushing in the watermark with the least disturbance. In terms of quality and robustness, the evaluation findings after simulation indicate that the proposed strategy surpasses present video watermarking techniques.

articleTitle: Smart Wheel Chair for Paralyzed Patients Using Advanced IoT
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper outlines the development of a smart wheelchair equipped with IoT technology to enhance the mobility and safety of paralyzed individuals. The wheelchair incorporates a suite of sensors, including accelerometers, gyroscopes, and proximity sensors, to monitor the user’s environment and physical condition. Data collected from these sensors is processed by an onboard microcontroller and transmitted to a cloud server for real-time analysis and feedback. The wheelchair features an intuitive user interface, including voice recognition and touch-screen controls, and utilizes advanced navigation algorithms to autonomously navigate various environments. Safety features, such as automatic fall detection, emergency stop mechanisms, and GPS tracking, ensure user security. The integration of IoT technology enables the wheelchair to provide enhanced autonomy, connectivity, and overall quality of life for paralyzed patients.

articleTitle: ComTrack: Combined Tracking Based on Knowledge Distillation and Attention Transfer
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Detection of unique objects and analyzing their movements as they move through the frames is referred to as Multiple Object Tracking (MOT). MOT plays an important role in applications such as surveillance and autonomous driving. There are many issues that are encountered in Multiple Object Tracking: occlusion, different objects appearing similar, interaction among multiple objects, etc. Our focus is on aerial images. When it comes to aerial images, there are even more issues as objects appear small and there would be distortions in proportions. Though there are many tried and tested techniques for MOT, only a few of them perform well on aerial images. Heavy trackers are difficult to be adopted in embedded devices which have limited resources. In this paper, we have aimed to fasten Mot by using 2 blocks, primary and secondary. The primary block transfers its knowledge to the secondary block during both training and inference phases. The proposed ComTrack framework was tested on MOT17 and yields a value of 65.53 on DLA34 detector and 56.53 on YOLOv5 detector.

articleTitle: Continuous Sign Language Recognition Using 3D Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This work proposes a novel computer vision approach for recognizing American Sign Language (ASL) gestures, utilizing OpenCV for image capture and manipulation, and MediaPipe for image labeling and preprocessing. With a diverse dataset of ASL gestures, two models are trained: a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and a Random Forest Classifier. The CNN model automatically extracts intricate spatial patterns from the ASL gesture images, achieving high accuracy through backpropagation and gradient descent optimization. Simultaneously, the Random Forest Classifier provides an efficient and accurate alternative approach by combining multiple decision trees based on features extracted from the images. Experimental results showcase the effectiveness of both models, offering promising prospects for improving communication and inclusivity among individuals with hearing impairments.

articleTitle: Smart Traffic Light Control System for Ambulance Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The growing issue of traffic congestion is an unavoidable consequence of urban expansion and population growth worldwide. The increase in vehicle ownership has resulted in severe gridlock. Given that human life is irreplaceable, many individuals have lost their lives due to delayed ambulance arrivals. The response time emergency services are crucial during crises, whether for medical, disaster, or defense purposes. Traffic congestion poses the most significant challenge to these responders. Emergency vehicles aim to reach their destinations swiftly without compromising safety. To tackle this problem, a sophisticated traffic management system utilizing adaptive algorithms that respond quickly to changing conditions is necessary. As the ambulance approaches an intersection, the intelligent traffic system adjusts the traffic signal timing accordingly. Implementing this system citywide could reduce delays significantly. Even moment wasted at a red light or in traffic jams diminishes the chances of survival. Therefore, it is essential to grant signal priority to emergency vehicle responses times and improves overall traffic flow. As each second lost to traffic obstacles reduces survival odds, it is vital to provide ambulances with signal priority, enabling them to traverse heavy traffic with minimal delay. This paper introduces a novel IoT-based system designed to achieve this objective.

articleTitle: Design of Efficient Power Management Circuit for Optimal Utilization of Solar Energy for Wearables
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The integration of solar energy harvesting systems into wearable devices presents a promising avenue for extending their operational lifespan and reducing dependency on traditional power sources. However, the intermittent nature of solar energy necessitates the design of efficient power management circuits to ensure optimal utilization of harvested energy. A buck regulator using a maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm adjusts the solar panel's operating point, optimizing energy extraction in changing conditions. This regulator combines MPPT functionality with a low-power buck converter to efficiently step-down variable input voltage to a stable output for wearables. By focusing on low-power design, the regulator achieves high energy conversion efficiency across various conditions. Simulation studies validate its effectiveness, proving its potential for next-generation wearable integration. Overall, this research contributes to the advancement of sustainable and self-powered wearable technologies by providing an efficient solution for solar energy harvesting and power management.

articleTitle: Empowering Communication: Emergency Hand Recognition for the Differently Abled
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The advancement of technology has significantly influenced the lives of differently-abled individuals, particularly in enhancing their communication and interaction capabilities. This article presents an innovative emergency hand recognition system designed to improve interaction and communication for individuals with disabilities. Utilizing advanced computer vision and machine learning techniques, the system identifies predefined hand gestures, facilitating quick and accurate emergency communication for those with speech or hearing impairments. By providing a dependable way for users to express urgent needs, this solution seeks to enhance the safety and independence of specially-abled individuals. The implementation of this technology not only empowers users in critical situations but also promotes greater inclusion in society, allowing for more effective interactions with caregivers and emergency responders. Thus, this work aims to bridge communication gaps and foster a more accessible environment for all.

articleTitle: Bi-Directional Dual Active Bridge for Aerospace Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In conventional aerospace power architecture two DC-DC converters are used. One will convert the available 270/540 VDC to 28 VDC and charge the battery. The other converter will be used convert 28VDC to 270/540VDC and it will support the 270/540VDC bus. The usage of two converters will increase the size, and weight of the system. Due to high size and multiple converters the power density and efficiency of the system will be reduced. A bi-directional Dual Active Bridge is presented in this paper which will reduce the size and weight and it will also increase the efficiency and power density of the overall system. Using the proposed topology and control algorithm we can achieve the efficiency nearly 98% and the power density is about 19 W/Inch<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The proposed topology is validated with MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Hybrid Product Recommendation System Using Popularity Based and Content-Based Filtering
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The paper introduces a hybrid product recommendation system that combines popularity-based and content-based filtering methods. The aim is to enhance the accuracy and relevance of product suggestions by utilizing both the intrinsic features of products (content-based filtering) and their popularity among users (popularity-based filtering). We assess the system's performance using standard metrics for recommendations, including precision and recall showcasing its effectiveness in delivering improved results.

articleTitle: Automatic Classification of Brain MRI slices into Glioma/Meningioma using Deep Transfer-Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Brain tumor (BT) is a harsh brain abnormality and early detection and treatment is essential to reduce the impact of the disease. This work proposed a Deep Transfer-Learning (DT) approach to detect the Glioma/ Meningioma with a better accuracy. The stages of this work includes; image collection and modifying its dimension to 224x224 pixels, feature extraction using chosen DT-models, feature reduction and serial features integration to get the fused-features, and bi-level classification using SoftMax and verifying the merit using 5-fold cross validation. This work initially executed the detection using individual features and then the experiment is repeated using the fused-feature vector (FFV). The FFV based detection helps to achieve a detection accuracy >97% on the chosen task and this outcome confirms the clinical significance of the proposed technique. In this work, the detection is performed using only the axial-plane 2D MRI slides, and in future, it can be extended to clinical MRI examination task.

articleTitle: Leveraging Transformer Architectures for Automated Building Detection in High-Resolution Satellite Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Building detection from satellite images is vital in urban planning, disaster management and infrastructure monitoring. Nonetheless, recognising buildings in high-resolution satellite images is an extremely difficult problem computationally speaking and compared to advanced deep learning models. In this work, we employ the Pyramid Vision Transformer (PVT) as the feature extraction backbone and a transformer-based mask prediction model called Mask2Former to precisely segment buildings. The PVT backbone can effectively capture hierarchical multi-scale features of satellite imagery, the Mask2Former refines object queries with cross-attention mechanisms to generate precise mask of buildings. To accommodate the memory and computation overhead of CPU-based training and inference, we made several optimizations such as reducing batch sizes or configuring based on number of layers. An evaluation of the model was given on INRIA Aerial Image Labeling Dataset, as it is a benchmark for building detection tasks. In our experiments, we demonstrate that STOR is efficient on CPU, and even though it may have certain bottlenecks due to not using parallel processing, the proposed method manages to remain competitive (35s inference time per 512x512 pixels). This study illustrates the potential of using transformer-based networks for building detection in low resource environments, thus maintaining a high accuracy in satellite imagery analysis.

articleTitle: Packet Sniffer for Securing Network Communication Through Real-Time Decoding and Authentication
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The Packet Sniffer project creates a user-friendly tool that is an analysis network and has surpassed the typical tools of network monitoring in a network, such as Wireshark, tcpdump, and Snort. It provides robust security features on data integrity; thus, the application improves all types of users using the Graphical User Interface. This tool captures and analyzes the network traffic in simplified analysis through the conversion of packet data into easily understandable formats. It focuses on the network analysis in order to recognize problems, improve its performance, and ensure safety for digital communication systems. Packet Sniffer integrates some of the functionalities of such tools as tcpdump and Snort while overcoming its flaws. The future version is expected to include more functionality, including encryption capabilities, and analytics for deep and enhanced security and analytic capacity. Packet Sniffer marks a major step ahead for all users in traffic network analysis.

articleTitle: IoT based Thermal Management and State of Charge Estimation of LFP battery
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Efficient storage of electricity is pivotal in modern applications, necessitating the use of batteries. However, enclosing batteries in compact spaces, such as power plants or electric vehicles, often leads to excessive heat generation, diminishing efficiency and longevity. Heat generation primarily stems from the charging and discharging processes. A liquid cooling system, powered by a motor connected to the battery system, circulates fluid externally around the battery layers to manage temperature, optimizing the battery's performance within the ideal range of 25°C to 35°C. Thermal Modelling of the battery is implemented in systems to understand how temperature changes affect their performance, efficiency, and reliability. IoT-based Battery Thermal Management System (IoT-BTMS) is introduced resulting in a sophisticated solution utilizing sensors, communication technologies, and data analytics. This system monitors and regulates battery temperature in real-time, based on sensed data a relay will enable cooling system if temperature values exceed the limit values or when the system becomes unstable, the cooling system continues until the system stabilizes and temperatures fall within limits.

articleTitle: A Multiclass Deep Learning Approach using CRelu - to Enhance Brain Tumor Identification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Research analyses the deployment of Convolutional-Neural-Networks (CNN) equipped with the CReLU (Concatenated Rectified Linear Units) activation function for identifying brain tumors MRI scan images. The CNN model is designed to be trained to classify various types of tumors, including glioma, meningiomas, pituitary tumors, and cases with no tumor present. By leveraging MRI images, the study evaluates how the CReLU activation function can enhance the model's capability to reliably distinguish between these tumor types, aiming to improve diagnostic accuracy and facilitate early detection through advanced image analysis techniques using deep learning.

articleTitle: Detection of Real vs. Fake Face Enhanced by MobileNetV2
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This study's abstract inspects the MobileNetV2 architecture and discovers that it performs excellently in accuracy and loss metrics over 20 training sessions. After the 20th session, the accuracy has been increased from 54.83% to 90.59% whereas the loss has been decreased from 1.1261 to 0.2207. This advancement improves security protocols, reduces identity theft, dismisses false information, supports debatable investigation, privacy protection, and confidence promotion in digital material. These consequences show the potential to discriminate between real and altered face photographs that are enhanced through increased consistency between its predictions and actual data.

articleTitle: Simulation and Performance Analysis of Passive Cell Balancing Technique for Lithium batteries using Modified Generic model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Modern society is increasingly adopting Electric Vehicles (EVs) due to fuel scarcity and the need to control pollution. Batteries are the most suitable energy storage devices for EVs; however, they have certain limitations, such as maintaining a safe operating temperature, risks of overcharging and deep discharging, and cell imbalance. Protecting batteries is crucial, and to ensure their safety, Battery Management Systems (BMS) are employed. BMS performs tasks such as parameter estimation and cell balancing based on the battery model. In this paper, a Modified Generic Battery Model is developed to provide a more accurate representation of battery characteristics. Passive cell balancing is implemented for both the MATLAB inbuilt battery model and the developed battery model. The variation of the State of Charge (SoC) is analyzed during charging and discharging, with and without cell balancing, in both cases. It is observed that the balancing time is approximately 110 seconds in both cases. However, minor variations in the SoC are noted in the developed generic model, which could be eliminated by improving the control algorithm or using active cell balancing. This validates the accuracy of the developed generic battery model. Additionally, an analysis is performed during simulation to identify the optimum balancing resistor, which is found to range between 0.6–0.65 Ω.

articleTitle: Enhancing Solar Power Forecasting Through Hybrid Machine Learning Models, Satellite Data Integration, and Transfer Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative method for improving solar power prediction accuracy by integrating realtime weather forecasting, advanced machine learning techniques, and hybrid modelling frameworks. The proposed methodology incorporates satellite-based solar irradiance data, time-series prediction leveraging Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and transfer learning for cross-regional model adaptation. These innovations aim to address the limitations of traditional models and provide a more resilient framework for forecasting solar power in diverse geographic regions.

articleTitle: Real-Time Object Detection from Surveillance using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Object detection in surveillance systems leverages advanced deep learning techniques to enhance security measures through real-time analysis of dynamic video feeds. This project integrates the YOLOv5 model for detecting weapons in both pre-recorded videos and live camera feeds. The model, trained on a dataset with 4000 images labeled for handguns and knives, utilizes image preprocessing steps such as resizing, normalization, and augmentation to improve detection accuracy. Implementing the system with OpenCV and Tkinter, the application processes video streams, identifying potential threats with high precision rate of 0.85 and recall rate of 0.90. The integration of a graphical user interface ensures user-friendly operation for security personnel. Key outcomes demonstrate the efficacy of deep learning models in real-time object detection, significantly contributing to proactive surveillance and enhanced situational awareness.

articleTitle: Vision Assist – Object Detection for the Blind
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Blind people need some aid to feel safe while moving. Vision Assist is a smartphone app for visually impaired individuals, using deep learning for intelligent assistance. It enhances accessibility by understanding real-time camera input and providing clear feedback. Compatible with all smartphones, With the help of Vision Assist's real-time object identification and customizable settings, visually impaired people can move more independently and with confidence around their environment. Users are given rapid, understandable feedback on their surroundings by means of text-to-speech communication of this information

articleTitle: Convolution Neural Networks for Multi-Channel EEG Based Sleep Stage Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Sleep disorders raise serious public health concerns because of their complex causes and profoundly negative impacts on people’s quality of life. The symptoms of these diseases are diverse, overlap, and affected by various lifestyle and health related factors, making a precise diagnosis important and challenging. A pivotal part of this investigation involves relating sleep stages to electroencephalogram (EEG) signals. In our work, we proposed a CNN Transformer model that classifies multi-channel EEG signals. This model uses a FFT to get frequency features of signals. FFT helps extract important frequency factors that distinguish different stages of sleep. We evaluated our model using the CAP Sleep database (Cyclic Alternative Patterns), achieving an accuracy of 91.84%. The average precision was 0.9197, with an F1 score of 0.9185, a recall of 0.9184, and a Kappa coefficient of 0.8980, demonstrating a reliable classification of sleep stages

articleTitle: Defect Detection and Identification in PCBs Using Single Stage Object Detection Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In industrial electronics, detection of defects in PCBs is an essential part in ensuring quality and reliability of printed circuit boards. Conventional methods of identifying such defects are sometimes ineffective, as they may not detect the defects efficiently owing to human error. Machine learning (ML) methods can be a better alternative to these traditional methods. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are well known for detecting abnormal patterns and irregularities in datasets efficiently. By training ML models using large datasets of PCB image samples, the models can effectively recognize the presence of such defects. The defects may include mouse bites, short circuits, spur defects and so on that may sometimes go unnoticed by the human eye. The implementation of ML models for this purpose not only improvises on accuracy, but also reduces the time taken. This paper focuses on a solution to detecting PCB defects using ML models.

articleTitle: A Sensor-Driven Automated Hydroponic System for Optimized Plant Growth in Diverse Environments
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This research paper presents the design and implementation of an automated hydroponic system capable of managing both closed and open setups in indoor and outdoor environments. The system integrates sensors and microcontrollers to monitor, control, and display key parameters like temperature, humidity, Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) in the nutrient solution, water level, and pH. Through automated monitoring and control, it reduces the need for human intervention, ensuring optimal growth conditions and continuous plant health. The project is driven by the vision of enabling agriculture in any environment, regardless of geographical constraints. Hydroponics, a soil-less method of growing plants, forms the core of the system, allowing for cultivation beyond traditional soil-based farming. By applying these techniques, the system aims to overcome the limitations of conventional agriculture, enabling the growth of various plant species in diverse locations. Through the integration of microcontrollers and sensors, this automated hydroponic system ensures continuous monitoring and precise control of environmental conditions, significantly reducing the need for manual intervention. This research contributes to the advancement of agricultural technology by providing a sustainable solution to enhance food production while addressing the challenges faced by traditional farming. By leveraging automation and sensor technology, the system optimizes resource usage, reduces environmental impact, and empowers individuals to cultivate crops with minimal expertise.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Attendance Framework using Quantum Edge Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Through the use of a Streamlit web application, the script is a highly intelligent tool that combines cutting-edge quantum processing principles with traditional computer vision approaches to handle a variety of face detection and identification tasks. While other libraries handle computer vision jobs and numerical calculations, such as NumPy and OpenCV, Streamlit is essential to developing the web application interface. While Streamlit WebRTC allows real-time video streaming, PIL is utilized for image processing. The application is set up to have a personalized look and a centered layout. Users may upload photographs, choose detection modes, and modify face detection settings on its header and sidebar. The program detects faces in uploaded photographs by encircling them with bounding boxes using the Haar Cascade Classifier. This may be used to build a face dataset or train a face recognition algorithm. Another important feature is real-time face identification, in which the software uses the Haar Cascade Classifier to identify faces in a video stream. Bounding boxes are used to emphasize faces, and photos containing faces are retained for later study or training. The program may utilize taken photographs to train a model for face recognition. These photos are processed, turned into grayscale, and then the LBPH (Local Binary Patterns Histograms) technique is used to train the model. The trained model is then kept for use in upcoming facial recognition assignments. Moreover, the program may be set up to track attendance in real time by identifying faces in a webcam stream. Time stamps are recorded, attendance is logged using recognized faces, and the information is saved to a CSV file. All things considered, the script provides a complete solution that combines traditional and quantum methods for real-time face identification, picture processing, and attendance monitoring. This makes it an adaptable tool for a range of computer vision and machine learning applications. Accuracy is improved by the incorporation of Quantum Edge Processing into the described face recognition framework, especially under difficult circumstances like dim lighting, spectacle wear, or other facial changes. The approach improves the identification of important face characteristics beyond what is possible with conventional techniques by utilizing quantum parallelism to achieve more accurate and efficient edge detection. Consequently, the method greatly enhances performance in real-time settings, where traditional systems frequently encounter constraints.

articleTitle: AIPenTool: A Unified Approach to Automated Penetration Testing for Enhanced Network and Web Application Security
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In response to the growing need for effective cybersecurity practices, this paper presents a unified penetration testing tool designed to streamline and automate the vulnerability assessment process for both network and web applications. Existing penetration testing tools often require the use of multiple disparate applications, which complicates workflows, limits functionality, and increases the burden on users. This tool integrates industry-standard tools like Nmap, Metasploit, and OWASP ZAP within a single platform, providing comprehensive vulnerability scanning, real-time monitoring, and customizable reporting in a user-friendly interface. By offering multi-platform support and automated workflows, this solution enhances accessibility for both technical and non-technical users, thereby increasing the efficiency and accuracy of security testing. Testing results demonstrate the tool's effectiveness in reducing false positives and improving the detection rate of common vulnerabilities, underscoring its value for modern cybersecurity practices. Future directions include the integration of AI-driven analysis for further vulnerability detection optimization.

articleTitle: Algorithmic Trading and Machine Learning: An Empirical Study of Stock Price Prediction in India
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This research paper uses historical data from Ambuja Cement to compare nine machine learning algorithms for algorithmic trading in the Indian stock market. The algorithms applied include SVM, Linear Regression, Decision Tree, K-NN, Ridge Regression, Lasso Regression, Bayesian Ridge Regression, Random Forest, Elastic Net Regression, XGBoost, and reinforcement learning. MSE, MAE, and R² are metrics used to evaluate predictive performance. The findings show that ensemble approaches and regularized regressions outperform simpler models, emphasizing the importance of model complexity and feature selection. Reinforcement Learning has the potential for optimizing tactics through constant adaptation. The study provides valuable insights on enhancing algorithmic trading in emerging Indian markets.

articleTitle: Empowering smart traffic avoidance using Natural language processing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The integration of Natural Language Processing (NLP) into smart traffic systems offers a novel approach to enhancing real-time traffic management and optimization. This paper explores how NLP can be leveraged to interpret and analyze vast amounts of unstructured traffic-related data, such as social media updates, traffic reports, and incident logs. A key component of this approach is the use of a BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) classifier, which enables more accurate extraction and classification of relevant traffic information from textual data. By processing this data in real time, the BERT-based NLP system can provide more precise traffic predictions, identify congestion patterns, and optimize traffic flow dynamically. The study highlights the potential of NLP, particularly through the use of BERT, in improving the efficiency and responsiveness of traffic management systems, ultimately leading to reduced travel times, lower emissions, and enhanced urban mobility. The app also includes user-friendly interfaces that allow drivers and city planners to access real-time updates, personalized route recommendations, and predictive analytics. The system’s adaptability ensures that it can respond quickly to unexpected incidents, such as accidents or road closures, further enhancing urban mobility. The study highlights the transformation potential of this app in improving the efficiency and responsiveness of traffic management systems, ultimately leading to reduced travel times, lower emissions, and a significant improvement in overall urban transportation experiences.

articleTitle: Enhancing Efficiency in Multicore Processor
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Traditional multi-core processor designs face challenges related to underutilized resources during program execution, particularly when cores encounter halts, such as when waiting for subroutines or lengthy tasks. This underutilization can result in reduced system efficiency and responsiveness. To address this problem, our concept incorporates dynamic load balancing, multi-threading, and a 5-stage pipelining approach, allowing a second core to work concurrently with the first core during execution halts. This integrated approach optimizes resource utilization, minimizes idle times, and enhances the overall execution time of programs. Mechanisms for task scheduling, synchronization, and communication are essential for effective implementation, ensuring seamless collaboration between cores without conflicts or data inconsistencies.

articleTitle: Cost-Effective Multiclass Model: Unveiling The Legacy of Tamil Nadu’s Iconic Temples
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: India's heritage sites, including temples, monuments, and forts, are crucial to the nation's cultural, historical, and architectural legacy, yet they face increasing threats from urbanization, pollution, and neglect. Reports from ICOMOS indicate that about 30% of these sites are at risk, with 24% of monuments under the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) lacking adequate signage and visitor facilities. In Tamil Nadu, tourism significantly contributes to the local economy, attracting 70% of international heritage visitors, making their protection essential for cultural preservation and sustainable tourism development. Traditional methods of detecting and classifying, such as manual surveys and satellite imagery, are often ineffective, highlighting the need for advanced technologies like deep learning. In this work, various pre-trained CNN models namely ResNet50, VGG16, InceptionV3, MobileNetV2, and EfficientNetB1 have been utilized to analyze the various model’s accuracy of identifying and categorizing Tamil Nadu’s temples. The notable temples that are classified using the models are Brihadeeswara,Meenakshiamman, Padmanabaswamy,Five Rathas, and Shore Temple. Implementing these models not only aids in conservation efforts but also enhances tourism, education, and urban planning while promoting public awareness and cultural identity. Thus, heritage sites can be effectively safeguarded from deterioration and encourage sustainable development.

articleTitle: Voice AI-Intelligence Based Voice Assistant
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Voice assistant applications have become integral parts of modern technology ecosystems, offering users convenient and efficient ways to interact with their devices. This paper introduces Voice Ai, a versatile voice assistant application developed using Android Studio and Google's Machine Learning Kit Machine learning(MLKit) for Optical Character Recognition (OCR) functionalities. The app includes features like setting alarms, making calls, opening applications, and conducting question-answer sessions powered by G4F. A comparative analysis between G4F and Google's backend is performed, assessing their performance and user satisfaction during question-answer interactions. Voice Ai simplifies daily tasks and boosts productivity, providing insights for developers, researchers, and end-users interested in AI-based voice assistant applications.

articleTitle: Blockchain based Identity Generator and Authenticator
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The market today is flooded with the counterfeit branded products and there is currently no reliable solution to prevent the widespread flow of duplicates. However, blockchain technology offers a potential solution to stabilize the inflow of these counterfeits. As a decentralized and secure system, blockchain can assign a permanent, unique identity to each product, which can be accessed by anyone but cannot be altered, not even by the owner. This paper proposes the development of a blockchain-based system to assign a unique identity to every product, serving as a tag to distinguish between original and counterfeit items. This identity can also act as an ownership ID, enabling ownership transfer and helping to prevent the illegal trade of stolen or counterfeit products.

articleTitle: Indian Sign Language Interpretation using Neural Networks and Mediapipe Holistic
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Communication with individuals who have hearing disabilities presents a significant challenge. This paper aims to address the complexities involved in character classification within the context of Indian Sign Language (ISL). Signing is essential for effective interaction among those with hearing impairments or speaking disabilities. For those unfamiliar with this language, deciphering the gestures made by individuals with disabilities can be confusing and disordered. Effective communication should flow in both directions.To address this issue, we propose a system for recognizing Indian sign language from hand gestures. The system captures hand gestures from individuals, and these captured gestures are processed to identify their meaning.Our model captures static signs for finger spelling and identifies the alpha-numeric characters associated with captured gestures. We test this model to identify gestures assigned for each alphabet (A–Z) and numerals (1–10). We tested this model with subjects who were trained on the gestures, and the system produced an accuracy of 92.69% in the case of alphabets and an accuracy of 85%in numerals.

articleTitle: Design of Low Power 4-Bit Adder for DSP Applications Using Custom 45nm Technology CMOS Standard Cell Design
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The increasing demand for energy-efficient digital circuits in resource-constrained environments like mobile devices has driven the need for optimized low-power designs. This research focuses on the design of a 4-bit Ripple Carry Adder (RCA) tailored for Digital Signal Processing (DSP) applications. Using 45nm technology, the goal is to minimize the consumption of power while ensuring high performance. This design addresses static and dynamic power concerns by leveraging custom standard cell design and advanced low-power techniques like Sleepy CMOS Sleepy Stack (SC-SS) and the Forced Stack Technique (FST). The challenge is optimizing the RCA’s design to minimize power consumption while maintaining high operational speed, enabling integration into embedded DSP systems in resource-constrained environments such as mobile devices.

articleTitle: Placement Prediction Using the Artificial Neural Network (ANN)
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Placements are of utmost significance to academic organizations and college students. A strong foundation for the professional field is built up for the student beforehand, and a positive placement report gives a school or college a competitive edge in the educational marketplace. An automated method of statistical evaluation that streamlines the creation of analytical versions is machine learning. In this study, a computer that predicts whether a student might be located or not is the focus, based solely on the student's credentials, historical data, and experience. The performance is evaluated using students’ datasets from presidency college and accuracy achieved for our model is 96%.

articleTitle: The Effect of Algorithmic Trading Systems on Stock Market Volatility
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: For many people, trading in stock market is a popular investment option. Stock price trends has always been an important area of interest for machine learning researchers. Modelling the stock market has always stood as a challenge, despite of many Algorithmic Trading system being available. Algorithmic trading is a mechanism involving use of Artificial Intelligence(AI) for quick trading in stock exchanges.This work focuses on understanding the role of algorithmic trading on the capital markets and examines the existence of volatility and test the homogeneousness in the degree of volatility of the chosen Emerging and the developed markets from ASIA.ADF, PP tests and Jarque-Bera tests were conducted to examine the stationarity and normality of the time series data. Returns, SD, ARIMA, ARCH, GARCH, BEKK-GARCH, Granger causality test were applied for the study. The empirical analysis depicted that volatility is present in all stock markets, with its level varying between different markets over time. This will be beneficial to the investors to arrive at right decision.

articleTitle: Diabetes Detection Using Iris Image
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The diabetes detection utilizing iris images was an extensive investigation into the application of machine learning techniques for medical image analysis. The primary objective was to develop an effective system capable of distinguishing between diabetic and non-diabetic individuals based on iris images. The Proposed system comprised several phases, including image preprocessing, feature extraction using Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG), and classification using the AdaBoost algorithm. Iris images were preprocessed by converting them to grayscale, resizing them to a uniform size, and normalizing their pixel values. HOG was employed to extract meaningful features from the images, capturing the essential gradient and edge information necessary for classification. The AdaBoost classifier, with a decision tree as the base learner, was then trained to differentiate between diabetic and non-diabetic iris images. A comprehensive dataset of iris images was used, split into training and testing sets to ensure robust model validation. Cross-validation was performed to assess the model's generalization capability, resulting in a low cross-validated loss, indicative of the model's accuracy and reliability. For feature extraction and classification, the suggested solution successfully integrates Python's machine learning packages, including scikit-learn and scikit-image. A user-friendly interface for classifying test images was also included, demonstrating the proposed system's usefulness.

articleTitle: Forecasting Gilt Mutual Fund Performance Using Data-Driven Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This study investigates the performance of gilt mutual funds by employing data-driven machine learning algorithms to forecast returns and classify funds based on performance indicators. It predicts year-to-date (YTD) returns using linear regression (MSE 48.24, and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of 0.59), K-means clustering, and Random Forest classification, as well as categorizing funds as 'Good' or 'Average' based on performance criteria such as assets under management (AUM) and risk profiles. The analysis focuses on the top five gilt funds, utilizing historical returns data to forecast performance and volatility. Key findings identify Kotak Gilt - Investment, HDFC Gilt Fund, and Bandhan Government Securities Fund as top performers, giving practical insights for investors. However, model limitations, such as limited fit and precision for lower-performing funds, highlight possibilities for improvement. The findings help investors make better decisions by improving their understanding of fund performance trends.

articleTitle: Optimizing Symptom Prediction in Healthcare: An Integrative Machine Learning Approach to Regression and Classification Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This research explores the application of combined machine learning techniques for predicting disease symptoms, aiming to support early diagnosis and improve healthcare outcomes. By analyzing both regression and classification models, the study evaluates their respective performance, strengths, and challenges in predicting symptoms. Using a comprehensive dataset with medical records, demographic data, and clinical variables, we developed predictive models to capture the complexities of healthcare data. To enhance accuracy and manage issues like data imbalance and feature diversity, ensemble methods and feature engineering were applied, with the Random Forest classifier achieving a leading accuracy of 91.84%. Additionally, the study emphasizes model interpretability, which is crucial for healthcare professionals to trust and adopt these predictive tools. The findings provide valuable guidance for healthcare professionals and data scientists in choosing machine learning approaches suited to specific medical applications. By bridging the roles of regression and classification models, this research offers a well-rounded perspective on the potential of predictive analytics in healthcare.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: LSTM-Based Assistance for People with Alzheimer’s Disease
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The study emphasizes the utilization of AI-based technologies to support individuals affected by Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) and their caregivers. The following presents a succinct overview of research papers that tackle the obstacles confronted by AD patients, along with innovative AI solutions. Explored topics encompass the creation of mobile applications, deployment of deep learning algorithms, integration of voice-activated technologies, and application of systems biology approaches. These technological interventions provide a spectrum of features including memory-boosting games, medication reminders, location tracking, cognitive exercises, and emotionalsupport. Through harnessing AI advancements, these solutions aspire to augment patient independence, aid in daily activities, enhance communication, and contribute to overall well-being. Key findings underscore the importance of user-friendly interfaces, personalized support, and seamless integration with existing healthcare systems. Additionally, privacy, security, and effective integration with clinical data emerge as crucial considerations. Ongoing research in the domain holds the promise of further advancements to positively impact the lives of those affected by AD.

articleTitle: Cost Effective Attendance Logging System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Efficient attendance management is crucial for the smooth operation of educational institutions, corporate environments, and various structured settings where tracking individuals' presence is essential. Traditional attendance methods, such as manual sign-in sheets or punch cards, are often prone to inaccuracies, are time-consuming, and are vulnerable to manipulation. These conventional methods can lead to discrepancies, inefficiencies, and administrative burdens, impacting organizational productivity and accountability. This paper presents a cost-effective attendance logging system effectively combining RFID technology with the Node MCU to deliver an innovative and budget friendly solution for attendance management.The system implements the integration with Google sheets facilitating easy access to and management of attendance records, enhancing overall operational efficiency. A compact set-up is developed with casing done by 3D printing supporting for the easy handling and installation of the system. The system’s design focused on cost effectiveness without compromising functionality making it an ideal choice for a range of applications.

articleTitle: Multi-Server Management System Using Flask, SSH and Paramiko
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This Multi-Server Management aims to offer a web-based management system with its different capabilities that support SSH by Paramiko library at the same time, it provides the users an interface to communicate with the different servers in real time using Flask and Socket IO. It simplifies the complexities of handling multiple servers. The designed interface allows the end-users to connect to remote servers through SSH and input commands, and receive the corresponding outputs in real time over the web. Key functionalities include multi-user support, logging, and monitoring, which collectively enhance administrative efficiency. The design offers an HTML template to the user via a Flask web module, while client-server interactions are improved with Socket IO. Employing the Paramiko library provides control over the use of nodes and the issuance of commands to the target node over SSH. This technology offers a simpler way of handling servers since various functions such as control and supervision and effectively handling administrative tasks are accomplished at once. Future enhancements may include integration with cloud services and additional protocols, further enriching the management experience for IT professionals.

articleTitle: Sentiment Detection Using X-NLP: Harnessing Advanced NLP Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is a useful way to gain insights from text, helping organizations make informed decisions based on the emotions in the information they collect. This project aims to create a sentiment analysis system using Explainable Natural Language Processing (X-NLP) to clarify how sentiment predictions are made. The system offers users a look into how certain words and features affect sentiment classification. By using explainable AI techniques, it ensures that users not only get accurate sentiment labels but also understand why these labels were assigned, building trust and ease of use. The models are trained on the Sp1786 database and a larger data-set of 1.6 million tweets, applying both statistical methods (SVM) and deep learning techniques (LSTM). The SVM model achieved a precision of 0.6753, an AUC of 0.8432, and an F1 score of 0.6769, making it effective for real-world use.

articleTitle: Daily updates on Construction sites progress using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Construction planning stands as a cornerstone in the successful management and execution of construction projects, presenting both fundamental principles and significant challenges. The planning process encompasses the strategic selection of technology, accurate estimation of required resources and task durations, and the meticulous identification of interactions among diverse work tasks. A well-crafted construction plan serves as the bedrock for developing comprehensive budgets and schedules, laying the groundwork for efficient project execution. Furthermore, the system recognizes the importance of adaptability and customization in the construction industry. It stores and updates customized requirements for materials, ensuring that the construction plan remains agile and responsive to changing project dynamics. the proposed construction planning system represents a paradigm shift from traditional methods, offering a holistic and technologically advanced approach to project management.

articleTitle: Shelf Optimization Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This work introduces an advanced automated billing system for retail environments, leveraging Internet of Things (IoT) technologies to revolutionize the shopping experience. By integrating load cells, RFID modules, and Arduino microcontrollers, the system ensures a smooth and efficient checkout process. Load cells precisely measure product weight, RFID modules verify item authenticity, and Arduino boards handle data collection and processing. The system's functionality is enhanced through connectivity with Google Sheets via an ESP8266 module, enabling real-time updates on inventory and transactions. A user-friendly interface, designed using Flutter Flow, offers an engaging shopping experience for customers. This work exemplifies how IoT can transform retail operations, delivering a scalable, secure, and customer-focused solution.

articleTitle: Implementation and Performance Analysis of 1kb Memristor Based Memory Array
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Memory is a fundamental cognitive process that allows us to encode, store, and retrieve information. This paper explores memory design, focusing on a new memory module called 4T2M SRAM. Current SRAMs use six transistors per memory cell. This design proposes a more efficient 4T2M SRAM that uses four transistors and two memristors. This design aims to improve performance, reduce power consumption, and be more space- efficient. The paper also dives into various components crucial for memory systems, such as control blocks, decoders, drivers, and sense amplifiers. Memristors are a promising new memory technology with advantages like high density, low power use, and the ability to retain data even without power (non-volatile). The paper explores how memristors can be incorporated into memory design. Overall, this paper discusses memory architecture and proposes a 4T2M SRAM design that leverages memristors for improved performance, power efficiency, and area usage. It also details essential components used in memory systems.

articleTitle: Real-Time Aerial Image Edge Detection with MicroWatt Power ISA on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This research investigates the implementation of real-time aerial image edge detection using the Canny edge detection algorithm with the MicroWatt Power Instruction Set Architecture (ISA)-Open Core Processor on Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs). Canny edge detection is particularly advantageous for aerial image processing due to its ability to produce precise and well-defined edges, making it ideal for applications in surveillance, agriculture, and environmental monitoring where detail preservation is critical. The proposed system utilizes the MicroWatt Power ISA-Open core processor to optimize resource utilization, achieving high throughput and low latency while maintaining energy efficiency. The work uses the Xilinx Vivado EDA tool to calculate the power dissipation of the FPGA implementation, demonstrating significant reductions in power consumption compared to traditional processing methods. The experimental results showcase the effectiveness of the Canny edge detector in producing accurate edge maps while minimizing resource usage, thus enabling real-time processing capabilities. This work contributes to the advancement of low-power embedded systems for aerial imaging, highlighting the potential of FPGAs combined with the MicroWatt Power ISA for efficient and effective image analysis.

articleTitle: Quantum Cipher Exchange with BB84 Protocol and Cryptography Using the One-Time Pad Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Quantum cryptography using the BB84 protocol is at the forefront of modern secure communication. This paper emphasizes on BB84 protocol and its role in secure key distribution utilizing the Qiskit libraries in Python to simulate Quantum Key distribution (QKD). This QKD is then applied to the One-Time Pad algorithm for message encryption and decryption. Ensuring data confidentiality and integrity and is difficult due to advanced cyber threats and the potential of quantum computing to undermine traditional cryptographic methods. Current encryption techniques are susceptible to quantum related attacks, risking the decryption of sensitive data. Alice (sender) and Bob (receiver) use classical encryption to communicate but eavesdropper Eve with quantum capabilities, can potentially decrypt their messages. This vulnerability affects critical data security in finance, healthcare, and national security, making robust cryptographic solutions essential for maintaining trust and safety in digital communications. Our work emphasis the utilization of the quantum key generated by employing the BB84 protocol with the help of Qiskit library in python as cipher text in the process of one time pad encryption and decryption. This encrypted data dispatched between the sender and receiver to ensure maximum security, confidentiality and integrity over the period of communication.

articleTitle: Hilbert curve based optically interfaced microwave resonator for reconfigurable wireless systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The proposed design uses the 2×2 integration architecture as an array that is recovered to a T-resonator in order to access the Hilbert curve. In conjunction with a transmission line that has two air gaps, the resulting combination reaches a resonance frequency of around 0.8 GHz. The proposed deive is mounted on a 1.6 mm FR4 substrate that is 50 × 50 mm. CST technique improves the obtained plan dimensions. Based on numerical calculations, the functioning of the suggested resonator is assessed using the S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> and S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf> parameters. Two varactor diodes circuits are included for reconfiguration in order to regulate the frequency range as well as the parameters associated with the relevant frequency band.

articleTitle: Federated Learning for Enhanced and Private Autism Spectrum Disorder Detection in Children Across Diverse Populations
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The contribution of this work focuses on the results of applying Federated Learning(Fl) to the improvement of performance and generalizability for Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) detection models, which include children, assuming high standards for data privacy. In FL, institutions can collaborate on model training by means of decentralized datasets that share knowledge without exposing sensitive information explicitly. This would be fully in line with all the regulations for privacy and would protect patient information. Our federated model achieved an accuracy of 91% and outperformed the traditional centralized way with a gain in generalization for several diverse demographic groups by 5% on the F1-score. FL combines five sources of input-eye-tracking data, speech prosody, EEG, and physiological signals-used by the clients into a staunch, adaptable model suitable for a wide range of populations. Our results suggest that FL might represent a game-changer in ASD Diagnostics, given the pursuit of a scalable and privacy-centric solution for sensitive health care contexts.

articleTitle: Decentraliszed eCommerce (deCom) Development based on Token Trade Store
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The decentralized e-commerce (deCom) project aims to create a comprehensive eCommerce platform that mimics eCommerce website functionality and user experience. This project features the modern web development technologies integrated into scalable, responsive, user-friendly. It also creates customizable applications. The frontend built with React ensures a dynamic and seamless user interface, while the backend powered by Node.js and Express.js controls server-side logic and database operations through MongoDB A key feature is the user of reliability, product inventory, cart management and order processing the work emphasizes modular code architecture, efficient state management, and a robust API framework. When these technologies are combined, the project is a useful demonstration of building full-stack web applications.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Certificate Generation and Validation System for Refugees
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The global refugee crisis has created unprecedented displacement, making access to essential services like education, healthcare, and employment challenging due to unreliable identification. Traditional certification methods are prone to forgery, loss, and accessibility issues. This project introduces a Blockchain-based Certificate Generation and Validation System for refugees, utilizing MetaMask for digital identities, the Solidity compiler on Remix IDE for certificate generation, and Ganache and Truffle for development and testing. The Django-developed frontend enables user-friendly certificate generation and validation. This system enhances security, integrity, and efficiency, reducing human errors and streamlining administrative procedures. By providing secure, verifiable certificates, it improves refugees' access to essential services and supports their integration into new communities, offering a scalable solution to certificate management in refugee contexts.

articleTitle: Active Wind Power Forecasting Through Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Wind power is non-conventional, promising and widely accessible renewable energy resource. Accurately predicting the useful wind power production from Wind Turbines is of paramount importance for management of wind power in power grids.
