The purpose of this paper is to accurately estimate and predict the active wind power generated based on multiple features using Machine Learning (ML) models. This paper analyzes the prediction power of popular ML Regression models - Linear, Ridge, Lasso, K-Neighbors, DecisionTree and GradientBoosting for active wind power prediction. Values recorded every 10 minutes from wind turbines physically installed in China is utilized to train and evaluate the ML models. Obtained results have concluded that K-Neighbors Regressor model promises and can predict active wind power with better and more correctness in comparison to others.

articleTitle: A Survey of 3D Gaussian Splatting: Optimization Techniques, Applications, and AI-Driven Advancements
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a transformative technique for real-time, high-quality 3D rendering. This paper surveys the advancements in 3DGS, focusing on optimization strategies, applications across diverse domains, and AI-driven innovations that enhance its utility. Optimization techniques, such as Mini-Splatting and sparsification frameworks, address challenges like computational overhead and memory inefficiency while maintaining visual fidelity. AI has further expanded the capabilities of 3DGS through frameworks like SceneTeller, ART3D and GaussianEditor, enabling text-to-3D generation, object-level manipulation, and artistic scene creation with multi-view consistency. Applications of 3DGS range from autonomous driving and robotics to virtual and augmented reality, highlighting its adaptability and efficiency. This survey underscores the importance of continued research to refine 3DGS’s scalability and applicability, solidifying its role at the intersection of computer graphics and artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Raspberry Pi Powered Smart Doorbell System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In today’s smart homes, automation systems are increasingly interconnected, streamlining daily tasks. However, this convenience necessitates enhanced security to mitigate potential risks. The system focuses on two primary functions. First, it provides real-time alerts to homeowners when an unknown individual presses the doorbell, ensuring they are always aware of who is at their door, thereby improving safety. Second, it employs sensors to collect and analyze environmental data, enabling users to customize their home automation settings according to their preferences. At the heart of this system is a Raspberry Pi, which serves as the central server, complemented by a network of user-friendly sensors that facilitate real-time data gathering and control. This design prioritizes ease of use, allowing homeowners to interact with the system effortlessly. This paper presents a solution that integrates home automation with robust security features for a seamless user experience. This innovative solution provides a secure and customizable home automation system that prioritizes both convenience and safety.

articleTitle: Automated Dental Cavity Detection in Front Teeth using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The increase in number of cases in dental caries has entailed the need for sophisticated diagnostic tools for timely detection and treatment. This work presents an innovative dental caries detection methodology using OpenCV, a well-known open-source computer vision library. By utilizing image processing techniques, this method accurately identifies and analyzes caries. The four stages involved in caries discovery involve Image pre-processing, segmentation, feature extraction and classification. Image preprocessing enhances quality of the image and removes noise, followed by segmentation, that identifies and isolates the specific region of interest. Next, feature extraction approaches identify potential caries regions by analyzing their morphological characteristics. In the next step, classification algorithm differentiates accurately between healthy and caries-affected areas. Experimental outcomes show the efficiency of this approach, presenting a high accuracy in caries detection. This automated system can not only assist in early diagnosis, but also supports dental professionals in providing improved patient care by reducing the time and subjectivity associated with traditional investigation techniques using own-trained haarcascades files. The novelty of this work is the development of the new, own-trained model in the OpenCV haarcascades toolbox as it does not contain any explicit model for detecting dental caries.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Approaches of Resistive-Random Access Memory
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Memory refers to a physical device storing data in bits. It may be 0 or 1. Storage and retrieval of information is essential for computer operation and memory acts as the primary foundation. Non-volatile memory is a type of storage that does not lose the data it contains after a power loss, just as volatile memory does. Re-RAM is one of the nonvolatile memories. Re-RAM is another outstanding non-volatile category that applies resistance switching from a high resistive state to a low resistive state and vice versa in metal-oxide layers to store data more quickly and at higher density. For instance, it has a low power rating, high endurance, and good data retention characteristics, and is thus suitable for energy-constrained mobile and embedded systems. This Paper demonstrates the simulation of Re-RAM which can be done using Verilog-A in Cadence Virtuoso and through code-level analysis with MATLAB.

articleTitle: Smart Ventilator for Affordable Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Over the past few years, COVID-19 pandemic has emphasized the significance of the requirement for an efficient and accurate ventilator in health care system along with quick response. IoT-based smart ventilators have been developed to pump oxygen when needed, providing low latency and advanced features. Additionally, a system for Heart Rate Monitoring using IoT technology has been designed to assess the risk chances of heart attacks and monitor heart health that utilizes ECG to measure rate and consistency of the heart, along with electrical activity during the cardiac cycle. In this paper, a new IoT-based ventilator and heart rate monitoring system has been proposed and developed that offers a low-cost, portable, and accurate solution for respiratory and cardiac care. The device allows for real-time monitoring and control, enhancing patient outcomes. Additionally, the newly developed ECG system delivers detailed heart activity insights thus improving timely health assessments. These advancements in medical technology aim to improve patient care.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Democratic Engagement: Block chain Based E-Voting System with Enhanced Biometric Security
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: There is an enormous need for a secure and efficient online decentralized voting system. This paper mainly revolves around our proposed model for the same, that leverages the robustness of Blockchain Ethereum Technology and the precision of machine learning algorithms for user authentication. The system ensures a transparent, tamper-proof, and user-friendly voting process, enabling users to participate in elections from remote locations and eliminating the possibility of under-the-bench corruption. The fusion of a facial recognition system, built on a python-based Django-powered backend, authenticates users before voting. Upon successful authentication, voters receive their ballots via email, which directs the voters to a React-based web application for casting votes. This paper outlines the system architecture, the flow of events, the technologies utilized, and the implementation specifics, highlighting the innovation and security attributes that distinguish this methodology as a viable alternative to traditional voting methods.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Four Quadrant DC Drive
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The paper focuses on hardware implementation of a reduced-cost, high-performance chopper-based four-quadrant DC drive system. The main aim is to control the speed and direction of a DC motor efficiently across all four quadrants of operation (i.e. forward and reverse motoring, forward and reverse regenerative braking). The drive system applies to electric vehicles (both plug-in and hybrid) that work in all four quadrants. The design encompasses the selection and sizing of components such as power transistors, diodes, and capacitors to ensure reliable and efficient operation. The system incorporates a chopper circuit to control the voltage supplied to the motor, thereby regulating its speed and direction. Modulation techniques (pulse width) are employed to vary the duty cycle ‘k’ of a chopper, allowing precise control over the motor's characteristics. Additionally, appropriate control algorithms are implemented to achieve smooth transitions between different operating modes while ensuring system stability. Experimentally validated by demonstrating the performance of the DC motor as a load in all four quadrants. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed four-quadrant DC drive utilizing a chopper for precise control and efficient operation of DC motors in industrial applications.

articleTitle: Optimization of Forced Sleep 4x4 Sram Array Using Delay Flip Flop
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Memory optimization plays an important role in electronic devices. With low latency and high-speed data access capabilities, SRAM gains prominence. Crucial for high-speed caches, AI and other networking applications that require rapid data processing. The immediate writing and retrieval of the data determines the performance of the device. As a volatile or non-volatile data storage for electronic gadgets like laptops and cellphones, Static Random Access Memory (SRAM) is the best choice for industrialists. Memory proved to be a significant contributor to the speed, performance, and data storage of the handheld system. The urge to optimize performance is always relevant. The proposed system uses 250nm technology, where a 9T SRAM cell uses a forced sleep technique for power optimization to implement a 4x4 array.in this project, the SRAM cell is converted to a D flip flop so that the 9T SRAM can replace the D Flip Flop at low power and low size applications. This project also modifies the SRAM array by replacing the cell with a DFF. It gives a comparative analysis of various 4x4 SRAM arrays of traditional Static Random-Access Memories such as 6T SRAM, Conventional 9T SRAM, modified 9T SRAM, as well as a D flip flop, thus achieving a significantly lower power delay product (PDP). A stable low-power system is developed using the tool LT spice. This tool is used to evaluate the power dissipation, delay, and power delay product, and thereby, the comparative study of the memory cells can be studied.

articleTitle: Using Immersive Virtual Environments for Intercultural Learning Experiences
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This case study paper presents results from a pilot study to test the use of immersive virtual environments as a pre-departure training module in study abroad programs for intercultural learning experiences. Insights from the pilot study are used in developing a scenario-based immersive pre-departure training module for further testing and refinement. Study abroad programs introduce students to novel cultural experiences that lead to enriched learning experiences, friendships, and a lifetime of memories. Our study presents insights on the current student experiences in these programs and how immersive technologies can enhance their experiences through prior virtual cultural exposure and interactions. For the pilot study, six students from a computer graphics technology program who had previously enrolled in study abroad programs were recruited. Participants were guided through an exploratory tour of popular locations in Google earth VR. Once participants got comfortable using the VR headset and controller, they were asked to explore their prior study abroad destination and share their experiences in those foreign destinations. The VR session lasted for roughly 20 minutes followed by filling out a post-session questionnaire. The insights gained through this pilot study show that 1. Participants appreciated the visual immersion of the VR experience. However, participants preferred real-life experiences over virtual ones. They did see the VR module as preparation for real-world cultural exploration. 2. There was a lack of cultural interaction in the VR space. Participants valued experiences that help them better understand differences in the way of life and values of people, more than just viewing eye-catching monuments. These insights informed the design of a scenario-based immersive pre-departure training module in VR for students to explore virtual scenarios and encounters with cultural ambassadors in the foreign destination.

articleTitle: Cradle- A Simplified Decentralized Finance Platform
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Financial Systems have been revolutionized by the introduction of Decentralized Finance (De-Fi).They are used for financial activities such as lending, staking and token swapping. However, there are challenges to the existing De-Fi platforms like the complexity that creates a barrier for new users to use them effectively. The proposed model Cradle tries to address these challenges.

articleTitle: Optimizing Microbial Fuel Cells for Commercial Use: A Study on Electrode Durability, Organic Substrates, and User-Friendly Design
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Microbial Fuel Cells (MFCs) are an emerging technology which harnesses the power of electrolytic bacteria for generating electricity from organic matter. In the present work, the performance of MFCs is investigated with respect to current generated, durability, ease of handling, availability and cost-effectiveness. Testing was done using different substrates and electrode materials, specifically carbon paper and aluminium foil with primary aim of making MFCs a user-friendly, cost-effective renewable energy source which also addresses environmental concerns by utilizing biodegradable wastes. The highest current output of 77 mA was achieved using aluminium foil as electrodes and soil mixed with bio-compost as the electrolyte, demonstrating the potential of MFCs for sustainable energy generation.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of DC Microgrid for Sustainable Energy Development
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: A Cutting edge modern day technology for the existing conventional power system is the idea of smart grid. To eradicate climate changes, market variations and security of power supply in near future smart grids help in restructuring the power structure. Smart grids are applied to low carbon energy emissions, electric vehicles, microgrid, renewable energy, flexible power system, distributed energy resources (DER’s), advanced metering infrastructure, fuel markets, customer support etc. In this paper, Analysis of DC Microgrid is implemented with distributed generation. On site generations like PV, wind and battery act as input sources and deliver output to the load. The proposed model is simulated in MATLAB Simulink and the results are verified for the operation of DC Microgrid using distributed energy resources. Results highlight upon the flow of power continuously using any one the input resources. The structure is implemented in MATLAB/Simulink and the results are tabulated.

articleTitle: Accident Avoidance in Driverless Car using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This abstract presents a ground breaking paradigm for accident mitigation in autonomous vehicles through the utilization of Raspberry Pi and deep learning methodologies. By synergistically amalgamating cost-effective hardware and sophisticated AI techniques, the system empowers real-time object detection and recognition, thereby augmenting the vehicle’s capacity to pre-emptively avert collisions. The efficacy of this system is meticulously assessed through meticulous simulations and rigorous real-world experimentation, thereby substantiating its efficacy in bolstering safety measures. Noteworthy challenges encompassing the procurement of comprehensive training datasets, computationally intensive requirements, and real-time optimization are duly acknowledged.

articleTitle: MineShark AI: Respond to Text Queries and regulations applicable to mining Industries
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The current work MineShark_AI is an Artificial Intelligence-driven platform designed to respond to text queries and provide comprehensive regulatory information for the mining industry. Leveraging natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning algorithms, MineShark_AI accurately interprets user queries and delivers relevant information on mining regulations. The platform encompasses location and country-specific regulations, ensuring compliance and operational safety. MineShark_AI serves as a valuable resource for mining professionals, enhancing decision-making processes and streamlining regulatory adherence through a user-friendly interface. This innovative solution addresses the complexities of mining regulations, promoting industry best practices and sustainability.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms with and without Hyperparameter tuning for Dry Bean Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Classification of dry beans is very important task in food and agriculture industry. Traditionally, classification was done manually. To reduce the task of human and to automate the separation, algorithms of machine learning are employed. All the supervised learning algorithms are trained and tested with and without hyperparameter tuning and the results are presented as result. Machine learning algorithms which are used for this study are Naïve Bayes, K Nearest Neighbour, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, XG Boost, Multi-Layer Perceptron. Accuracy of all the algorithms were compared and it is evident that Support Vector Machine with Grid search hyper tuning is giving highest accuracy of all other algorithms for dry bean classification.

articleTitle: Automated Crowd Abnormality Detection and Segmentation Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Crowd analysis has evolved as a highly prominent research subject within the field of computer vision. For public safety, automated analysis of crowd dynamics from surveillance video is essential since it allows for the identification of potentially dangerous crowd formations and the tracking of their movements. We are all aware of the various difficulties that come with big parties. Terrorist attacks pose a serious threat to our nation since they frequently position bombs in busy places, which causes large-scale casualties. Furthermore, thieves usually operate in crowded areas, using the confusion to their advantage to conduct crimes undetected. Effective crowd analysis is crucial given these hazards. This work presents a deep learning framework for crowd behaviour monitoring and control, with the objective of averting violent episodes and other detrimental behaviour’s that frequently occur in such environments. The suggested method aims to detect unusual crowd behaviour by utilizing cutting-edge deep learning algorithms. This proactive approach improves public safety and reduces possible hazards to society.

Author Keywords: Crowd anomaly detection and Deep learning for public safety

articleTitle: Energy Generation using vertical Axis Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Electrical energy comes in second to sunshine as a major energy source in today's technologically evolved society. Its usage of thermal energy, however, has made the generating one of the sources of pollution. Currently in operation, hydropower facilities are not a sustainable source of energy. As a result, wind turbines are a clean, renewable, and sustainable energy source. This abstract looks at how vertical axis wind turbines (VAWTs) can be integrated with buck regulators and inverters to generate energy efficiently. VAWTs provides several advantages than traditional horizontal axis wind turbines (HAWTs), including simpler construction, lower noise levels, and the potential to harvest wind from any direction. By combining buck regulators, which efficiently convert variable wind energy into stable DC voltage, and inverters, which convert DC to AC for grid integration, this system enhances the overall performance and reliability of VAWT-based energy generation. This paper clarifies the promising role of VAWTs in diversifying renewable energy by an extensive analysis of the body of existing literature and case examples.

articleTitle: Video enabled crowd monitoring system and analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: One of the most victorious strategies for slowing the spread of the COVID-19 virus has been proposed: social isolation. A computer vision-based AI-assisted approach for aiding with social distance norms compliance is utilized. The solution consists of modules for person detection, tracking, and distance violations detection. You are given the option to select a tool-based mode for camera calibration. In this paper, the various measures for determining the likelihood of social distance violations and how to tell them apart from temporary violations from persistent ones are demonstrated. On countless real-world issues, AI/Deep Learning has in the past shown promising results. In this paper, how to observe crowds in public areas and workplaces using Python, image processing, and computer vision is discussed in depth.

articleTitle: Efficient Energy Exchange in V2G System for enhanced Power Quality
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The Creation of Vehicle-to-Grid technology was driven by the rise of electric vehicles and grid concerns with regard to renewable energy sources. The suggested system outlines the push-pull inverter based V2G, which is an essential part of the bidirectional power flow between electric vehicles (EVs) and the grid. By effectively converting power from one form (DC) to another form (AC power for grid injection during discharging and, conversely, by converting grid Alternating power to Direct power during charging, the push-pull inverter enables this dual functionality. To precisely detect and synchronize with the grid's voltage and frequency, a PLL control technique is used. This guarantees that the output of the inverter is exactly in line with the properties of the grid, From the MATLAB Simulink study, the power quality improvement and energy management of the system is reflected in this paper.

articleTitle: Soft Alert Generation for student Dropout Mitigation and Proactive Management by Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Proactive dropout mitigation is crucial for enhancing student success and retention in schools. Dropout rates pose significant challenges in education systems globally, impacting students, communities, and societies. This paper emphasizes the necessity of proactive measures to address dropout rates and support student achievement by building an educational network. Through proactive approaches, schools can identify and address risk factors early, preventing student disengagement and dropout. Various strategies such as early interventions, personalized support systems, academic enrichment programs, and community partnerships are examined for their efficacy in promoting student engagement and retention. Additionally, the role of data-driven decision-making and predictive analytics in identifying at-risk students and tailoring interventions is explored. Implementing proactive dropout mitigation requires collaboration among educators, administrators, families, and community stakeholders. Prioritizing proactive measures can foster a supportive learning environment, empowering students to excel academically. This paper highlights the significance of proactive dropout mitigation that has been enabled using a seemingly enhanced automated full-stack student management system integrated with ML algorithms used in enhancing student success and promoting educational equity. By investing in proactive interventions, educational institutions can reduce dropout rates and foster a culture of academic excellence and lifelong learning.

articleTitle: Architectural Visualization using Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In the dynamic field of architectural design, effective communication stands as a requirement for successful project realization. However, traditional 2D methods often struggle to convey the depth and essence of architectural visions to stakeholders. Augmented Reality (AR) emerges as a revolutionary tool, poised to transform architectural communication and stakeholder engagement. This work is an exploration of the transformative power of Augmented Reality in architectural design communication, employing a comprehensive methodology. By leveraging state-of-the-art technological innovations, the aim is to provide architects and designers with groundbreaking tools to translate their blueprints into immersive, dynamic experiences. Beginning with collaborative requirement analysis, conceptual design, and data acquisition, the optimization of assets for AR rendering follows suit. Augmented Reality, in tandem with Unity 3D, Figma, and specifically smartphones as AR devices are used for realization of the work. This integration fosters collaborative, immersive design experiences and propels architectural discourse into a new era of interactive visualization and communication.

articleTitle: Design of Low Cost & Compact Ventilator using Proportional Solenoid Valves and DC drive
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper primarily focuses on the design and development of a Low Cost & Compact Ventilator (LCCV) using Proportional Solenoid Valves (PSVs) and DC drive. The PSV, a promising technological component, is used to control the inspiratory to expiratory ratio [I:E ratio] of the ventilator module. Low-cost and low power-consuming electronic products available in the market are employed to produce an efficient, effective, and affordable LCCV. The dual channel DC drive used in the LCCV consists of a pair of step-down DC-DC choppers whose output is connected to two PSVs to control the I:E ratio of the ventilator system. The PWM pulses generated by an Arduino microcontroller is fed to the gate terminals of the MOSFET switches of dual-channel DC drive through driver and opto isolator circuits.The duty cycle of the switching pulses of the dual channel DC drive is adjusted for fast dynamic operation of the PSVs. The inspiratory-to-expiratory (I:E) ratio can be set independently after assessing the patient's condition. A simulation of a dual-channel DC drive is carried out using MATLAB/Simulink, and the results obtained are consistent with the embedded hardware output of the LCCV module. Bluetooth technology is employed to test the functionality of a test lung with ventilator module, which replicates the behaviour of human lungs. The expansion and contraction, as well as the fast dynamic operation of the test lung are found to be controlled efficiently according to the I:E ratio and duty cycle settings of the LCCV module. The designed module is more affordable, operationally effective, and efficient than similar ventilator models on the market, making it ideal for launch with significant benefits for patients, especially in rural areas and ambulance systems.

articleTitle: Wavelet-Based Image Enhancement and Deep Learning for Accurate Underwater Fish Species Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Underwater photography has long been subject to degradation from turbulence and suspended particles; conventional techniques such as picture enhancement, restoration, and reconstruction have been investigated to counteract these effects. In order to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of these algorithms, the conventional neuron fitting function was substituted with a wavelet basis, which successfully captured the waveform and properties of submerged turbulence. A thorough understanding of marine ecosystems is largely dependent on the accurate classification of various fish species. Attaining high classification accuracy for fish is essential for progressing Ichthyology research and supporting fish behavior research by marine biologists. This work provides a method that uses machine learning—more specifically, a CNN algorithm—to improve underwater photos and categorize species. Compared to traditional methods or simpler machine learning algorithms such as support vector machines (SVM) or decision trees, CNNs demonstrate superior accuracy with 95% and robustness due to their ability to learn spatial hierarchies and automatically extract meaningful features, making them especially effective for complex visual tasks in challenging underwater environments.

articleTitle: Smart Impact Mitigation: Intelligent Speed and Safety
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Road accidents present an enduring global issue, leading to substantial loss of life and property. The present research introduces a mechanism developed for the identification of accidents in real-time and the proactive regulation of vehicle speed to reduce collisions and lessen their impact. The utilization of acceleration and gyroscopic sensors aids in recognizing sudden changes in vehicle movement that may indicate accidents. Once identified, the system promptly sends out an alert message with precise vehicle location coordinates via GSM to predetermined emergency contacts, such as emergency services and specified family members. GPS technology is employed for continuous monitoring of the vehicle’s location, allowing for comparison with stored speed limits. Persistent occurrences of speeding lead the system to independently adjust vehicle speed by controlling the throttle or applying the brakes, thereby ensuring adherence to speed regulations and improving overall road safety. This comprehensive approach provides numerous advantages, including immediate accident identification, swift alert dissemination, and automatic speed control directed at accident prevention. Through the seamless integration of GSM and GPS technologies, the system establishes a strong foundation to support road safety initiatives and reduce the impact of accidents at a systemic level.

Author Keywords: Gyroscopic sensors and road safety enhancement

articleTitle: Automated Robotic System for Pipeline Health Assessment
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Pipelines are extremely important equipment since they are utilized for a wide range of purposes in various sectors, including the shipping of fuel oils, petrol and water. They are vulnerable to ageing, decomposition, cracking, mechanical defilement, and other issues over time. If these issues are ignored, accidents can occur, resulting in significant costs to the economy and human lives. This emphasizes how crucial it is to regularly inspect pipelines in industrial facilities to increase security and efficiency. These days, there are numerous methods for examining pipes, including magnetic particle-type inspection technologies and X-rays, but none of them provides a thorough inside inspection of the pipes.In this paper, we propose to develop an autonomous robot for in-pipe inspection that can see within pipes. Additionally, eliminates human involvement in labor-intensive and hazardous tasks, which will lower the frequency of accidents caused by infrequent inspections. The mechanical design of the robot and the implementation details are explained in the paper. The results of the hardware implementation are presented in the current work.

articleTitle: Predictive and Preventive Fire Safety System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper presents the development of an advanced fire detection system that utilizes a camera to identify fires. The proposed system leverages Deep Learning methods to detect flames and fire outbreaks, and it employs an appropriate water control mechanism to extinguish the fire. A key feature of this system is its ability to minimize false alarms, enhancing the system’s reliability and overall efficiency. The proposed device has potential applications in residential homes, businesses, shopping malls, and similar environments. By reducing the risk of injury and property damage caused by fires, the system offers significant safety benefits. Experimental results demonstrate the model’s superiority in terms of cost-effectiveness, performance, and efficiency.

articleTitle: Evolution of Photovoltaic Cells: A Comprehensive Review of Material Innovations, Technological Progress, and Efficiency Improvements
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) technology has become a cornerstone in the quest for sustainable energy solutions. This paper presents a comprehensive review of recent advances in photovoltaic cells, focusing on material innovations, device architectures, and technological improvements. This study examine the development of new photovoltaic materials, including perovskites, organic semiconductors, and tandem cells, as well as enhancements in device efficiency, stability, and manufacturing processes. The review also explores emerging trends, such as flexible and transparent PV cells, and discusses the challenges and opportunities in the path toward commercialization and large-scale deployment. Finally, the paper provides an outlook on future research directions that could drive further advancements in the field.

articleTitle: High Performance Closed-Loop Control of a Phase Shifted Full Bridge Converter for Electric Vehicle Application
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Phase Shifted Full Bridge (PSFB) DC – DC converter is a popular converter used in Electric Vehicles (EV) due to its salient features like high stability, Zero Voltage Switching (ZVS) property and simple design. In this paper, an ideal PSFB converter operating in Continuous Conduction Mode (CCM) is mathematically modelled using volt-sec and amp-sec balance equations and modelled using MATLAB / Simulink software with appropriate step size. Later, a single voltage loop control system is developed considering the sensor and Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) gains. The developed controller was tested for various conditions like output set points, load changes at high slope rates which are typical in EVs. In addition, the effect of ripple injection on the high voltage (HV) side of the transformer is observed on the Low Voltage (LV) for different frequencies. A simple PI controller was designed using the bode plot technique to regulate these disturbances.

articleTitle: Web-based selector-Applicant simulation software
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The interviewing process is inherently complex and demands an unbiased, objective approach to assess and identify the right talent effectively. This project proposes a web application to enhance the interviewing process using AI technologies like deep learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP). The platform simulates a Board Room environment, starting with ice-breaking questions and advancing to specialized queries tailored to the candidate’s expertise. A key feature is an AI-driven scoring system that evaluates the relevance of interview questions and the quality of candidates’ responses, ensuring a focused assessment of required skills. Utilizing a MySQL database for scalability, the application provides fair and quantifiable evaluations for both interviewers and candidates, helping organizations streamline hiring, reduce bias, and improve workforce quality.

articleTitle: Smart Hackathon Management System with Machine Learning Integration
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In the rapidly growing landscape of hackathons and competitive coding events, managing large-scale participation and evaluating diverse submissions have become increasingly challenging. Traditional methods of handling hackathons are often inefficient, particularly in assessing and summarizing large volumes of participant data, presentations, and project documentation. This paper introduces a Smart Hackathon Management System that integrates advanced machine learning techniques to address these challenges, focusing on text summarization using seq2seq models and image-based text extraction. The proposed system automates the summarization of textual content, such as project proposals and idea presentations, allowing juries to make quick, informed decisions. Additionally, it incorporates a robust image text extraction module, designed to accurately retrieve and analyze text from images, further enhancing the system's capability to handle various forms of data. This integration of machine learning models within a hackathon management platform not only streamlines the evaluation process but also improves accuracy and reduces the manual workload involved in event management. The effectiveness of the proposed system is validated through extensive experiments, highlighting its potential for broader applications in event management and other domains requiring efficient handling of large datasets.

articleTitle: Percepti Alarm: A Beacon of Safety and Autonomy Leveraging OCR and ML
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Percepti-Alarm is a groundbreaking endeavor aimed at revolutionizing the lives of the visually impaired. It introduces a transformative solution by integrating a high-tech camera onto the conventional white cane, offering real-time environmental scanning and object recognition capabilities.This innovative system works by capturing live visual data, processing it with a sophisticated algorithm, and seamlessly conveying the findings to the user through a discreet Bluetooth earphone. What sets Percepti-Alarm apart is its ability to not just alert the user to the presence of objects but to also verbally articulate the nature of these objects. By delivering comprehensive situational awareness through speech, Percepti-Alarm empowers the blind to confidently navigate their surroundings. This project is not only a triumph of technology but a testament to the profound impact it can have on the lives of those with visual impairments, facilitating independence, safety, and inclusion. It marks a significant stride towards a more equitable and accessible world for the blind

articleTitle: Efficient Signal Processing: Harnessing Distributed Arithmetic for High-Speed FFT Operations
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The present article introduces a novel approach to significantly enhance the computational efficiency of modern Digital Signal Processing (DSP) processors. The algorithm enhances the efficiency of Sum of Products (SOP) operations, which are essential for real-time signal processing applications, by utilizing Distributed Arithmetic (DA) techniques for the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) and its inverse (Inverse FFT) (IDFT) computations. The present study undertakes an exhaustive quantitative analysis to assess the computational delays of the proposed 2, 4, and 8-point Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) and Inverse Discrete Fourier Transform (IDFT) across various bit representations (4, 8, and 16-bit). For example, when using 4-bit representations, the computational delays for a 2-point Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) are measured to be 13.318ns, 30.629ns for a 4-point FFT, and 27.779ns for an 8-point FFT. Similarly, the delays for the 2-point Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) in an 8-bit representation are 13.727ns, the 4-point FFT in 22.276ns, and the 8-point FFT in 30.592ns. The study further includes the addition of appropriate delays for IDFT operations, which enhances the understanding of the effectiveness of the approach suggested in various scenarios. Furthermore, the research presents and evaluates three distinct categories of transforms, namely 2-point, 4-point, and 8-point FFT and IDFT structures. These structures utilize different quantities of Look-Up Tables (LUTs) for computational purposes. The research showcases the exceptional computing efficiency of the suggested design through detailed quantitative analysis, emphasizing its potential advantages in improving DSP implementations in practical situations.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Advertisement Design: A PIL-Based Approach for Quality and Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The paper presents the development of a Data Science solution that applies generative AI models in order to create high-quality images to be used in visual marketing and advertising. Using the Python library PIL (Pillow) along with machine learning frameworks, the solution combines predefined product images with the selected backgrounds, enhancing image synthesis techniques for more appealing and contextually relevant visuals. This leads to improved efficiency and effectiveness in the creation of content by automatically placing product images onto the background images used in marketing campaigns. The approach demonstrated a 98.06% SSIM (Structural similarity Index) score, indicating significant visual quality improvement. Initial results suggest a 15% enhancement in visual appeal compared to traditional image creation methods.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of 6T SRAM in different technologies using FinFET process
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Static Random Access Memory (SRAM) is an essential component of contemporary system-on-a-chip (SoC) devices and processors. To achieve high density, SRAM bit cells must be built using ever-tinier components. This study looks at the design and operation of a 6T SRAM cell at many technology nodes, from 180 nm down to 18 nm (Fin Field-Effect Transistor) FinFET (Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor) CMOS. It looks into how scale affects stability, process variation tolerance, soft mistakes, and device aging. Significant difficulties are seen at smaller nodes, such as heightened vulnerability to soft mistakes and decreased stability as a result of process variances and aging devices. The report also emphasizes how FinFET CMOS technology has advanced to 18 nm, resolving certain scaling problems with earlier nodes. SRAM cells gain from increased density as technology advances, but they also confront significant stability and reliability issues. In order to guarantee the lifetime and continuous performance of SRAM in cutting-edge semiconductor technologies, future research should concentrate on reducing these problems.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Handwriting Analysis for Personality Trait Identification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Handwriting is a unique characteristic that distinguishes a person's identity and serves as a method for identifying various physical and psychological attributes of the writer. It reflects genuine personality traits, including behavior, emotional responses, self-perception, creativity, honesty, fears, and many other characteristics. In this paper, we propose a multi-layered approach for analyzing personality traits through handwriting analysis, utilizing a Voting Classifier, which integrates predictions from multiple base models to enhance overall performance. Specifically, our Voting Classifier combines Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine, Random Forest Classifier, and Gradient Boosting Classifier. Each base model is carefully tuned using RandomizedSearchCV to optimize hyperparameters such as regularization strength for Logistic Regression, kernel type for Support Vector Machine, and number of estimators for Random Forest and Gradient Boosting Classifiers. The model's performance evaluation reveals impressive results, with a 93% accuracy in classifying handwriting samples. These findings highlight the model's effectiveness and its ability to handle various handwriting styles with consistency. The strong accuracy underscores the model's potential for real-world applications, offering trustworthy insights into personality traits through handwriting analysis.

articleTitle: Novel Four-Port Fractal Filter with Improved Port Isolation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper presents a detailed design and simulation of a novel four-port fractal filter. The design utilizes a combination of square resonator and a Vicsek fractal geometry fed through microstrip feed at each corner. The modeled filter is simulated using EM tool. The bandpass response is observed between opposite ports at two frequencies, 2.66 GHz having a bandwidth of 441.8 MHz and 6.43 GHz having a bandwidth of 583.4 MHz. As for the adjacent ports, they isolated with an isolation of -15 dB and -30 dB respectively. The filter has been fabricated on a FR-4 material and performance has been verified using a variable waveform generator. For the -27.5 dBm / 2.8 GHz input power at port 1, the output power at the opposite port is - 30.17 dBm and the output power at the adjacent port is - 38.98 dBm with a -8 dB attenuation.

articleTitle: Automated Parsing and Comparative Analysis of ASN.1 Structures in 3GPP Standards
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The growing complexity of telecommunications standards requires efficient tools to parse and analyze 3GPP specifications. This research presents an automated system for parsing ASN.1 structures, extracting field descriptions, and analyzing differences across multiple versions of 3GPP documents. Traditional manual methods are time-consuming and error-prone, with single document processing taking 6–8 hours. Our system reduces this time by 96%, processing a version in under 10 minutes, integrating structured data into an SQLite database, and offering search and comparison functionalities through a Flask-based web interface. Results indicate significant improvements in efficiency and accuracy, enabling seamless version management for complex standards.

articleTitle: Portable soil analyzer to promote Digital Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Digital agriculture is revolutionizing the way food is grown, managed, and distributed, offering a path to more efficient and sustainable agricultural practices that can address global challenges like climate change and food security. This includes efficient management of soil health and water usage. It is critical for maximizing crop yields and ensuring sustainable practices. This presents the design and implementation of a smart portable soil analyzer that can measure key soil properties including pH, moisture, and nutrient levels. The device is designed to interface with a comprehensive management system that provides real- time weather updates and monitors irrigation systems based on soil moisture data and weather conditions. The proposed system enhances farm productivity, sustainability, and profitability.

articleTitle: Performance Metrics Comparison between Half Bridge DC Link Inverter and Traditional Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper focuses on a comparative performance evaluation of conventional multilevel inverters over DC-link inverters, examining key metrics such as harmonic distortion, voltage balancing, power quality, efficiency, and operational flexibility. The circuit configuration with symmetrical topology is modelled and results are verified using MATLAB Simulink. The analysis demonstrates that conventional/traditional multilevel inverters with 5.97% of VTHD consistently outperform DC-link inverters with 20.22% in terms of waveform quality and scalability, albeit with higher complexity and component requirements. The findings underscore the continued relevance of conventional MLIs for applications demanding superior harmonic suppression and high-power capability, while also identifying their limitations compared to simpler alternatives like the DC-link inverter. Simulation results confirm its capability to enhance power quality and system dependability, positioning it as a practical solution for renewable energy systems, drives, and grid-connected applications.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Skin type Classification using Fine-Tuned ResNet50 Architecture
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Personalized skincare depends critically on the classification of skin types since different skin types—normal, oily, and dry—need different treatment plans to preserve beauty and health. Recommendation of suitable skincare products, prevention of side effects, and optimization of therapies for common dermatological diseases depend on precisely identifying skin types, therefore promoting excellent health and well-being. In this work, we classified skin types from a dataset of 3,152 photos using a deep learning method leveraging ResNet50 architecture. There were 2,522 photos for training, 314 for validation, and 316 for testing out of the dataset. ResNet50, a well-known convolutional neural network (CNN), was tuned for this particular purpose by changing its final fully connected layer to output three classifications matching to normal, oily, and dry skin types. Following training, the model attained an accuracy of 85% on the test set, therefore encouraging infrastructure and creativity in dermatological research. This study emphasizes the relevance of deep learning in dermatological domains and opens the path for automated, customized skincare recommendations, so supporting responsible consumption and manufacturing of skincare products and so helping to lower inequalities by guaranteeing skincare solutions for different skin types.

articleTitle: Optimizing Design Turnaround in Angstrom-Scale Semiconductor Devices: A Correlation Analysis of Design Tool and Signoff DRCs
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: As semiconductor technology advances towards finer nodes, significant deviations from conventional Very Large-Scale Integration (VLSI) methodologies are inevitable. Innovations such as backside power delivery networks coupled with gate-all-around structures are anticipated to form the backbone of future angstrom-scale devices. These advancements introduce complex challenges for layout engineers, necessitating a comprehensive understanding of how DRC infractions within design tools correspond to actual layout discrepancies. Design Rule Checking (DRC) being an iterative process, that involves verifying whether a specific design adheres to the constraints imposed by the process technology, typically requires generating a layout and then addressing any issues within the design tool. This study presents a correlation analysis aimed at enabling preemptive resolution of these infractions during the design phase, consequently optimizing turnaround times in subsequent tape-out processes.

articleTitle: Analysis of optimization Techniques for Dynamic Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Models based on dynamic neural networks such as DeBERTa and Vision Transformers ViT have disrupted the two fields. However, there is one complication – their performance requires so much computation which limits its realistic applications. The aim of this study is to propose advanced optimization techniques that can increase the efficiency of these models without compromising their performance. We adopt approaches such as DistilBERT, DeBERTa and Vision Transformer models. Then we carry out detailed empirical analysis of the consequences of these techniques on the model accuracy, time performance, throughput as well as resources consumption. The findings show enhancement models, where some methods improved the throughput by 29% and reduced the GPU usage by 61% at the same or higher accuracy. This reveals the capacity of dynamic neural networks in resource-constrained settings and enhances the overall vision of the use of such models in practice.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Disturbance Observer-based Passivity Controller for an Interleaved Boost Converter Feeding a Constant Power Load
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The instability within the overall power system can arise due to the negative impedance behavior exhibited by the presence of a constant power load (CPL). This article tackles the challenge of stabilizing the DC bus voltage of interleaved boost converters under the influence of varying CPLs. To maintain stability and control the voltage across the DC bus, this research introduces a passivity-based control (PBC) approach that is resilient to load variations while also eliminating the steady state error induced by changes in the CPL. The resilience of the introduced control algorithm is achieved by incorporating a nonlinear disturbance observer (NDO) along with PBC. The suggested controller approach ensures stability against nonlinearity, rapid restoration, and accurate following of the global trajectory to the desired voltage across the DC bus. To validate and confirm the effectiveness of the control, the results from the MATLAB/Simulink simulation are presented.

articleTitle: Next-Generation Intrusion Detection Systems with Machine Learning and Deep Learning-Based Firewalls
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The growing complexity of cyber-attacks has underlined the requirement of strong Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) able to instantly recognize a variety of hazards. This work offers a strategy for improving Next-Generation Intrusion Detection Systems (NGIDs) combined with firewalls by use of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches. Using the NSL-KDD dataset—which includes both normal and attack network traffic—the work creates a system able to classify traffic patterns into "Normal" and "Attack" categories. The proposed method consists in four phases: data collecting, data preprocessing, feature selection and extraction, and classifier application. In the preprocessing stage, the dataset is cleaned and normalized; hence, suitable feature selection follows to increase classification accuracy. Trained and tested for classification using performance criteria including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, naïve bayes and support vector machine (SVM) models are then compared in efficacy. The results reveal that the SVM classifier has low misclassification and great accuracy (97.29%), therefore proving its prospective use in advanced IDS. The article underlines how several models could be merged inside a firewall system to offer real-time network protection. Future studies will look at using deep learning techniques and ensemble methods to raise detection accuracy even more, therefore allowing NGIDS to be more adaptable and efficient in countering evolving cyber threats.

articleTitle: Quantum Dot-Enhanced Sodium-Air Batteries for Unprecedented Energy Storage Performance
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper investigates the material complexity and scalability considerations to integrate Sodium Quantum Dots (NaQDs) into Sodium-Air Batteries to enhance their stability and overall performance. The introduction outlines the pressing need for advancements in energy storage technologies to meet the increasing demands of modern applications. NaQDs, chosen for their unique electronic and structural properties, emerge as a promising candidate for improving Sodium-Air Batteries. The theoretical and innovative exploration promises the enhancement in stabilities and efficiency by retaining the structural integrity of the battery system.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Common Source CMOS Amplifier and Two Stage CMOS Common Source Amplifier using 45nm technology
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative analysis of CMOS CS Amplifiers with varying channel lengths of 45nm and 90nm, as well as a Two-Stage CMOS CS Amplifier using 45nm technology. The performance parameters such as gain, bandwidth, power consumption, and noise characteristics are critically analyzed using the Cadence Virtuoso environment. The primary objective is to evaluate the impact of channel length variation on the performance of CMOS amplifiers and to contrast it with the two-stage amplifier configuration, which is widely used for higher gain applications. The results highlight the trade-offs between these configurations and provide insights into the design considerations for high-performance analog circuits in advanced semiconductor technologies.

articleTitle: Novel approach for characterization of MMIC based modules using RF Probe station
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In this article a method for characterization of Microwave Integrated Circuits (MICs) & Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuits (MMICs) using RF Probe station is presented. Detailed characterization of the MMIC die using RF probe station is presented. As an example, a C-band MMIC driver amplifier MMIC die is characterized using probe station. Measured & simulated responses of the MMIC die are compared. Design, fabrication and characterization of the Coplanar Waveguide (CPW) to Microstrip transition is briefed in this article. The designed transition is useful for characterization of MIC circuits at carrier plate level. Alumina is chosen as substrate material for designing the CPW- MS transition. The realized transition achieved a relative bandwidth of 107% with a return loss of −20 dB in the 6.0-20.0 GHz, and the corresponding insertion loss is less than −0.5 dB. The designed CPW-MS transition is used in characterization of MMIC attenuator die at carrier plate level and gives estimates of the packaging losses. Keywords: Alumina, CPW-MS transition, RF Probes, Probe station, MICs

articleTitle: Stacking Ensemble Model for Stress Detection using Sleeping Habits
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This Stress is defined as a state of emotional response or mental tension triggered by problematic circumstances or challenging situations, called as stressors. It is a normal response of human beings whenever threats and emotions are addressed. The degree of stress levels experienced by humans varies based on various negative outcomes in life. To mitigate stress levels, it is essential to know the various stress levels. This research explores how sleep disturbance is related to various physical, mental, and social issues. The main aim of this research is in detection of the levels of stress through machine learning algorithms in sleep-related behaviours. The multiclass dataset used comprises information about the numerous sleep habits and the corresponding stress levels. The pre-processed data are applied to Machine Learning (ML) techniques like Naive Bayes (NB), Decision Tree (DT), Gradient Boosted Tree (GBT), Random Forest (RF) and Random Tree (RT) for classification. The ensemble stacking method is proposed to obtain better results than the existing results. The findings of the study can be computed accurately, facilitating in addressing sleep related issues in a timely manner.

articleTitle: Evaluation of CNN Architectures for Brain Tumor Identification and Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Brain tumor statistics are alarming and varied. Brain tumor detection can drastically aid in improving patient care, quality of life, and survival rates. This work presents brain tumor detection and classification and compares various convolutional neural network (CNN). The dataset employed 1 contains images from four tumor classes: glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and no-tumor. CNN models like AlexNet, a custom-designed CNN, ResNet-50, and VGG16 are trained and then tested on the dataset, that comprises of 7,061 images. The performance of each architecture is evaluated based on classification accuracy, computational cost, and overall generalization capability. Results indicate that ResNet-50 model demonstrated the highest accuracy of 98.78%, making it a strong candidate for efficient brain tumor classification. This research yields significant contributions to the understanding of CNN architectures in medical image analysis, offering recommendations for future advancements [1]-[2]. Notably, it presents a comparative assessment of four architectures, thereby expanding the existing literature and addressing a previously unexplored research question [10].

articleTitle: A Critical Study on Hybrid Computing and Its Current Influences and Future Challenges
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This research focuses on the evolving field of hybrid computing, which combines traditional computing architectures with advanced computational paradigms like quantum computing, neuromorphic computing, or cloud-edge computing. Hybrid computing involves integrating multiple computing models or systems to leverage their complementary strengths. For example, combining classical computing with quantum or neuromorphic approaches to solve complex problems more efficiently. The goal is to enhance computational power, increase efficiency, and tackle problems that are difficult for traditional computing models alone. Emerging technologies, including quantum computing, machine learning, and AI, are driving the need for hybrid systems. These technologies enable the handling of more complex computations that classical systems struggle with, such as optimization, simulation, and cryptography. The integration of cloud and edge computing is also central to hybrid computing, enabling decentralized computation and processing closer to data sources. Combining different computing paradigms requires seamless communication and integration between systems, which is a significant technical challenge. Main challenging areas are scalability, software and hardware compatibility, energy efficiency and security. There is a need for standard protocols and frameworks to enable smoother integration of various computing systems. New algorithms that can take advantage of hybrid architectures need to be developed. Depend on applications significant advancements in hardware, including quantum processors, neuromorphic chips, and integrated hybrid processors required. The rise of hybrid computing will also bring ethical concerns, such as the impact on jobs, privacy, and inequality in access to advanced technologies. The study concludes by emphasizing the transformative potential of hybrid computing while acknowledging the technical, economic, and societal hurdles that need to be overcome. It highlights that while significant progress is being made, realizing the full potential of hybrid computing will require continued research, collaboration, and innovation across multiple domains. In summary, hybrid computing is poised to revolutionize many fields by merging the strengths of various computational models, but its widespread adoption will require overcoming substantial technical, economic, and regulatory challenges.

articleTitle: Smart Servo-Operated Ball Valve with IoT Integration and PID Control for Precise Fluid Management
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of an innovative control valve system that integrates a ball valve run by a servo motor, IoT capabilities, and PID control for precise operation. The system uses a 1/4-inch ball valve mounted in a custom 3D printed housing, driven by an MG995 servo motor. An ESP32 WROOM module microcontroller enables Wi-Fi connectivity and data transmission to the cloud via the Thingspeak platform. Ultrasonic sensors are used for tank level measurement, and the valve operation is controlled using a PID algorithm implemented in C++ on the Arduino IDE. The PID parameters are fine-tuned to achieve best performance. This solution offers a cost-effective and precise method for fluid control in various industrial applications.

articleTitle: Computational Modeling of Thermal Effects on MoS2 Electrodes in KOH Electrolyte for Energy Storage Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: An axisymmetric two-dimensional model of a supercapacitor using molybdenum disulfide electrodes and 1M KOH electrolyte is simulated under different operating cell currents involving charge-discharge process using COMSOL Multiphysics to analyze different temperatures, inner temperature distribution field, electric current density, ion concentration and various types of heat transfers. In this paper, the influence of different current values on the thermal behavior of the supercapacitor is investigated and key thermal trends are identified showing the effects of increasing current on the supercapacitor.

articleTitle: AI/ML Applications in Spoofing Detection in 5G Networks: Challenges and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: 5G networks has advanced connectivity, high data, low latency and reliability. Along with these features new challenges come with respect to security, particularly spoofing attacks. One of the necessity in 5G and future wireless communication is to prevent the spoofing attacks depending on the applications. Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) present promising solutions for detecting and mitigating spoofing threats in 5G networks. This paper explains the different types of spoofing and applications, challenges, and future prospects of AI/ML in addressing spoofing in 5G networks. AI/ML algorithms can be used in detection of the location of attackers. This paper also analyses current methodologies, highlight key challenges, and discuss potential advancements that could enhance the security of 5G networks.

articleTitle: Knock Detecting Door Unlock System using IOT
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a Knock Detecting Door Lock System, aimed at enhancing security by eliminating traditional lock and key mechanisms. The proposed system utilizes an ESP32-based setup to detect specific knocking patterns, ensuring that only authorized individuals can unlock the door. The system addresses common security issues associated with key duplication and passcode vulnerabilities by relying on a personalized knocking sequence. Key features include the ability to set, and update knocking patterns, detect discrepancies, and maintain a balance between security and convenience. The hardware components include an ESP32, piezo sensors, and a servo motor, while the software is developed using the Arduino IDE. It can also incorporate two-factor authentication by generating a One-Time Password (OTP) when a valid knocking pattern is recognized. The OTP is sent to the user’s mobile device as an additional verification step before access is granted. By integrating the knock-based mechanism with the OTP feature, this system offers a robust, user-friendly solution that addresses both analog and digital security needs. The system’s innovative approach offers a cost-effective, efficient, and secure solution for modern door locking needs, with potential applications in various settings, including residential and commercial properties.

articleTitle: Detection of Maize Plant Insects using Lightweight Deep-Learning Scheme
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Automatic plant condition monitoring using a chosen computer algorithm is one of the recent advancement in the agriculture domain. To ensure the plant health, it is necessary to monitor the pest which causes the considerable damage to the plant. This work considered the monitoring of maize (corn) from the study and the common pests which causes the severe damage to maize, like the grasshopper and beetle are analyzed automatically using a chosen Lightweight Deep-learning (LD) methodology. This work considered the MobileNet (MN) variants for the study and this proposed technique consist the following phases; digital image collection and converting it to 224x224 pixels, feature extraction using chosen MN-model, feature optimization using Butterfly-Algorithm (BA) and fused-features generation, and binary classification with 5-fold cross validation. This work considered the MN-variant model to examine the pest images and the achieved result confirms that this scheme presents a detection accuracy up to 96% when SoftMax based classification is executed.

articleTitle: 6 DOF Robotic Arm Control using Arduino Uno and Bluetooth Module
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Robotic arm manipulators are used in many industrial and commercial applications. The arm that we have designed here has 6 DOF(Degrees of freedom) which gives it ample movement in 6 different axes. We have used 6 servo motors for accurate and quick arm movement. By interfacing it using the Arduino Uno it was fairly easy to program the 6 motors and run them simultaneously. The entire arm is controlled by a smartphone using the HC-05 Bluetooth module, thus making the user interface fairly simple. This robotic arm performs pick and place operations with high accuracy, low power requirements, and minimum operating difficulty.

articleTitle: Multiple Disease Prediction System using Gradient Boosting
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The research paper highlights the urgent need for early diagnosis of chronic diseases such as heart disease, Kidney disease, Lung Cancer, Parkinson’s disease, and diabetes, which are major sources of morbidity and mortality worldwide. In order to address this problem, the research proposes a Multiple Disease Prediction System that predicts various diseases by using gradient boosting, a potent ensemble learning technique. By using the Adaptive Boosting Classifier Boosting algorithms to adjust hyperparameters, the accuracy and resilience of the system are improved. The system successfully predicts diabetes, Kidney disease, Lung Cancer, Parkinson’s disease, and heart disease, according to experimental data, indicating that it could be a useful tool for clinicians to help with early diagnosis and enhance patient outcomes. In addition to pointing the way toward future approaches for multi-disease prediction with wider applications in medical diagnostics, this research adds to the expanding field of machine learning in healthcare.

articleTitle: Automated Darting Point Identification System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Limited expertise and experience in handling human-wild life conflicts necessitates automated tools for wild life management. YOLOv8 classification algorithm was utilized to detect the presence of an elephant. Once the presence of the animal is detected an appropriate darting point will also be detected for applying quick-action sedatives as part of the human-wild life conflict management. The proposed automated focusing system can ensure improved target acquisition speed and can be instrumental in the development of an automated dart gun mechanism. Appropriate darting site for elephant was successfully detected by the algorithm after the elephant got classified positively. Top-1 accuracy for elephant/non-elephant classification system, with YOLOv8 achieved a consistent accuracy of more than 97%.

articleTitle: Kidney Stone Image analysis for Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Kidney stones are a common medical issue that, if not identified and treated quickly, can result in excruciating pain and other complications. The accuracy and intrusiveness of traditional diagnostic techniques like ultrasound and X-ray imaging are limited. This work suggests a non-invasive and effective method for kidney stone identification that makes use of MATLAB's capabilities in particular for image processing approaches. The technique entails obtaining medical images, usually CT or ultrasound scans, and using image processing algorithms to improve and assess the images. To raise the quality of the photos, pre-processing methods including contrast enhancement and noise reduction are used. After that, segmentation techniques are used to isolate the regions of interest, which enables the recognition of possible kidney stones in the images. The identified stones are then described using feature extraction techniques according to their size, shape, and textural characteristics. Kidney stones may now be automatically identified and categorized, thanks to this model, which facilitates kidney stone diagnosis. To evaluate the precision and effectiveness of the suggested system, a dataset of medical photographs is used to assess the suggested method. The findings are compared with standard diagnostic approaches. The outcomes demonstrate how MATLAB-based image processing methods may be used to accurately and quickly detect kidney stones, which can assist medical professionals in making better judgments and giving their patients better care.

articleTitle: Smart Wheelchair Navigation Using Gesture-Based Control and IoT
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
