abstract: There are a lot of people in India and other countries around the world who are physically disabled and use wheelchairs to move around. This gesture-controlled wheelchair project aims to provide an innovative solution to help these people. They can control their wheelchair movements using just gestures made by their hand or head. This project makes use of the MPU 6050 sensor which has a gyroscope and an accelerometer that can be used to detect the gestures of the user, these gestures correspond to the respective orientation data which is then transmitted to a receiver unit using Arduino Nano with the help of a radio module - nRF24L01 to the motor driver to control the motion of the wheelchair. This model is very convenient for the user to control his wheelchair and move around easily. A prototype of this wheelchair has been designed to show the working of the device. This project can help improve mobility and bring independence to individuals with physical disabilities. Further research into this topic can motivate companies to produce this product in the market with affordable cost.

articleTitle: Advancing Digital Health: Strategies for Implementation and Management
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: India’s healthcare system is undergoing rapid digital transformation, with innovations like the Scan and Share system under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Health Mission (ABDM) streamlining patient registration. This study examines the low adoption of the Scan and Share system in Karnataka’s government hospitals, identifying barriers such as limited training, connectivity issues, and low awareness of the Digital Health Incentive Scheme (DHIS). By combining quantitative and qualitative data from 40 hospitals, the study highlights key enablers including targeted training, improved communication, and enhanced DHIS awareness. Addressing these challenges can significantly improve operational efficiency, patient care, and overall system adoption, contributing to a more integrated digital healthcare system in India.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Assessing Collision Risk of Space Debris with Operational Satellites: Enhancing Safety and Mission Planning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The operational integrity of satellites is seriously threatened by space debris, as potential collisions might result in expensive damage and mission failures. The goal of this project is to create a predictive model that will evaluate the likelihood of space debris colliding with satellites in operation. The model will provide precise risk evaluations by using orbital characteristics and historical debris data, improving satellite safety and supporting mission planning. To forecast collision probability, the method includes gathering data, preprocessing it, creating features, and using machine learning algorithms. A detailed grasp of the mechanics of space debris and how it interacts with operational satellites is necessary for the development of. Large datasets will be processed and analyzed using advanced data analytics and machine learning techniques to find patterns and trends that affect the likelihood of collisions.

articleTitle: Virtual Voice Assistant (Jenny)
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In the contemporary technological landscape, artificial intelligence (AI) has catalyzed a transformative revolution, culminating in the emergence of virtual assistants such as Google Assistant, Bixby, Alexa, and Siri. This study centers on Jenny, a virtual voice assistant specifically designed for Windows operating systems. Jenny’s primary objective is to enhance accessibility for individuals with disabilities, particularly those who are unable to type or have visual impairments. Utilizing Python programming languages, Jenny facilitates a seamless user experience through voice commands, effectively mimicking human interaction. Its capabilities encompass the opening of applications, internet browsing, and control over multimedia functions, significantly augmenting the independence of users with disabilities. A notable feature of Jenny is its ability to comprehend and respond contextually through Natural Language Processing (NLP). NLP enables Jenny to interpret linguistic nuances, ensuring accurate and appropriate responses, thereby rendering it reliable for routine usage. Jenny stands as a pivotal advancement in virtual assistants, underscoring the paramount importance of accessibility and inclusivity. This research provides a comprehensive account of Jenny’s design, implementation, and impact, showcasing the transformative potential of AI in empowering users with disabilities.

articleTitle: Isolated Resonant Inverter (IRI) for Aerospace
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Aircraft avionics systems predominantly operate on a 115 V AC, 400 Hz power supply. To meet the varied power needs, standard DC buses such as 270V, 540V, and 28V are utilized as input sources. The conventional method of DC to AC inversion relies on a two-stage conversion process DC-DC for isolation and DC-AC for inversion leading to increased system complexity, size, and inefficiencies. Furthermore, most conventional topologies lack galvanic isolation and fail to achieve soft switching across the entire power conversion stage.This paper proposes a novel Isolated Resonant Inverter (IRI) Topology designed to overcome limitations in existing systems by achieving single-stage DC to AC conversion with inherent galvanic isolation and soft switching. The IRI topology eliminates the need for a separate DC-DC conversion stage, reducing component count and improving overall system efficiency. Additionally, the resonant nature of the topology ensures reduced electromagnetic interference (EMI) and switching losses, enabling more compact and reliable designs for aviation systems. This work presents the IRI topology as a proof of concept (POC) for future avionics applications.

articleTitle: Time Stamp to Provide Security to Autonomous Vehicle Using KNN Cluster Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper is about giving the security to the autonomous vehicle through Time stamp, autonomous vehicle has a semi automatic manual key, the key has one to ten numbers, once he inserts the key person gives the number from one to ten, this number triggers the algorithm present in the number pressed this can be k nearest numbers, using ML algorithm system identifies the K nearest number and the mathematical formula that calculates the password, then the password is displayed on user mobile phone and updated in the autonomous vehicle, for this complete set the amount of time required to get the password must be the distance between the key and the Autonomous Vehicle and the persons mobile. Here the test is the time stamp, if the password generated beyond the time stamp, the password created is not from the user of the autonomous vehicle.

articleTitle: Real-Time Elderly Fall Detection as Ambient Intelligence in Old Age Homes
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The rapid expansion of autonomous technologies, the rise of computer vision, and edge computing present exciting opportunities in healthcare monitoring systems. Fall prevention is especially important for the elderly because falls from this age group often result in fatalities and serious injuries. Fall detection devices that can quickly recognize falls and alert emergency services have become more and more popular as a result. The primary goal of the project is to increase elderly home safety by implementing an ambient intelligence-based automated emergency recognition system. We present a unique method for fall posture detection utilizing an intelligence surveillance camera and a class of efficient models called MobileNets for mobile and embedded vision applications. A real-time embedded solution persuaded from “edge AI” is implemented using the state-of-the-art Object detection: single shot detector (SSD) Mobile Net V2 and Internet of things embedded GPU platform NVIDIA’s Jetson Nano.

articleTitle: Hive Destruction Protocol: An Automated Defense System Utilizing YOLO Human Recognition and Real-Time GPS Tracking
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The Hive Destruction Protocol (HDP) introduces a cutting-edge automated border defense system that enhances security operations through advanced human recognition using YOLO, precise GPS tracking, and coordinated drone responses. Soldiers are equipped with camera-integrated spectacles that facilitate the rapid identification of enemy targets via visual cues and hand gestures. Upon confirming a target, the system transmits accurate GPS coordinates in real time to autonomous drones, which are deployed to neutralize threats from multiple angles, creating confusion and minimizing detection risk. To ensure reliability and real-time processing in dynamic environments, HDP employs optimized communication protocols for secure data exchange between ground personnel and drones, allowing for seamless coordination among multiple units, each capable of independently engaging identified threats based on shared GPS data. The integration of machine learning algorithms improves the system even more flexible to changing field conditions, improving detection accuracy and robustness under various environmental constraints. Overall, the Hive Destruction Protocol represents a forward-thinking solution for border defense, leveraging artificial intelligence and automation to provide proactive and responsive capabilities in critical security applications.

articleTitle: Data Science Based Bird Osteometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Osteometry is the study of bones of an animal. Osteometry is very useful to determine correlations and evolutionary traits in between vertebrates. Measurements of various bones is used to determine anatomical similarities between animal species. We used various ML techniques like clustering and regression to find out Osteometric Correlations between various bird species. For clustering, we used the K-means algorithm, and for Regression, we used an ANN model. The dataset used was ‘Osteometric Data of Avian Fauna of Armenia’. The descriptive analysis gave some interesting results too. We found out direct correlations between various bird bone dimensions across nearly all species. Various bird bone lengths were analysed, like Carpo Metacarpus and Femur bones, and their corresponding dimensions. Clustering using the K-means algorithm gave inferior results and bad clusters, thus the data was not inherently clustered. Using an ANN to predict bone dimensions resulted in a very high accuracy of 92.59%.

articleTitle: Securing the internet of things communication and data transmission by using Blockchain based Architecture
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Due to the rapid growth of technology usage of Internet of Things devices has revolutionized in multiple domains and areas, but still there are few challenges to address like security and performance issues. Most of the traditional approaches are not sufficient in solving those issues related to IoT ecosystems. This paper aims to present a block chain technology-based solution to the problems of security challenges and improvement in integrity, confidentiality, and availability for IoT systems. The features of Block chain in the sense of an immutable nature help secure the IoT system to share data with others, enhance authentication, and transparency. The integration of block chain with IoT devices can also ensure data provenance thus creating an environment for trust with users and stakeholders. To build this blockchain-based IoT system, the proposed architecture ensures a framework of not only ensuring the security of the IoT ecosystem but also sustainability. Future work will be based on designing prototypes and applications within real-world environments to validate the effectiveness of these proposed solutions in various IoT scenarios.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Prediction of Anxiety and Depression Symptoms using Demographic and Temporal Data
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The aim of the paper is to analyse the trends in anxiety and depression symptoms across different demographic groups in the United States during the COVID-19 pandemic. The data is collected between April 2020 and the subsequent months, based upon that, we examined the prevalence of depressive disorder symptoms and their fluctuations over time. For the implementation of the research work, we have applied 7 different deep learning models. By extending the use of other RNNs including LSTM networks, GRU offered an opportunity to capture temporal data for disease symptom related to mental health disease and provide accurate predictions relating to the trends of these symptoms in the future. Based on three architecture models, LSTM model gives the highest training accuracy and validation accuracy 86.39% and 82.67% respectively. However, the RNN model also performed very well and even slightly outperforming LSTM in both training and validation accuracies. The GRU model performs similarly to LSTM, with slightly lower validation accuracy (81.25%) and higher validation loss (0.438). The models also showed that younger age groups consistently had higher levels of reported symptoms of mental disorders. Additionally, predictions highlighted possible future periods of increased mental health challenges, signifying that continuing monitoring and practical interferences will be crucial in mitigating long-term mental health impacts.

articleTitle: Optical Character Recognition using YOLO4, Tesseract and Paddleocr for Text Extraction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The recent advancement Tesseract OCR engine and the YOLO4 (You Only Look Once version 4) object detection framework provide an innovative approach to optical character recognition (OCR) with a focus on table extraction. Because of their complicated layouts, traditional OCR algorithms frequently have difficulty accurately retrieving tabular data from photos. The suggested technique successfully extracts tables from photos by utilizing Tesseract for precise character recognition and YOLO4 for reliable object detection. Table borders, cell boundaries, and text sections inside tables are all recognized by the YOLO4 model after it has been trained. The textual information inside these areas is then identified using Tesseract. The suggested solution outperforms conventional OCR techniques in experimental results that show how well it extracts tables from photos with different layouts and levels of complexity.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Breast Cancer Recurrence using Machine Learning for Improved Patient Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Breast Cancer is most significant disease of death for women in the world, early identification is very essential. In order to enhance the precision and dependability of Breast Cancer recurrences diagnosis, this study investigates the application of several machine learning techniques, such as Support Vector Machine, Genetic techniques, and Voting Classifier. The prior goal of the proposed recurrence diagnosis model is to combine Voting Classifier with Genetic algorithm to overcome the challenges with machine learning algorithm prediction. The hybrid model (GA+VC) can improve performance through a collective decision-making process. Hyperparameters such as kernel functions for SVM are optimized to maximize model performance. In this paper, the study explores the Sand cat swarm optimization (SCSO) with SVM gives higher accuracy in recurrence diagnosis. The result obtained indicate that recurrence model gives higher accuracy of 90%. The results with the optimization SCSO with SVM providing insights into the trade-off between detecting true positives (malignant cases) and minimizing false positives.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic based Speed Control of Induction Motor using SVPWM Technique
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Induction motors are essential in numerous industries for producing rotational motion and force. In variable-speed drive applications, these motors must offer a wide range of speed control and rapid torque response, even when load conditions fluctuate. Using pulse width modulation (PWM) techniques, variable voltage and frequency can be produced. Of these, the most popular techniques are carrier based sinusoidal pulse width modulation and Space Vector PWM (SVPWM).SVPWM is a sophisticated and computationally demanding PWM approach that is frequently considered the greatest of all existing methods for variable frequency drives due to its superior performance. Its application has been growing rapidly in recent years. This research focuses on comparing the effectiveness of Sinusoidal PWM and SVPWM for regulating induction motor speed, especially with regard to lowering the motor current's total harmonic distortion (THD).Results indicate that SVPWM outperforms Sinusoidal PWM as a vector control method for induction motor speed regulation. The study further extends the work by integrating aFuzzy decision systemwith the SVPWM technique to enhance speed control and analyze the induction motor's performance. Additionally, THD variation is examined for both methods.

articleTitle: Enhancing Crop Yield: A Deep Learning Approach to Detect Tomato Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Agriculture represents a vital pillar of the global economy, with crop production significantly influenced by a broad variety of Phyto pathological conditions, particularly plant leaf-diseases. The early and accurate detection of these diseases are paramount, as they have a direct impact on crop yield, which consequently influences the economic viability and market profitability of agricultural outputs. However, many farmers and agricultural practitioners often lack the specialized knowledge required for precise diagnosis of leaf diseases, resulting in suboptimal crop production and economic losses. Consequently, the development of robust and efficient disease detection methodologies is imperative for the sustainability and success of agricultural practices. This research investigates the application including sophisticated deep learning algorithms like VGG19 and CNN, to identify and classify diseases in tomato plant leaves. The developed model attains an accuracy of 99.17%, surpassing both VGG19 and CNN, with the goal of enhancing crop management strategies and optimizing overall agricultural productivity.

articleTitle: Simulative Analysis of Electric Arc Behavior in Metal Welding with Matlab/Simulink
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The energy flow between the electrodes in arc welding procedures must be precisely and effectively dynamically controlled to achieve superior weld strength and quality, increased productivity, and reduced fume formation. This highlights the significance of analyzing the electrical properties of the arc used in the material joining process. Delivering steady current and voltage while maintaining exact control over arc characteristics and heat input is the main goal of arc welding power source design. Adaptability to different welding processes, feedback mechanisms for arc stability, and efficiency-enhancing technologies are important design features. Power supply configuration circuits can be designed and implemented in MATLAB simulation to analyze circuit behavior, optimize control algorithms, and validate performance before prototyping. This study simulates arc models based on MATLAB/Simulink to determine the arc’s voltage, current, magnetic waveforms, and V-I properties. The system’s architecture guarantees a suitable welding process without compromising the power source. The findings show that the magnetic energy produced by the arc and the variation in inductance during the arcing phase are unique and precise. The process is simulated using actual parameters to find the output values that match the real-time measurement acquired by the hardware setup.

articleTitle: MediScan AI: Brain Tumor Detection Using Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Identification of a brain tumor is a very critical task. Magnetic resonance imaging is a medical imagining test that create comprehensive images of almost every internal structure in human body. Early detection of brain tumour can save patient's life. Timely and correct diagnosis can significantly help to improve patient outcomes. Machine learning techniques such as ensembling techniques that use multiple model such as support vector machine, logistic regression, random forest together to improve the accuracy. In this study, we propose a web platform for the users which will help them to upload the MRI image and get the predicted output. The brain tumor detection allows the breakdown of tumor cells to identify the extent of tumor present in particular region and locate an abnormal cell mass on a slice of magnetic resonance imaging (MR).

articleTitle: Diagnose Kidney Cancers Using Machine Learning Classification Algorithm From Transcriptome Profiles of Patients
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Kidney cancer is the ninth most diagnosed kidney cancer in men and the fourth most common in women according to the world health organization Report. Worldwide, kidney cancer causes 144,000 accidental deaths and 338,000 fresh cases of the disease each year. It is very important to diagnose it in the early stage to save one life. So that they can get treatment at the early stage. It is very hard to diagnose manually from clinical data and images by the doctors in the medical field. The recent technologies like artificial intelligence using image processing will help them to diagnose it accurately.We have used TCGA Kidney Cancers Dataset, is a bulk RNA-seq dataset that contains transcriptome profiles of patients to identify kidney cancer. In this research we used MRMR and regression. In terms of accuracy, our results indicate that the regression model achieves 97% accuracy, this Machine learning algorithms to create a reliable and accurate diagnostic tool for diagnose the kidney cancer. The potential for improved clinical decision-making will be demonstrated by the combination of transcription profiles and machine learning approaches

articleTitle: Enhanced Brain Tumor Classification through an AI-Integrated Multi-Modal Imaging Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This study explores the presentation of cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) techniques aimed at the precise identification of gliomas, meningiomas, and pituitary tumors, utilizing comprehensive imaging data. By leveraging convolutional neural networks (CNNs) refined by advanced transfer learning methods, we have significantly enhanced diagnostic accuracy. The refined models achieved an impressive diagnostic accuracy of 95%, with sensitivity and specificity reaching 94% and 96%, respectively. These results demonstrate a marked improvement over conventional diagnostic techniques, illustrating the transformative impact of AI on neuro-oncological diagnostics and the optimization of treatment strategies, thereby advancing the field of precision medicine.

articleTitle: DemoCraft: Using In-Context Learning to Improve Code Generation in Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Producing executable code from natural-language directives via Large Language Models (LLMs) involves obstacles like semantic uncertainty and the requirement for task-focused context interpretation. To resolve these difficulties, we introduce DemoCraft, a framework that refines code generation through in-context learning and demonstration selection, in tandem with latent concept learning. Latent concept learning appends extra concept tokens, which act as trainable embeddings encapsulating task-oriented insights. We evaluate our approach on two promi- nent datasets: MBPP and Humaneval. Our experimental findings reveal that this method attains roughly a 2x boost in the pass@k metric compared to baseline models. Moreover, we propose two new evaluation measurements: correctness@k and similarity@k. Empirical analyses indicate that our system achieves nearly a 3x advancement in these measures as well.

articleTitle: Vegetable Leaf Disease Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: For maximum crop productivity, leaf disease classification and early identification are essential. Conventional methods for identifying illness need a lot of time and money. Promising results have been observed in the detection and classification of leaf diseases using Machine Learning (ML) approaches. This research presents a robust machine learning approach for the identification and classification of leaf diseases. A convolutional neural network (CNN) is used in the suggested method to categorize leaf diseases into various classifications. The suggested method's overall effectiveness is assessed using a leaf photo dataset that is available to the public. The results show that the suggested method achieves 98.92% accuracy. India is a developing nation where agriculture is important. Approximately 58% of rural India's livelihood is influenced by agricultural intervention. Tomatoes are one of the most common crops utilized to make agricultural products. To prevent a significant loss in tomato yield and quantity, it is imperative to identify and classify any illnesses that a tomato plant may have. These issues are addressed by the newest and most advanced technologies, like image processing, which use a range of techniques and algorithms. A particular type of disease initially affects the leaves of a tomato plant.

articleTitle: Synthesis of AMBA APB BUS Protocol
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The AMBA (Advanced Microcontroller Bus Architecture) standard, widely used in System-on-Chip (SoC) designs, enables efficient management of IP cores by providing a modular, scalable architecture that reduces redesign efforts and shortens integration time. Different versions of AMBA introduce various communication interfaces, such as APB (Advanced Peripheral Bus), ASB (Advanced System Bus), AHB (Advanced High-Performance Bus), AXI (Advanced eXtensible Interface), ACE (AXI coherency Extension), and CHI (Coherent Hub Interface). Detailed RTL (Register Transfer Level) schematics support design optimization, with Verilog HDL playing a key role in the process, guided by VLSI principles. A novel codebase was developed from scratch to synthesis the proposed architecture. The optimized performance is seen for Effort High Condition with Total Power optimization at 17% due optimization of Switching Power by 34%, Cell Area optimization by 7%.

articleTitle: Advancement in LED Technology: Semiconductor Fabrication, Optimal Driver Selection, and Novel Intensity Control Strategies Incorporating Darlington Pair
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This overview aims to provide a comprehensive insight into the manufacturing, design, and selection of LED drivers, highlighting the significance of LEDs in lighting technology. Compared to traditional light sources like incandescent, fluorescent, and optical fibers, LEDs excel in efficiency, versatility, durability, and color variety. However, their complex manufacturing and design process requires a deep understanding of components, semiconductor physics, and general sciences. This overview delves into the various stages of LED production, key parameters, and components involved in designing LEDs. Additionally, it explores LED drivers, a crucial part of LED systems, including their types based on operating modes and selection parameters for specific applications. The outcome of this overview is to equip beginners with a thorough understanding of LEDs, their manufacturing, design, and driver selection, complemented by an in-depth analysis of intensity regulation using Darlington pairs, including experimental, simulated, and theoretical perspectives.

articleTitle: Crop Disease Detection using Hybrid Model of CNN and Capsule Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Incorporation of DL techniques have greatly advanced in accuracy of prediction in various fields. In this research, our goal is to diagnose crop damage in fields by enabling farmers to identify the crop disease and take suitable actions. The proposed solution leverages hybrid model of CNN and CapsNets for image-based classification, accessible via a web interface, to facilitate this accurate crop disease prediction. After reviewing over 50 CNN articles, we identified that usage of Capsule Networks along with CNN enhances image classification acquiring better spatial relationships.

articleTitle: Green Energy for Smart Cities: A Review of Research Trends
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper presents a bibliometric analysis of research trends in the field of green energy for smart cities. Utilizing the Scopus database, 1558 research articles from 2010 to 2024 were analyzed, revealing a significant upward publication trend since 2015. Conference papers dominate the literature, indicating active engagement in academic forums. However, there is a clear need for more comprehensive literature such as books and review articles. Highly cited research papers, prolific authors, countries, journals, keywords, and organizations were identified, highlighting the global distribution of research efforts. India and China emerged as leaders in research output, emphasizing the importance of global collaboration for sustainable urban development. In summary, the present analysis offers significant perspectives to practitioners, academics, and policymakers regarding integrating green energy solutions into smart cities and promoting sustainable urban growth.

articleTitle: Soil Nutrient Prediction and Crop Recommendation System: Conventional to Modern Methods of Soil NPK Sensing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Agriculture plays a crucial role in strengthening a nation’s economy. Crop production largely depends on two key factors: soil fertility and moisture levels. Fertilizer usage is generally guided by the nutrient content present in the soil, which is typically analyzed in a laboratory. Accurate fertilizer recommendations require a thorough nutrient assessment of the soil, but the manual testing process is often time-consuming. As a result, many farmers repeatedly grow the same crops without conducting lab tests, which gradually diminishes soil fertility. To restore and maintain soil productivity, it is essential to determine the appropriate stages of nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), and potassium (K) required. Additionally, monitoring the soil’s pH value is crucial since the concentration of hydrogen ions (H+) helps decide the ideal amount of fertilizer for optimal crop growth. Ensuring the right balance of nutrients not only improves soil quality but also enhances crop yield and product quality. This project introduces a color sensor paired with fiber optics to measure the NPK levels in soil, while a pH sensor is employed to monitor acidity or alkalinity. The NPK sensor operates on the principle of color absorption from the soil solution, providing reliable insights into nutrient content.

articleTitle: Enhanced Super-Resolution with EDSR: Optimizing Image Quality across Multiple Scaling Factors
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In today’s world where high resolution visual content is preferred in domains like medical imaging, satellite imagery, and digital entertainment, effective image super resolution is crucial for success. This paper focuses on not just upscaling the resolution but restoring the lost details to improve the overall quality of images. The enhanced deep residual network (EDSR) is utilized to significantly improve image resolution and reduce blurring and outperforming traditional methods. While EDSR does not eliminate all forms of quality degradation, it effectively improves image sharpness, clarity and balancing computational efficiency with enhanced detail construction. The model’s performance is elevated using traditional metrics like PSNR and SSIM to quantify the quality enhancement. In the end comparisons are drawn across the scaling factors of 2x, 3x and 4x to show the models ability to perform across various domains. Here, the approach was evaluated across various scaling factors of 2x, 3x, and 4x showing consistent improvement in image clarity, sharpness and structural integrity and surpassing traditional interpolation methods.

articleTitle: Data Analytics on Blitz E-sports: Enhancing Gaming Experience through Personalization and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper delves into the comprehensive data analytics of Blitz E-sports, a dynamic gaming cafe, to enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. The study focuses on three pivotal objectives: revenue optimization, game recommendations, and churn prediction. Through meticulous analysis of customer data, gaming trends, and operational metrics, this proposal equips Blitz E-sports with action able insights to enhance profitability, customer engagement, and long-term sustainability. The potential of data-driven decision-making in the competitive e-sports industry is demonstrated by leveraging advanced machine learning techniques and big data technologies. This paper aims to reveal significant improvements in personalized user experiences, optimized revenue strategies, and effective customer retention measures.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Autonomous Line-Following Minidrone Using Image Processing and PID Control
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive approach to controlling a Parrot Mambo minidrone in a simulation environment using MATLAB. The primary objective is to guide the drone along a predefined path while maintaining stability and precision. Optical flow technique and Inertial Measurement Unit sensor data are used for real-time position and velocity estimation. Path planning algorithms, coupled with control strategies such as Kalman filtering and dynamic error correction, ensure the drone follows the optimal path to reach its target. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed system in successfully navigating the drone through complex maneuvers with minimal drift.

articleTitle: Predicting Digital Payment Platforms Adoption by Retail Vendors Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The goal of this study is to use machine learning techniques to anticipate retail vendors' adoption of digital payment platforms. Data was collected from 270 merchants throughout 10 major retail markets in Bangalore, with a focus on small and medium-sized businesses. Using multiple regression, exploratory factor analysis, and support vector machines (SVM), the study identifies significant factors driving adoption, including perceived usefulness, social influence, and compatibility. The data show that, while perceived usefulness and social influence are important drivers, other factors such as perceived ease of use and technical support have limited effect. The SVM model was moderately accurate in predicting platform adoption. The report also evaluates customer satisfaction across various digital payment platforms and predicts future trends using ARIMA models. These findings have significant implications for improving digital payment adoption tactics among retailers.

articleTitle: Smart Oral Health Monitor
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Oral health is vital to overall well-being but is often overlooked due to inefficient monitoring tools and delayed diagnosis. This project presents a smart handheld device featuring a miniaturized camera for detecting oral issues like plaque, cavities, teeth discoloration and gum diseases in real-time. Using image processing and deep learning algorithms, the device provides precise feedback and actionable insights. Paired with a mobile application offering detailed analysis and recommendations, it empowers users to adopt proactive oral hygiene practices to prevent teeth disorder.

articleTitle: Real-Time Global Parcel Tracking System in the Supply Chain Using RFID and GPS
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper presents an in-depth exploration of a Real-Time Global Parcel Tracking System in the Supply Chain Using RFID and GPS, designed to revolutionize logistics and parcel management. By integrating RFID technology for automated identification, GPS for precise real-time tracking, and data analytics for intelligent routing, the system addresses inefficiencies in traditional supply chain operations. A comprehensive review of literature on RFID-based tracking, GPS integration, clustering techniques, and IoT applications in logistics is presented, highlighting their capabilities, limitations, and future potential. As part of the project’s initial implementation, a prototype was developed using an Arduino-based RFID system that links unique order IDs to RFID tags. This low-cost and scalable solution demonstrates how emerging technologies can be harnessed to automate parcel identification and streamline tracking processes. The study underscores the transformative potential of such a system to reduce delays, enhance resource optimization, and provide unparalleled real-time visibility, setting the stage for a further efficient and reliable global supply chain.

articleTitle: 5G Channel Estimation for downlink SISO channels using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Channel estimation involves identifying the characteristics of a communication channel, specifically its impulse or frequency response. This information is essential for the receiver to reduce the channel's impact and accurately interpret the transmitted signals. This research presents a deep learning approach developed for channel estimation in a 5G SISO network. The Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) is used as a performance measure to evaluate the effectiveness of the implemented regression model. The outcomes are then contrasted with those from pilot-based linear channel estimation and perfect estimation methods. The findings reveal that the neural network model produces a lower RMSE value (0.022), showcasing its enhanced performance compared to the alternative methods in channel estimation.

articleTitle: Smart Attendance By Using Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Maintaining attendance by hand in contemporary classrooms is a laborious activity that is prone to errors and mistakes. To make this process easier to comply with, we suggest a Face Recognition Based Attendance Management System (FRAMS) which makes use of modern facial recognition technology to eliminate the need for manual attendance. This system utilizes computer vision technology where face detection and recognition take place using real time python open cv software while mingling through a comfortable user interface designed by Tkinter. Haar Cascade classifiers are incorporated for face detection while the facial recognition aspect is conducted through an efficient algorithm referred to as Local Binary Patterns Histograms (LBPH) that is resistant to changes in lighting, facial emotions and facial poses.FRAMS works by taking students pictures using a webcam and a dataset is generated from these pictures. This dataset is then used to prepare the face recognition model. During attendance sessions, live faces are compared against the stored database within the system to recognize and verify users. When the system is capable to identify a person, it automatically registers the person’s state using the online spreadsheet which further provides attendance records in a precise manner. The aided system is efficient as it removes the need for attendants roll call, thereby minimizing errors and curtailing proxy attendance.More so, the system was subjected to extensive testing when in use in various situations and its recognition accuracy rate was high in controlled conditions. There were, however, some problems like the differences in lighting and the chances of wrongful identification in the middle of busy pictures. Even so, in light of these challenges, FRAMS is an improvement over the attendee sheets that yesteryear utilized because it’s faster and more dependable. For works in progression, it may be possible to enhance the recognition algorithms to cope with increasing the size of datasets and the difficulty of the surroundings.

articleTitle: Advancing Drug Discovery through a Deep Learning-Based Protein-Ligand Interaction Prediction Tool
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning has emerged as a promising approach to advance drug discovery by accurately predicting interactions between proteins and small molecules, or ligands. The identification of these interactions is essential in developing drugs, as it informs us about a molecule's potential therapeutic efficacy. Traditional methods, like molecular docking, often struggle with accuracy and computational efficiency, limiting their application in high-throughput settings. In this paper, we propose a novel deep learning-based tool designed to predict protein-ligand interactions with enhanced precision and scalability. Our model leverages convolutional and graph neural networks to capture the complex, three-dimensional nature of these interactions. Using a large, curated dataset, we train and test the model to optimize binding affinity prediction, employing metrics such as mean squared error and accuracy to validate performance. The results show that our approach outperforms conventional techniques and recent machine learning models, demonstrating a significant improvement in predictive reliability. This tool has potential applications in screening vast compound libraries in early-stage drug discovery, reducing time and costs associated with experimental trials. By providing more accurate insights into protein-ligand affinities, our method represents a step forward in computational drug design, with implications for developing targeted therapies across various disease areas.

articleTitle: Sentiment Detection in Financial News: A Deep learning Approach to Extreme and Moderate Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Today’s financial industries need precise, directed news analysis with sentiment identification more than ever in order to forecast possible future moves. This research focuses on developing a robust system for sentiment detection in financial news using a deep learning approach, enabling both extreme and moderate. The data collection has been ensured through the use of web scraping to gather data from multiple reliable financial news sources. To reliably forecast the attitudes encoded in the news items, this dataset has been processed using state-of-the-art deep learning algorithms. The latest technologies in deep learning have been employed, and a comparative analysis of different models has been conducted to identify the most effective one of this specific task. Providing an easy-to-use interface that allows users to obtain news from many sources and their corresponding sentiment analysis is the main goal of this research. With the help of this technology, stakeholders should be able to make well-informed decisions by using the sentiment trends found in financial news. By providing the effectiveness of deep learning models in sentiment identification, the system not only improves user experience by offering sentiment-based news insights but also advances the field of financial news analysis. The deep learning model that was constructed has demonstrated encouraging results in reliably classifying attitudes through extensive testing and evaluations, indicating that it has the potential to be an instrumental tool for financial analysis. For future research in the fields of sentiment identification and financial forecasting, this study establishes a precedent and emphasis the significance of incorporating cutting-edge technologies into news analysis.

articleTitle: AyurVedaMitra
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The wide acceptance the ayurveda or say ayurvedic medicine during pandemic was observed in comparison with allopathy medicine. It also known that most of the ayurvedic medicine are plant based. In recent years, the integration of traditional medical systems like Ayurveda with modern technologies such as machine learning has opened up new avenues for personalized healthcare solutions. This work proposes, an innovative mobile application that leverages machine-learning algorithms in which Ayurvedic plants are recommended based on specific symptoms/disease provided by the user. The work has been title as AyurvedaMitra, that basically represents a significant step towards bridging the gap between ancient medicinal knowledge and contemporary healthcare practices. By harnessing the extensive database of Ayurvedic medicine and applying advanced data analytics, AyurvedaMitra offers evidence-based recommendations tailored to individual health needs. In this work the methodology, implementation, and potential impact of AyurvedaMitra in enhancing access to Ayurvedic remedies and promoting integrative healthcare is discussed.

articleTitle: Next-Gen Dermatology: Revolutionizing Dermatological Diagnostics with AI and Emergency Care Solutions
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Skin health conditions should be diagnosed and treated on time so as to prevent complications and promote better health results. This paper presents an AI-based system that makes use of Convolutional Neural Networks with the InceptionV3 Architecture for predicting skin diseases at higher levels. The model, which is based on the large DermaNet dataset, classifies skin disorders fast and effectively. The system is coupled with a simple Telegram based application for the users to get a complete solution. A user can upload a photo of the affected skin area and get a diagnosis within seconds, an explanation of the disease and how severe it is in percentage. The bot also has a location and contact sharing feature that assists users in finding nearby doctors and clinics that can provide further assistance. It further provides on the spot appropriate cures for the particular condition diagnosed. Moreover, this makes it possible for the customer to fill the healthcare void in particular the neglected ones by making it easy for them to access real time high quality services. By equipping users with relevant information and appropriate actions required at the right time, this project has showcased how AI has the ability to transform the dermatological field.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Innovations in Casting Defect Identification: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper abstract describes how defect classification models that help track the variety of casting defects were applied and reduced various problems. The distribution of metrics precision, recall, and F1 for each defect class (Misruns, Cold Shuts, Hot Tears they see values close to or higher than 95%—98%), suggesting the model performed quite well at detecting and distinguishing these defects. The support scores indicate how many times each defect occurred within the dataset, so it gives a bit more detail about what is being learned. The accuracy of the model, when it comes to classifying casting defects is about 99% (in terms of overall) while its general image classification capability was on full display with an impressive 90.06% achieved over 12,302 images. Macro, weighted, and micro average metrics are chosen to present the performance across all defect classes for an overall function of model performance. The macro average observations that hover around 97% for accuracy, recall, and F1 score are indicative of the consistent performance across different defect types. Moreover, the weighted average metrics highlight excellent performance even under class imbalance. Micro average metrics additionally ensure the accuracy, recall, and F1-score of an overall model as a defect classifier. In conclusion, the research abstract emphasizes industrial quality control applications for this type of model and justifies why casting defects can be correctly detected/reclassified successfully.

articleTitle: Automail AI: Intelligent Voice-Controlled Email Generator
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The complexity of contemporary communication further emphasizes the need to automate monotonous work to increase efficiency and effectiveness. This paper introduces a new advance, voice-controlled Automail AI, in the form of an email generation tool that automatically sends an email according to end-user-specified keywords. Automail AI utilizes NLP, ML, and Speech Recognition to differentiate formal emails from informal ones and draft appropriate responses as the situation demands. It has been tuned with Naive Bayes Classifier that yields a better level of accuracy as compared to models such as Decision Tree, SVM, and Logistic Regression. Setting the benchmark for Automated Communication tools, Automail AI combines diverse technologies like SMTP to guarantee secure Email delivery, Google Text-to-Speech or GTTS for auditory feedback, and a module providing an interface for speech recognition that offers the possibility to use the tool with no hands.

articleTitle: Leveraging Computer Vision to create an Intelligent Threat Detection System for Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Visual impairment affects over 2.2 billion people worldwide, making it difficult to perceive environmental hazards and navigate safely. While traditional assistive technologies like canes and guide dogs are helpful, they struggle to detect distant or complex threats. To address this, we aim to develop an Intelligent Threat Detection System through Computer Vision. This research project employs a wearable camera to record the user’s environment in real-time. The captured video is then processed by a sophisticated Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trained to identify potential threats from a large dataset. The model extracts relevant features and classifies threats, generating an auditory alert and verbal guidance. The system achieved an average precision of 92% in threat detection, and user studies with 20 blind participants showed a significant reduction in collision incidents with improved user confidence compared to traditional assistive aids. Participants who navigated through controlled environments equipped with our threat detection system showed a significant reduction in collision incidents and improved user confidence compared to traditional assistive aids alone. Qualitative feedback highlighted the system’s ease of use and sense of enhanced safety.

articleTitle: Smart ANPR: A Checkpoint-Based Toll and Parking Management System Using Hybrid OCR and Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Automated Number Plate Recognition is one of the most important applications of computer vision, employed in the enforcement of traffic law, vehicular management, security, and even at toll collection. This paper proposed an advanced system for ANPR that can move away from the traditional booth and establish a checkpoint. The strategically located cameras with checkpointing will automatically capture the plates of passing vehicles, permitting road tax and parking fees to be deducted without making contact. A hybrid approach that combines the capabilities of OpenCV, Tesseract OCR, and deep-learningbased OCR models helps tackle such challenges as stable images from live video feeds and highly accurate text recognition. To this end, since the system integrates high-resolution frame stabilization using OpenCV to ensure crystal clear captures, it further employs the use of YOLOv8 to boost the precision of real-time detection. The blockchain technology is further implemented to ensure that transactions are tamper proof, therefore ensuring secure and transparent billing systems. This makes the ANPR solution deployable on edge devices, which opens real-time processing capabilities for high-speed and high-volume environments, thereby offering a scalable and efficient approach for intelligent transportation and smart city applications.

articleTitle: The Deepfake Dilemma: Enhancing Deepfake Detection with Vision Transformers
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The emergence of deepfake videos at an alarming pace has compromised the integrity of digital multimedia and mandates progressive research into detection strategies. A new forensic method for subjecting face tampering detection in videos using the FaceForensics++ dataset is introduced in this work. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based architecture is enhanced with Vision Transformer encoders for identifying facial manipulations introduced at microscopic precision. The hybrid model integrates CNNs and ViTs, allowing for the capturing of both local and global features that help in detecting subtle manipulations. ViTs have a built-in self-attention mechanism, which allows the model to concentrate on essential facial characteristics, thereby enhancing precision even if the manipulations are confirmed in less than optimal situations. Additionally, the pre-trained Gemini 1.5 Pro model is fine-tuned for optimal performance. The classification of faces into authentic or fake is accurately done using the key points by 90%accuracy as shown through experimentation. Moreover, the Haar cascade method is used for human face detection technique as part of integrated design which augments its complete application in real-world functionalities.

articleTitle: In-Home Healthcare Station Using Raspberry Pi Pico
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In recent years, the fusion of sensor technology with embedded systems has proven its worth in the domain of personalized healthcare. The purpose of the In-home healthcare system lies in its continuous monitoring of the vital signs of a person and the environmental conditions of the surroundings as well, thereby ensuring the early detection of health issues. This results in swift preventive measures to be undertaken. The proposed system is the integration of multiple sensors namely- The pulse sensor for monitoring the BPM (Beats per minute), DHT11 for room temperature, DS18B20 for body temperature, and MQ135 for air quality on Raspberry Pi Pico. The data from the sensors is continuously monitored and analyzed, detects anomalies, and generates alarms for the same. The sensor data collected is continuously displayed on the OLED for easy monitoring. The system’s compact and portable design enables efficient functionality while minimizing space requirements, offering a novel approach to space-constrained applications.

articleTitle: Prognostic Evaluation of Liver Tumors through Computed Tomography Imaging
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Liver tumors present a significant challenge in the realm of public health, requiring early identification and precise prognostication to enhance patient outcomes. The current investigation delves into the utilization of machine learning methodologies to improve the accuracy of liver tumor prediction. A holistic approach is recommended, involving the gathering of medical imaging data such as CT scans and MRI images from a diverse cohort of patients. These images are subjected to preprocessing steps to extract relevant features, establishing a resilient dataset for further analysis. The results of the study showcase the effectiveness of machine learning algorithms in precisely forecasting the presence of liver tumors. The developed predictive models demonstrate elevated levels of sensitivity and specificity, emphasizing their potential as valuable resources for early detection and treatment strategizing. This research emphasizes the potential of machine learning in the realm of medical imaging, illuminating its ability to improve clinical decision-making processes and patient care.

articleTitle: A Novel Generative AI-Powered Approach for Sentiment Analysis: Enhancing Deep Learning Models with Contextual Understanding
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Sentiment analysis, a pivotal aspect of natural language processing (NLP), has seen notable advancements with the advent of deep learning models. Despite these advancements, challenges persist in accurately capturing nuanced emotions and understanding context-dependent sentiments. This paper introduces an innovative method that integrates generative adversarial networks (GANs) into deep learning architectures to enhance sentiment analysis. By leveraging GAN’s ability to generate contextually relevant text, the proposed approach enriches the training data, thereby improving the model's ability to discern subtle sentiment variations. Our extensive experiments on benchmark datasets reveal that our method surpasses traditional deep learning models, achieving a 5% improvement in accuracy, a 7% higher F1-score, and demonstrating superior robustness to sarcasm and irony.

articleTitle: CCTV Surveillance-Based Vehicle Identification: Query-Driven Search Using Colour, Manufacturer & License Plate
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The paper addresses the challenges of vehicle detection and identification in road safety and surveillance, especially in hit-and-run incidents and vehicle theft cases. The solution combines computer vision with YOLO models for real-time vehicle detection, colour classification, and a custom CNN for accurate vehicle type classification. YOLO is also used for license plate recognition, paired with Tesseract OCR to extract alphanumeric details for precise identification. The colour identification process is two-fold: YOLO detects vehicles in video frames and isolates their bounding boxes, which are then processed through a YOLO-based classifier trained on the VCoR dataset with 15 vehicle colour labels. Trained over 25 epochs, the model achieved 85.6% top-1 accuracy and 99.5%top-5 accuracy, proving reliable across diverse lighting, weather, and traffic conditions. This system automates vehicle detection and identification, reducing the time and manual effort needed to review large video datasets. Integrating vehicle type classification, colour recognition, and license plate identification, it provides a scalable and efficient tool for law enforcement and surveil- lance, enabling rapid suspect vehicle identification in complex traffic environments. The solution enhances traffic monitoring and security, delivering high accuracy in real-world scenarios. Scalable across urban areas, highways, toll booths, and smart city infrastructure, it offers a versatile approach to modern traffic surveillance.

articleTitle: Enhancing Comprehension with LLM, TTS, and RAG: Transcription of Text into Podcasts and Chatbots
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The rapid growth of Large Lan-guage Models, Text- to-Speech technologies, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation is bringing a new mode of accessing and understanding textual information. This work talks about how these technologies can be coordinated so that texts are converted into conversational podcasts and chatbots. This makes information accessible and interesting to interact with. The system is based on using Llama3.2:3b for generating script, Suno/Bark TTS model for audio synthesis as close to reality, and a RAG-based chatbot for contextual interaction. with users. User studies present considerable changes in understanding and participation, meaning that these machines are going to flip the learning settings. Index Terms—Large Language Models (LLM), Text-to-Speech (TTS), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Document-to- Podcast, Chatbot Interaction, Comprehension Enhancement

articleTitle: Cook Smart-An Intelligent Recipe Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Cook Smart platform offers highly sophisticated personalized diet recommendations powered with the help of individualized nutrition profiles for optimal digestion based on dietary preferences, restrictions or medical conditions. Once the user provides information in terms of weight, height, dietary restrictions and if you are diabetic or hypertensive then CookSmart uses NLP for all this detail to happen also integrate machine learning models, after which our target to calculate a set value that must be used later, whether it predicts your calorie intake. According to the information it displays some custommade recipe suggestions and diet plan which relate with a particular health goal such as weight loss or gain, fitness enhancement in addition to prohibition into certain kind of food stuffs. Html/Css was used to build a simple UI interface when designing the front end of this platform, while in addition Python and Flask based backends that are responsible for data control — processing with backend business logic.This architecture renders a user experience dynamic in nature that is engine-responsive to be fast and lightweight as it maintains communication with congregated server frontend UI back-end CRUD operations. An interactive, real-time engaging chatbot in the app offers customized meal options and answers nutritional queries. In addition to suggesting meals, CookSmartiap also encourages New Users Save your FavoriteRecipes and Record your Eating History as you set up YOUR individual nutrition goals. In this paper, we describe the design and architecture of CookSmart that enables personalized meal recommendations with nutritional constraints. There is also room for the platform to scale with more complex AI models and an expanded recipe library geared towards individual nutritional requirements as personal nutrition needs gain in popularity in a health-conscious world.

articleTitle: Kinematics of Doosan Cobot-A0509
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Cobots are becoming more popular in the industries, especially for machine tending, assembly, inspection and other operations alongside a human operator. The Cobot in discussion here is Doosan A0509. When one purchases such Cobots, although he gets all the necessary tools for its operation, still one has to know how the information on the teach pendant is according to the kinematics that we read from text books. The Doosan family of Cobots use ZYZ Euler angle notation for representing the orientation of the end-effecter. How to interpret it from the information given in the teach pendant? More than that, during task space operations, the desired rotations of the end-effecter and the orientation of the end-effecter are both shown by Rx, Ry and Rz on the Cobot teach pendant. In that case does it represent the amount of rotation the user wants or the orientation of the end-effecter? Similarly, for the A0509 Cobot, one may fix frames and determine DH parameters and the forward kinematics model. But the forward kinematics results that he gets by coding may not be the same as shown in the teach pendant. Now how to get the same forward kinematics model as implemented in the Cobot software given to the user? In this article, all the above-mentioned issues are addressed with elaborate testing on the Cobot. This bridges the gap between what we learn about robot kinematics and the actual Cobot.

articleTitle: Implementation of Radar-Camera fusion for Efficient Object Detection and Distance Estimation in Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Autonomous vehicles depends on various sensors to accurately perceive their surroundings, ensuring safe and efficient navigation. These sensors include radar, lidar, cameras, and ultrasonic sensors, each offering unique strengths. Radar provides precise distance and velocity measurements in diverse conditions, while cameras offer detailed visual information for object recognition. State-of-the-art perception systems increasingly utilize sensor fusion to combine these strengths, addressing the limitations of individual sensors and enhancing overall vehicle perception capabilities. Challenges in radar-camera fusion include misalignment of sensor data due to differing spatial resolutions and difficulties in effectively integrating radar's sparse data with dense image data. Existing models like CDMC and RODNet struggle with limited precision or recall due to suboptimal fusion strategies. This work employs the Radar Multiple-perspectives Convolutional Neural Network (RAMP-CNN) architecture, which leverages the radar and camera data fusion through Conventional Neural Network (CNN) to improve perception. Radar data preprocessing involves steps like 3D Fast Fourier Transform, while image preprocessing includes gamma correction and noise reduction. The fusion process combines 2D image proposals with radar data, significantly enhancing object detection and distance estimation accuracy. Simulation results demonstrate the efficacy of this fusion approach. Performance metrics such as Precision, Recall, F1-Score, Mean Squared Error (MSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), R2 Score, and Mean Intersection over Union (Mean IoU) highlight the model's effectiveness. While precision is high, recall indicates room for improvement. Low error metrics suggest accurate distance estimations, and the R2 score confirms the model's strong explanatory power. This fusion method represents a significant advancement in autonomous vehicle perception by increasing Average Recall (AR) by 3% and Average Precision (AP) by 16% enabling more reliable and accurate navigation in complex environments.

articleTitle: An integrated approach to detect online financial transaction fraud using negative and clonal selection algorithms with AIS
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The relevancy of fraud detection in account takeover fraud in online financial transactions is at it’s peak. The traditional fraud detection approaches have seen a downwards trend. This paper adds more onto the utilization of Biological Immune System to level an AI-based Immune system for detecting frauds and the emerging patterns within it’s domain. By implementing various machine learning algorithms such as negative and clonal selection the proposed system can accurately identify previously unknown fraud patterns and various attack strategies used by the unauthorized users and hackers. The integration of this approach seems promising in improving the security and enhancing the dependability of the transactions, hence, safeguarding people from account takeover fraud.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics for Energy Demand and Renewable Resource Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: India’s rapid urbanization is driving energy demand to new heights, increasing dependence on nonrenewable resources and creating critical sustainability challenges for urban areas. This paper presents an integrated approach that combines ARIMA (Auto-Regressive Integrated Moving Average) modeling for accurate energy demand forecasting with Generative AI to offer practical recommendations for optimizing renewable energy usage. By utilizing Python for data processing and interactive visualization, the model enables stakeholders to explore consumption patterns, assess renewable contributions, and identify strategic opportunities for improvement. Initial results indicate a 15% gain in forecast accuracy and a 10% boost in renewable energy utilization. This combination of predictive modeling and AI-driven insights not only supports more precise energy management but also provides a flexible, data-driven framework that cities can use to balance energy needs with sustainability goals. Ultimately, this approach empowers urban areas to move closer to achieving sustainable development targets while managing resources effectively.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning based Analysis of Chest X-rays for Accurate Lung Disease Detection and Interpretation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This is a research paper based on a transfer learning approach with a primary aim at the analysis of chest Xrays for accurate detection and interpretation of lung diseases. The proposed method relies heavily on the use of pretrained deep learning models to enhance diagnostic accuracy and reduce the time and computational resources taken during training. Applying transfer learning to a large chest X-ray dataset, the model successfully detects key patterns associated with common lung diseases, such as pneumonia and tuberculosis. The manuscript encompasses data preprocessing, model finetuning, and performance evaluation and demonstrates huge improvements over the traditional methods both in terms of accuracy and interpretability. It has been experimentally proven that the model is competent enough to provide localization of disease areas, as it can be visualized through heatmaps obtained from predictions, which might further help the radiologists perform their diagnosis tasks. This work advocates for medical imaging automation for the early and efficient detection of lung disease.

articleTitle: Neural Contextual Adaptation (NCA): For Unsupervised Learning in Dynamic Environments
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) has made significant strides in various domains, primarily driven by supervised learning techniques requiring vast amounts of labeled data. However, real-world applications, particularly those involving rapidly changing environments, demand models capable of autonomous adaptation without the need for extensive labeled datasets. In this paper, we present a novel framework for unsupervised learning that allows AI models to dynamically adapt in real-time to changing environments. Our approach leverages a combination of self-organizing maps and contrastive predictive coding to enhance model flexibility and adaptability across diverse settings. We introduce an architecture that incorporates temporal data processing and on-the-fly adaptation mechanisms, enabling the model to learn and generalize from evolving data distributions. Through extensive practical assessments and experimentation, we demonstrate our model’s ability to outperform existing unsupervised approaches in real-time object detection and decision-making scenarios. The results, which show a significant reduction in model retraining time and increased adaptability to novel environments, suggest that our framework can be applied to various fields including robotics, autonomous vehicles, and dynamic control systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of Technological Journey of the Film Industry and Regression Modeling for Predicting Box Office Collection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In this paper we have analyzed the important technology evolutions that have significantly impacted the film industry. Pre-production of films to post-production, each stage of filmmaking has been greatly enhanced by technological advancements. The journey from silent era and black-and-white pictures to high-defination films has allowed filmmakers to immerse audiences in their stories. This study explores how these innovations have not only reduced the need for extensive human labor but also improved the overall quality of films. Furthermore, the analysis will demonstrate how these advancements have transformed the audience’s viewing experience, shaping modern cinema and its future directions. Additionally, the paper will explore the potential innovations that can further bring the revolution in the industry in coming years. Further we have explore this technological evolution with a specific focus on VFX and the formats in which movie was released, by employing linear regression model to predict the box office collection based on these.

articleTitle: Investigations of PAPR reduction methods in FBMC System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The primary concern of the 5G radio network has sparked interest in the development of new waveforms beyond 4G (5th generation networks). Filter Bank Multicarrier (FBMC) waveforms have recently been suggested as the desired one for 5G networks. It has both advantages and disadvantages. One of the biggest drawback of the FBMC broadcast signal is its high Peak to Average Power Ratio (PAPR). It has been widely used in wireless communication to achieve high speed and data rates. A high PAPR system results in substantial distortion of the signal because of the nonlinear power amplifier. Therefore, methods that effectively reduce PAPR are necessary for the realization of the FBMC system. The FBMC system uses the some common techniques as the OFDM system. Comparative analysis of various approaches such as PTS, SLM, Companding, etc are performed by considering their simulation outcomes when it comes to effective spectrum utilization, improved PAPR, along with minimum complexity.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs): Types, Structural Components, Communication Systems, and Operating Platforms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), commonly known as drones, have experienced rapid growth and widespread adoption across military and civilian applications in recent years.
