This paper offers a comprehensive survey of UAV technologies, focusing on their classifications, structural components, communication systems, and operating platforms. UAVs are categorized based on size, range, and altitude capabilities. Key structural elements such as frames, propulsion systems, sensors, and control mechanisms are examined. The paper also addresses communication requirements, architectures, protocols, and associated challenges. Furthermore, it reviews real time operating systems utilized in UAVs, high-lighting their design considerations. The survey concludes by identifying emerging trends and future research directions in UAV development, providing valuable insights for both newcomers and seasoned researchers in the field.

articleTitle: Using Attention Layers to Accurately Detect Malicious Traffic for Internet of Things Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The networks of the Internet of Things are subject to fraudulent traffic now that day by day, the devices deployed are on the rise. We put forward in this paper an attention-enhanced neural network architecture-based real-time harmful traffic categorization system for IoT networks. Our approach benefits the efficiency and accuracy of classifying normal versus anomalous traffic through the integration of both the attention and management layers. In testing our model on a reference dataset, our extensive testing yields excellent results-there is a very high Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 99.8% and accuracy at 99.5%. The system reduces false alarms but produces increased detection rates, thus showing good generalizing ability in most traffic patterns. Although real-time anomaly identification is the requirement for protection of a large-scale IoT ecosystem, the modest computing cost of this solution does open up promising avenues for the improvement of IoT network security.

articleTitle: Efficient Pothole Detection in Video Sequences Using YOLOv4 with Cosine Similarity: A Road Safety Solution
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: A novel approach for the detection and counting of potholes in road surfaces using video sequences is proposed in this paper. Potholes are a significant road hazard that can lead to accidents and damage to vehicles. Accurate and efficient detection and counting of potholes are crucial for road maintenance and safety. State-of-the-art deep learning methods, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Single Shot MultiBox Detector (SSD), You Only Look Once version 4 (YOLOv4), and YOLOv4-tiny are used for pothole detection in video sequences. Additionally, a counting method based on cosine similarity and tracker to estimate the total number of potholes is proposed. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods. These results highlight that YOLOv4 is better in accurate detection of potholes in video sequences. Moreover, the proposed counting method based on cosine similarity achieves the best standard error rate, indicating its capability to estimate the number of potholes with reasonable accuracy. This research provides a valuable contribution to the field of road maintenance and safety by offering an efficient solution for pothole detection and counting, which can aid authorities in timely road repairs and enhance road users' safety.

articleTitle: A Study on Hardware-based Implementation of Homomorphic Encryption
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Homomorphic encryption is an innovative cryptographic mechanism that allows performing cryptographic operations even on encoded data without intermediate decoding. As a result, sensitive information cannot be compromised in case of dealing with outsourcing services. This article firstly provides the general background of HE and most notably discusses the types of HE such as partial homomorphic encryption, somewhat homomorphic encryption, and fully homomorphic encryption Each of these types has its advantages on drawbacks depending on the type of operations and the level of computation efficiency. The paper also considers research undertaken recently oriented towards increasing the feasibility of HE by all means, especially the lowering of the costs in computation. A comparative analysis matrix contains distinctive features of various approaches in HE and defines their complexity, security, and usability concerns. This and further surveys present the HE history and its above- and below-the-line progress and suggest paths for HE-morphed developmental works for applications such as cloud computing and machine learning that are inherently privacy-preserving.

articleTitle: Face Recognition using MTCNN, Inception - Resnet with Ensemble Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: One of the critical task included in the computer vision in face recognition. Security system, surveillance system, computer-human interactions are some of the applications where face recognition has been widely used. This paper proposes an novel face recognition model that inculcates deep learning and feature extraction techniques. Our model, named "Inception-Resnet" is built to efficiently and accurately recognize faces from images. Inception-Resnet employs a deep convolutional neural network and it also employs a deep CNN architecture that includes multiple layers of convolutional and pooling operations for robust feature extraction. The network is trained using a large-scale dataset consisting of labelled face images, that allows it to learn differential facial features. Additionally, Inception-resnet utilizes a loss function during training phase to encourage the network to learn compact and separable face embeddings in the feature space. Face verification is conducted using an ensemble approach which combines multiple classifiers, including Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), and logistic regression, for the classification of face embeddings.

articleTitle: A Survey on Predicting Depression Among Teachers and Students at Metropolitan University (Sylhet, Bangladesh) Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Depression, a psychiatric condition marked by profound sadness and apathy, influences cognitive processes, emotions, and behaviors, causing psychological and physiological challenges. Everyday tasks become arduous, life loses vibrancy, and in extreme cases, may lead to suicidal tendencies. University students face unique stressors due to academic, social, and personal pressures, underscoring the need for mental health support. This thesis investigates depression diagnosis among Metropolitan University teachers and students using machine learning techniques. Survey data, comprising 516 anonymized responses covering mental well-being, mood, and behavior, form the basis. The researchers preprocess data, visualize it, and train models to detect depression indicators, evaluating techniques like Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, and Gradient Boosting for effectiveness. The research highlights that the reasons for depression differ between females and males. The aim is to enhance early detection and support mechanisms, fostering proactive intervention within the university community.

articleTitle: Predictive Framework to Assess Global Warming for Urban Environment Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Global Warming is a rising concern which increases the vulnerability of urban life in the context of urban environment monitoring system. Review of existing studies shows predominant usage of deep learning especially Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) to perform prediction; however, they are all identified with shortcoming. The proposed study contributes towards a predictive framework by assessing the thermal factor of global warming identified from air and surface. The synthetic data is captured from mobile sensor and historical data thereby introducing multiple resolution of temporal and spatial attributes while a revised RNN model is implemented considering a synthetic data in order to increase the scope of applicability of the model. The study outcome shows that proposed scheme offers reduced processing time and higher accuracy when testified with multiple datasets and frequently adopted learning models.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enhanced Data Integrity and Authentication in WSN-IoT Systems for Dynamic Spectrum Access
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) that work hand in hand with IoT are crucial for contemporary smart city solutions. However, as these are dynamic and decentralized, they pose additional issues related to network data and authentication. Therefore, the deep analysis of blockchain technologies in WSN-IoT to improve the data integrity and authentication of the systems is proposed in this paper. Based on the consensus mechanisms and the tamper-proof nature of the blockchain ledger, the proposed method is effective in managing the cognitive radio spectrum access. This paper also seeks to discuss previous methods, their inefficiencies, and potential enhancement through the application of blockchain based on various performance metrics.

articleTitle: Intelligent Image Captioning with InceptionV3, LSTM, and PySpark Integration
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Image captioning is a challenging task in artificial intelligence that involves generating descriptive captions for images automatically. In this project, we propose a novel approach leveraging advanced technologies such as PySpark, LSTM, and InceptionV3 to develop an effective image captioning system. We harness the power of PySpark, a distributed computing framework, to efficiently process large-scale image datasets and extract high-level features from images using the InceptionV3 convolutional neural network (CNN) model. These features capture the semantic information present in the images and serve as input to the caption generation model. The caption generation model utilizes LSTM neural network as the decoder component. LSTM is well-suited for sequential data processing and is capable of generating coherent and contextually relevant captions based on the extracted image features. The InceptionV3 model acts as the encoder, extracting meaningful visual features from input images, while the LSTM decoder generates captions by decoding these features into natural language descriptions. This multimodal approach enables the model to understand and describe the content of images accurately. Through experimentation and evaluation on diverse image datasets, our proposed system demonstrates promising results in generating accurate and human-like captions for a wide range of images. By integrating PySpark, LSTM, and InceptionV3, our image captioning system achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the effectiveness of leveraging advanced technologies in solving complex AI tasks.

articleTitle: Bluetooth powered Real-Time monitoring using Wireless Stethoscope
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Heart Diseases remain one of the leading health concerns worldwide, with subtle symptoms that are often difficult to detect without advanced diagnostic tools. Traditional heart auscultation, while useful, relies heavily on the clinician's experience and skill. This paper presents the development of an innovative wireless electronic stethoscope designed to enhance the diagnostic process by providing objective, real-time data on heart sounds and physiological parameters. The device utilizes an Arduino microcontroller and an HC-05 Bluetooth module to capture, process, and wirelessly transmit heart sound data to paired devices, such as smartphones or computers, for remote monitoring and analysis. This system enables healthcare professionals to listen to and analyze heart sounds without physical proximity, reducing the reliance on subjective interpretation and enhancing diagnostic accuracy. By integrating Bluetooth technology, the wireless stethoscope facilitates telemedicine, making cardiac health monitoring more accessible, especially in remote or underserved areas. This paper also explores the hardware design, algorithm for heart rate calculation, and the overall performance of the system, highlighting its potential to improve cardiac diagnostics, offer real-time data, and ensure better decision-making in healthcare settings. Ultimately, this work seeks to bridge the gap between traditional diagnostic methods and modern technology, providing a more efficient and reliable tool for evaluating and managing heart health. The main advantage is that the BPM sensed by the wireless stethoscope is effectively displayed in the Human machine Interface such as mobile.

articleTitle: Impact of news on stock prices of mid-cap companies in India
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The objective of this study is to analyze how sentiment in news articles effect mid-cap stock prices in India. In this regard, it is important for investors to learn how such headlines correlate with stock movements. News headlines were used and subjected to sentiment study in order to measure the level of polarity and subjectivity. These features of sentiment were then merged with the opening, closing and adjusted prices. Multiple machine learning models such as logistic regression, decision trees, random trees and support vector machine SVM were used for predicting the target stock price movement. The stock market sentiment and factors related to the stock being analyzed were integrated in such a way as to assess its predictive capability about the stock price movement. The summary from the analysis suggests that stock price measures such as the opening and closing prices of the stock are usually catalytic in making predictions however the stock price moving average has also influenced in predicting future price movements in relation to price direction. This paper suggests that news sentiment should be included in stock price predictions of mid-cap companies, which will benefit the investors as addition in analyzing the market price.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey and Implementation of Health Kiosk Innovations: AI Integration, IoT Applications, and Predictive Healthcare Solutions
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Kiosks, initially designed for administrative purposes, have rapidly evolved into vital tools in healthcare, offering a range of services such as diagnostics, telemedicine, and health data management. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of health kiosks, emphasizing their application in healthcare environments, particularly with the integration of AI, IoT, and predictive analytics. Key technologies, including advanced biometric sensors and AI-driven health insights, have significantly enhanced their functionality. The economic impact of deploying health kiosks, their integration with existing healthcare systems, and the importance of adhering to international medical standards are thoroughly examined. A review of academic research, patents, and industry innovations sheds light on the latest advancements, while case studies of real-world implementations demonstrate their growing adoption across different sectors. The paper also provides a comparative analysis of kiosk models globally, addressing challenges in deployment. Future trends such as AI and wearable technology integration, blockchain for secure health data management, and personalized healthcare services are explored, highlighting the potential for health kiosks to further revolutionize healthcare delivery. Considering the Literature available a practically feasible Health Kiosk is implemented with a custom ML model deployed with an accuracy of 95.3% is achieved.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches for Insect Species Recognition using Pyramid Vision Transformer
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Insect species recognition systems have significantly advanced with recent machine learning techniques, but many existing models still face challenges such as limited scalability, lower accuracy in diverse environments, and poor generalization across species variations. To address these limitations, we propose an insect species recognition system utilizing the Pyramid Vision Transformer (PVT) algorithm, which excels in handling hierarchical and multi-scale features. By utilizing a hybrid dataset that was produced by merging the Insect Village Synthetic Dataset and the Agricultural Pest Dataset, the proposed approach exceeds traditional models by a wide margin, achieving a recognition accuracy of 99.16%. The PVT-based system also demonstrates robustness in recognizing complex and diverse insect species, making it an effective solution for entomological studies.

articleTitle: Custom Voice Assistants: Enhancing Accessibility for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The complete or partial loss of capability to perceive visual stimuli is known as visual impairment (VIP). Without treatment including healthcare, assistive technology, or corrective eyewear, visual impairment can make it hard for a person to do everyday activities like walking and studying. The aims to make reading and communication simpler, more interesting, and helpful for the blind group, taking into account the special challenges they encounter. Through this initiative, a user-friendly digital voice-based help system created particularly for the individuals with visual impairments is introduced. A personal voice assistant is software designed to perform tasks and provide various services in response to voice commands. It works through a process that first recognizes speech patterns and then generates synthetic speech as a reply. Users can automate numerous tasks with these assistants, such as managing to-do lists, playing media, and sending emails. As technology continues to advance, reliance on it is increasing. While using a computer keyboard for commands is still common, voice interaction can offer a more convenient alternative. This is especially helpful for everyone as well as those who are visually challenged and may have difficulty using a keyboard. Voice assistants that can comprehend oral instructions, carry them out, and respond by speaking or in another way are therefore required. Voice assistants enable navigation of technology without visual interfaces, making devices accessible. They support tasks like reading, navigation, messaging, and schedule management, fostering independence and inclusivity. By converting text to speech, they read messages, notifications, books, and even handwritten content aloud.

articleTitle: Care Compass: Monitoring made easy, Care made effective
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Traditional healthcare focused on hospitals and clinics proved out to be inadequate, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic and various emergency crisis, Care Compass, is an innovative and affordable smart wearable device aimed at addressing critical health challenges faced by today’s youth. The 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century witnessed a large-scale transformation with the integration of Internet of Things and smart devices ranging from healthcare to manufacturing sector. The device integrates smart IoT devices and other technologies such as cloud computing platforms, health management mobile application with machine learning algorithms, offering real-time personalized health recommendations and continuous monitoring of vital health parameters. Emphasis is placed on accessibility and affordability, making Care Compass a viable solution for a broader demographic. The integration of Care Compass with clinical workflows is facilitated through collaboration with healthcare providers, enhancing the utility and effectiveness of the device in real-world applications. The results from initial testing demonstrate the potential of Care Compass to significantly improve health outcomes and quality of life for young individuals.

articleTitle: Enhancing IoT-Enabled Electric Vehicle Battery Performance Monitoring and Prediction using AI Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Strong battery management systems (BMS) are required to guarantee the best possible performance, safety, and longevity of battery packs due to the quick development of electric vehicles (EVs). This study introduces an Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled battery performance monitoring and control system that uses artificial intelligence (AI) methods to improve EV batteries' dependability and efficiency. In order to gather data on vital battery parameters like voltage, current, temperature, and state of charge (SoC) in real time, the suggested system combines a number of sensors. Through the use of a Wi-Fi communication module, this data is sent to a cloud-based platform for analysis, where artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms more precisely, a machine learning model are used to accurately forecast possible faults and monitor battery health. The technology maximizes battery life and energy efficiency by optimizing charging and discharging cycles through the use of predictive analytics. In order to prevent critical failures and guarantee safe operation, the system is also built to deliver alerts when battery characteristics surpass safe thresholds. The usefulness of the suggested strategy and its potential for use in smart EV technologies in the future are validated by simulation results showing notable increases in battery performance.

articleTitle: Modeling and Performance Analysis of PEM Fuel Cells Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cells (PEMFCs) play a vital role in the transition to clean energy technologies, requiring accurate and efficient models for their control, optimization, and real-time monitoring. This research focuses on creating machine learning models as Support Vector Regression (SVR), Gradient Boosting (GBR), XGBoost, and Random Forest (RFR) and MLPRegressor to predict PEMFC key performance attributes. Using a dataset from Hamidi et al [1]., which focuses on Nafion 112 membranes and MEA activation tests. Input features include current density, voltage, power density, gas pressure, relative humidity, and impedance components (real and imaginary). The primary output is cell voltage, a key performance indicator. Among the models, Random Forest Regressor achieved the best results with an accuracy of 94.715, R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> score of 0.8049, MSE of 0.001036, and RMSE of 0.03219. Feature importance analysis revealed relative humidity, current density, and voltage as the most influential factors. This research illustrates the use of machine learning techniques in modeling the functioning of attributes of PEMFCs, providing insights for optimizing fuel cell performance and accelerating the inculcation of clean energy technologies.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cancer Classification in Genomic Data: A Hybrid Approach Using Principal Component Analysis and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Using the abundance of genetic data available, cancer categorization using genomic data is an important field of study aimed at improving the diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment of different forms of cancer. Genomic data offers a full picture of the molecular mechanisms behind cancer. This data includes gene expression levels, DNA methylation patterns, copy number variations, and mutations. However, reliable cancer classification is severely hampered by the enormous dimensionality and complexity of these datasets. It is suggested that in order to improve the performance and interpretability of the classification model in cancer data, this hybrid technique should make use of both SVM and other traditional PCA. In order to improve performance while maintaining biological relevance in genomic characteristics, the approach entails employing PCA to reduce the dimensions. After that, the reduced dataset's complicated patterns are found using the SVM model. The strategy is put to the test to see how well it handles high-dimensional genetic data and what potential it creates for improving cancer detection and customized treatment regimens.

articleTitle: Academic Atlas: A Platform for Rich Resource Sharing for Academics
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Academic Atlas is a tool developed to facilitate access to academic materials such as previous year’s question papers, capstone projects, and research papers. Of major concerns for the students would be that they cannot access the necessary materials and resources needed for academic development and to prepare for upcoming examinations. This application is designed and built upon the MERN stack: Mongo DB, Express JS, React JS, and Node JS, resulting in the total scalability and efficiency of the platform. Controlled contributions feature guaranteed data integrity and reliability since only valid holders of institutional email IDs are allowed to submit new materials. The security of this application and platform lies in the hashing of passwords stored in the database. Using pre-trained T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer) model. The arxiv dataset consists of large number of summarized articles, so it will use this dataset for both the model and testing purposes to verify how reasonable its obtained metric scores are as regards ROUGE. So, Academic Atlas seeks to revolutionize the academic experience with a well- organized, accessible, and even interactive learning environment.

articleTitle: Understanding Cybercrime: A Study of Malware Analysis, Phishing Attacks, and Sentiment Trends
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: With the rapid evolution of computer systems and technologies, individuals face an increasing threat of cybercrime. This research explores the changing landscape of cybercrime by focusing on three key areas: malware analysis, phishing attack analysis, and sentiment analysis. The study aims to identify malware strategies for evading detection and analyze the prevalence of spyware by examining diverse malware samples. Additionally, trend analysis highlights the rising complexity and frequency of phishing attacks, with a notable shift toward targeting reputable platforms. Sentiment analysis of media headlines surrounding data breaches uncovers a paradox: while concerns about cybersecurity remain, there is a growing confidence in the ability to manage cybersecurity crises. These findings provide insights into emerging threats and evolving public perceptions, offering a comprehensive understanding of the current cyber- crime landscape.

articleTitle: Counting the Number of Potholes in a Video Sequence
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Pothole detection holds significant importance for road maintenance and safety. However, accurately counting potholes within dynamic video sequences poses substantial challenges due to varying lighting conditions, camera perspectives, object occlusions and limited availability of training and testing of dataset. To address these challenges, a methodology based on Cosine similarity, leveraging visual pattern recognition to quantify the number of potholes. Our approach achieves a promising standard error count. This study contributes to enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of pothole detection and counting systems, crucial for ensuring road infrastructure integrity and reducing hazards like pothole deaths, traffic congestion, gross wastage of fuel.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Predictive Model to Capture Consumer Emotion from the Ecommerce Sector using Sentiment Analysis Technique
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Sentiment analysis has become a popular topic of research in the last several years, and a lot of work has already been done in this area, including sentiment analysis of product reviews on Amazon, Flipkart, and other platforms. Twitter is a multifaceted platform that spreads its wide-ranging dialogue across a variety of industries, such as consumer goods, politics, and education. One way to evaluate the enormous volume of views on Twitter is using sentiment analysis. Nonetheless, recent advancements in sentiment analysis techniques, particularly in relation to Recurrent Neural Networks, have shown a great deal of promise for raising the effectiveness and accuracy of sentiment analysis for Amazon product reviews. In recent years, sentiment analysis has grown in popularity as a tool for analysing product reviews on websites such as Amazon.com. The speed and accuracy of sentiment analysis for Amazon product evaluations have improved dramatically with the advancement of methodologies, particularly the use of Recurrent Neural Networks. In the proposed technique, a CNN-based LSTM model was employed to perform sentimental analysis on Amazon product reviews. The experimental findings showed that the suggested CNN-based LSTM model outperformed previous models, with an accuracy rate of 94%.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Driven Strategies to Mitigate Mobile Banking Adoption Challenges in Rural Areas
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Mobile banking has huge potentials to promote financial inclusions, especially in the rural areas. However, the adoptions in these areas are hampered by factors relating to security, misunderstanding, limitation in technology, and trust. This research, therefore, tries to study problems and advocates a solution for the same based on machine learning. Demographic features, current usage, and key impediments to mobile banking adoptions are studied with a large database of rural respondents. The paper uses classification decision trees, basic content analysis, random forest allocation, and multiple regression to identify the major concepts driving customer satisfaction and behavior. Security, competition, and user interface complexity issues have emerged as particularly strongly influencing factors in the results. The conclusion derived is that a focus on machine learning solutions effectively addresses implementation issues, further extending to a bettering of overall user experience.

articleTitle: Prediction Of Mental Health in Working People Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The professional and personal quality of life are both improved by early diagnosis and treatment of mental health issues. Depression is a major factor in disability all over the world. Professionals can treat internal health conditions earlier and improve their patients' quality of life by examining these issues. Depression is the leading cause of mental health problems worldwide. Professionals in the workforce must address early internal health issues to avoid more complex issues. A comprehensive overview of ML and its use in healthcare operations is provided in this paper. In addition, it provides a summary of the author's own research on the application of ML to internal health, highlighting the limitations that are currently in place and the areas that require additional observation. Algorithms based on ML are now extremely useful for diagnosing issues and analyzing medical data. Joining information from many sources and AI approaches assisted us with achieving the best exactness of 94.061 with the irregular woodland classifier.

articleTitle: Ensemble and Attention-Driven Deep Learning Model for Grapevine Leaf Variety Identification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The research paper introduces an advanced Mo- bileNetV3Large model incorporating attention mechanisms and ensemble learning, which will be applied in identifying grapevine leaf varieties with high accuracy. The approach enhances classification accuracy by applying attention mechanisms that target critical features within the image and by using ensemble learning to further stabilize predictions and prevent overfitting. The model was trained on and tested against a dataset that consisted of five varieties of grapevine leaves, and in that the model's classification accuracy is 98. Extensive metrics that accounted for precision, recall, and the F1 score all average in at 0.98. Comparisons with state of art models, such as MobileNetV2, PNN, and Deep CNN, show the adequacy of the proposed method over these methods with respect to accuracy. The results have revealed that the capabilities of attention mechanisms combined with ensemble learning capabilities introduce additional robustness to the model and results which make it a real world based applicability to grapevine leaf variety classification. The proposed method would provide a promising solution to precision agriculture, with an accurate identification of different grapevine leaf varieties that would eventually lead to further improvements in vineyard management and crop quality.

articleTitle: Tailoring Content with Keyword-Based Recommendation Engine Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: It is the information age thus; it is very important to understand how to personalize content in accordance with what appeals to a user. This work is conceptualized to be labeled "Tailoring Content with Keyword-Based Recommendation Engine Using Machine Learning". This work provides the applicative system catering for the experience of users by proposing personalization in terms of content. The core of the work is keyword-based recommendation engine chosen by the user to recommend posts as well as other contents believed to be of the user’s interest. A recommendation system uses various types of algorithms related to machine learning and a combination of data analysis technologies while considering the interaction of the user with posts, created, liked, or participated in. From this, it will then understand keen interests by a user and make recommendations based on those grounds. This will keep users interesting about the relevant content and help develop skills in areas they are interested in. Some scope includes designing a recommendation engine, developing it into an application, and measuring performance. This would be in the ability of doing so, with accuracies at all high degrees, when recommending this content, scalability, and also privacy for the users. It will be used to prove how machine learning techniques can be applied towards developing personalized user experience and, as a by-product, contribute to this field known as content recommendation systems.

articleTitle: Real-Time Multilingual Communication System Using CNNs for Bidirectional Sign and Speech Translation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: A person who is proficient in Indian Sign Language cannot currently converse with someone who is proficient in sign languages from other countries. Additionally, there isn't an interface that translates between Indian Sign Language and other regional languages in India. The World Federation of the Deaf estimates that there are as many as seventy million people in the world using sign languages. It is the only way that the deaf people can express their feelings and emotions. Availing this language for the hearing and speech impaired is indeed of great significance to those who are learning as it shows the intent behind the expression and gives guidance on the person’s signing right away. The proposed solution aims to develop an interface that would close the communication gap that exists within the sign language community. Their ability and self-assurance in communicating with others through sign language can be enhanced by this. The system combines numerous machine learning models operating in the background with multiple translations, sign-to-sign, speech-to-sign, and sign-to-speech. These are employed to distinguish and identify the signs and convert them into the necessary spoken or sign language. These models are combined with a website that runs well to carry out the necessary translations. The system processes additional translation fast and effectively after receiving real-time video input. The goal of this research is to create a useful tool for converting between sign languages. Additionally, we may convert a specified sign language into a text or speech. translated from ASL to ISL with an 82% accuracy rate on average. To identify the indicators, our system receives video data in real-time. With our technology, a dumb or deaf person can converse with a blind person. Since our technology recognizes signs in real time, it may also be utilized by someone who wishes to learn sign language.

articleTitle: Quantales: Bridging Realms with Quantum Generative Adversarial Networks and Transformers in Educational Content Creation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Traditional teaching methods in Indian schools often lack engaging elements, hindering students’ full comprehension of concepts and fostering a tendency to memorize rather than understand. Existing solutions fail to provide effective visualization-based interactive learning. To address these issues, we propose an interactive application-based solution utilizing generative AI image generation models that can be used by students and teachers. Our application employs interactive story generation, allowing students to prompt creative texts and gain a deeper understanding of concepts. Trained on the school curriculum, this tool facilitates self-study, empowering students to understand complex topics independently. The application extends to classroom use, enabling teachers to incorporate interactive and application-based learning alongside traditional methods. Leveraging Quantum Generative Adversarial Networks (QGANs) and transformer-based models, the system analyses user input, extracts key elements, and creates dynamic story graphs for engaging narrative experiences. The integration of quantum computing enhances the application's capabilities, providing a novel approach to education through dynamic storytelling.In conclusion, the proposed solution seeks to bridge the gap in traditional teaching methods by introducing an innovative and interactive approach to education using Quantum Generative Adversarial Networks. This holistic solution addresses the limitations of current educational practices, offering a transformative learning experience for students and teachers alike.

articleTitle: Generative AI-Based Financial Fraud Detection System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Financial fraud presents a serious threat to the stability and integrity of global financial systems. Traditional methods of detecting fraud often struggle to keep pace with fraudsters’ evolving tactics. In this study, a new method is presented to combating financial fraud by integrating various machine learning algorithms with generative artificial intelligence techniques. This work uses advanced deep learning techniques, such as convolutional and recurrent neural networks, to enhance financial system security. It focuses on improving fraud detection accuracy and reducing false positives and negatives by analyzing extensive datasets to detect subtle fraud indicators in real time. This initiative seeks to set a new standard in financial security, aiming to significantly reduce financial losses due to fraud. RNN has high accuracy (99.39%) but low precision, recall, and F1 score (40% each). CNN has slightly lower accuracy (99.29%) and relatively lower precision (33.33%) and F1 score (36.36%). FCNN shows high accuracy (99.49%) and precision (98.96%), with perfect recall (100%) and a very high F1 score (99.47%). It was observed that the GRU performs excellently across all metrics, with perfect scores (100%) in accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, indicating its strong ability to detect fraud while minimizing false positives and false negatives. This performance suggests that GRUs are highly effective for this type of task.

articleTitle: Dynamic Demand Forecast Dashboard – A Machine Learning based Quick Commerce Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Quick Commerce (Q-commerce) is a rapidly growing sector that delivers daily essentials within 15 – 30 minutes. Companies in this sector currently operate using a dark-store model (inventory model). However, this approach presents challenges such as high operating costs, low margins, low average orders, and inefficiencies in last-mile delivery. The aim is to propose a new operating model that reduces operating and last-mile delivery costs through machine learning. A Dynamic Demand Forecast Dashboard (DDFD) is proposed which forecasts sales for specific categories in particular locations and times. This is achieved through autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) modeling and Random Forest classifier, with an accuracy of 70%. The dynamic pricing approach further allows for real-time revenue maximization, adapting to fluctuations in market conditions.

articleTitle: Strategic Innovations in Network Security: A Machine Learning Approach to Detect and Mitigate Backdoor Attacks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: A backdoor attack is a malicious act in which a hacker takes advantage of holes in the system to enter without authorization. This requires changing the network and authentication processes in order to insert malicious code and provide an entry point for unwanted activities. Early detection of backdoor attacks is essential to preventing significant damage. Proactive defence searches for irregularities in network traffic before dubious behaviours become widespread. Prompt innovation boosts the robustness of a cybersecurity system, protecting information and infrastructure against illegal access and possible breaches. This paper emphasizes proactive security measures and offers a methodical approach to identifying backdoor attacks. Strong early detection might be achieved at the network-database interface with ensemble machine learning. This helps to ensure that SQL queries are corrected correctly and prevents unwanted access. Our work improves cybersecurity resilience by deepening our knowledge of how to successfully defend against backdoor attacks. Producing datasets for machine learning algorithms of superior quality is essential to the backdoor incursion detection procedure. The variety of conditions it offers makes accurate testing of detecting systems possible. The use of ensemble machine learning on datasets like UNSW-NB15 improves the accuracy of backdoor attack detection, hence supporting the development of an all-encompassing and efficient cybersecurity plan.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Machine Learning Approaches for Cirrhosis Survival Prediction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Cirrhosis is a fatal condition characterized by irreversible scarring and loss of liver function. Prediction of cirrhosis treatment outcomes at an early and precise manner is difficult be- cause of issues like data imbalance, feature dimensionality, noises and outliers prevalent in clinical dataset. This study examines the use of supervised machine learning approaches to support this prediction in cirrhosis patients. We analyze the performance of seven predictive models, such as Decision Trees, Random Forests, Gradient Boosting Machines (GBMs), K-Nearest Neighbors, Extra Trees, and Logistic Regression based on their accuracy, F-1 score, Recall, Precision, and Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC). Outlier detection using isolation forests is used to refine data quality, while SMOTE resampling addresses class imbalance and a Genetic Algorithm optimizes feature selection for improved model performance. LightGBM and XGBoost proved to be the most successful methods with an AUC of 0.94. The combination of XG- Boost with Genetic Algorithms demonstrates superior predictive power, marking a novel methodology for automating liver disease diagnosis. The results show that the combination of the XGBoost algorithm and Genetic Algorithms is best suited for automating liver disease diagnosis. This methodology promotes early diagnosis and intervention based on improvements in the efficiency and precision of predictions.

articleTitle: Hybrid AI-Electronic Systems for Real-Time Edge Processing in IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Real-time data processing is facing many issues as a result of the Internet of Things' rapid expansion, especially at the network's edge where latency, bandwidth, and compute resources are limited. The creation of hybrid AI-electronic systems for real-time edge processing is investigated as a solution to these problems. To improve the effectiveness and precision of data processing in Internet of Things contexts, the research combines machine learning algorithms with sophisticated electronic circuits. The techniques include creating a brand-new hybrid framework that blends edge computing and AI models and focuses for low latency and low power consumption. When compared to conventional edge processing systems, extensive simulations and real-world research show a 25% reduction in processing latency and a 15% gain in data categorization accuracy. According to the findings, the suggested hybrid AI-electronic system can successfully handle the requirements of contemporary IoT networks and offer a scalable real-time edge processing solution. This strategy has potential for use in smart city applications, industrial automation, and other fields in the future.

articleTitle: Evaluation of UAV Path Planning Approaches for Urban Air Mobility
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In contemporary society, it is pertinent to address the feature of the Urban Air Mobility (UAM), a new mode of urban transport, whereby unmanned aerial vehicles transport people and goods with the view to rendering relief to ground traffic congestion. However, challenging as it may be, the deployment of the UAVs within the confines of the urban built environment is complex. In this systematic review, we provide state-of-the-art developments found in multi-UAV path planning for UAM. We highlight the different aspects of navigation strategies, cooperative algorithms, optimization methods, as well as collision avoidance techniques over the years. In total, we conducted analyses on thirty recent studies, such as those that deal with the combination of machine learning, bio-inspired algorithms, and other environmental-induced factors involved in the path planning process. The review results exhibit significant advances in navigation-aware planning, cooperative systems, advanced optimization techniques, and real-alive applications. However, while all these have been achieved, adaptations in real-time, dynamic environment management, and the integration of learning-based methods with conventional control methods are challenges that have continued to be faced. Future research will propose directions to fill in these gaps to further the progress towards developing efficacious, safe, and sustainable urban air transportation systems.

articleTitle: WellSphere: AI-Driven Lifestyle Health Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Well Sphere Fight against lifestyle undiagnosed diseases, diabetes, heart disease, Parkinson's disease, etc., by integrating Streamlit technology and advanced Machine Learning algorithms to provide patient populations residing at locations with least access to healthcare and health information with personalized health insights for their better care. The system will identify the potential victims of such disorders, based on thousands of health data elements, involving demographics and medical histories. Well Sphere will focus its monitoring on blood pressure, blood glucose, cholesterol, BMI, and family history for early detection of diabetes, heart diseases, and Parkinson's disease. The diagnosis should be made early to ensure that prompt lifestyle changes and medical interventions are performed before it leads to major problems. It will make an interface easy to use, so a user can take better control of his health journey and prevent such problems from arising and makes it easier to manage them appropriately. So, there is the possibility that well Sphere can radically change access to healthcare throughout the world with the help of the most advanced technologies in diagnostics and prediction, having positive health outcomes and reducing the spread of diseases caused by an unhealthy lifestyle

articleTitle: Real-Time Object Detection for an Intelligent Retail Checkout System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Customers are made to wait for extended hours in busy shopping settings as traditional limits of barcode and RFID-based billing systems have a predisposition towards errors and inefficiencies in scanning untagged or weighted items. The methods that are in use today can't keep up with the demand and lead to queues at check-out counters causing customer discontentment. This paper presents an idea of a novel Smart Billing Counter, based on Object Detection using advanced deep learning, YOLOv8, and OCR technologies for smooth billing processes. It captures the image of items placed at the counter, identifies what it is with minimal error, extracts necessary information from labels concerning weighted items, and generates a bill automatically. The unique capability of this solution is to recognize identical items in one frame with total cost by quantity to optimize checkout times and minimize the possibility of errors or fraud. At an inference speed of 37.2ms per image with 93.6% accuracy, this significantly enhances operational efficiency and ensures that grocery retailers provide their customers with smooth, error-free, and swift checkout processes. This innovation is likely, therefore, to bring about a transformation in retail billing systems. It will enhance customer satisfaction and operations efficiency quite highly.

articleTitle: Predictive Modelling of Investor Sentiment and Preferences in Green Bonds Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This research study leverages machine learning algorithms to forecast investors' attitudes and preferences concerning green bonds. Using a sample of 187 investors from Bengaluru, the study explores relevant demographic and experience variables affecting investment decision-making. It employs decision tree analysis, K-means clustering, and SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) values to identify outcomes that matter most regarding sentiment and preference. In addition, to indicate the relative importance of these traits to investment decisions and the long-term sustainability of green bonds, the study utilizes multiple regression analysis and survival analysis. These results provide valuable insight for investors, issuers, and policymakers on how to efficiently and effectively structure their green bond offerings and strategies to improve appeal to the market and ultimately invest in a more sustainable environmental outcome.

articleTitle: Advanced VLSI-Based Design of Multiple Path OTAs with Dual Flipped Voltage Follower for Signal Processing & Communication Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This research paper presents the Advanced VLSI-Based Design of Multiple Path OTAs with Dual Flipped Voltage Follower for Signal Processing & Communication Applications, targeted for VLSI-based signal processing cases. Leveraging 50nm CMOS technology and Cadence tools, the proposed OTA architecture offers enhanced performance and versatility in signal processing tasks. The design incorporates multiple paths for signal processing, enabling improved bandwidth, gain, and linearity while minimizing common-mode noise. The inclusion of Dual Flipped Voltage Follower enhances the OTA's stability and dynamic range, ensuring reliable operation in high-speed VLSI systems. Through extensive simulation studies, the paper demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed OTA design in meeting the stringent requirements of modern signal processing applications. This research contributes to the advancement of VLSI design methodologies, offering a promising solution for high-performance signal processing tasks in nanoscale CMOS technologies. The simulation results from the cadence tool shows the effectiveness of the methodology that is being presented in this research article.

articleTitle: Intelligent Iris based chronic kidney identification system
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Chronic renal disease is the term used to describe the progressive loss of kidney function. In the early phases of chronic renal illness, there might not be many symptoms. Chronic renal disease may not be apparent until your kidney function is seriously impaired. The iris is a colorful muscle located inside the eye. Because it contains a range of distinct textural information that is difficult to change or disturb, it is the best feature to predict health difficulties. Iridological science attributes iris apparitions to the body's tissue weaknesses. It exhibits toxicity to organs or tissues, inflammation, or weakening. Thus, iridology could serve as a stand-in for early chronic kidney disease diagnosis.This method can reveal the state of the organ in the body before symptoms of illness appear. Image processing techniques in diagnosing diseases are accurate and could be used in the biomedical field. Diagnosis using Iris image analysis is one of the best non-invasive diagnostic methods for clinical diagnosis that helps determine the health of organs. This paper aims to process the iris images using various image processing steps, such as pre-processing and feature extraction, to evaluate the diagnostic validity of an ancient complementary and alternative medicine technique and explore the possibility of diagnosing chronic kidney disease from the representations of the iris.

articleTitle: Transforming Agriculture with Cloud Computing: Data Processing and Analysis Innovations
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Cloud computing is a game-changer in modern agriculture, providing new forms to access enormous data analysis. In this paper, we investigate how cloud computing solutions are being integrated with agricultural practices to improve the efficiency, scalability and availability in managing data pertaining to agriculture. Farming operations generate massive amounts of data from a multitude of sources like sensors, drones, and satellite imagery., the performance bottleneck becomes the traditional methods with which the data are being processed. So the common factor in all these problems lies with Cloud computing itself, it has a scalable infrastructure that provides reliable analysis and Real-time processing of large data sets throwing light on an array of questions people have about various aspects. In this paper, we explore the major innovations in cloud computing that power precise agriculture and examine how machine learning algorithms, data fusion methods, and distributed processing platforms are utilized. It also discusses cloud-based solutions, which can reduce costs of the use of resources, crop yield prediction, and risk management to weather/climate and pests. Cloud computing opens up a world of monitoring, analysis, and optimization to help provide higher yields more efficiently while maintaining a commitment to sustainable agriculture. Challenges and considerations in deploying cloud computing in agriculture, e.g., data security risks, privacy concerns, and the need for stable internet connection for rural environments are also articulated in the paper. The results of this project underscore the vital importance of cloud technology in redefining the agri-future and providing a robust platform for smarter and more sustainable agriculture.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Transfer Learning with MobileNetV2 for Crop Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Early diagnosis of such maladies can avoid crop diseases and increase agricultural yield. We attempt to propose deep learning-based approach for the classification of diseases in an apple crop using the New Plant illnesses Dataset sourced from Kaggle. A pre-trained feature extractor called Mobile NetV2,with global average pooling and denser layers and dropout is included for achieving better regularization in the proposed model along with transfer learning. The increase in augmented image data increases generalization and robustness at training. Our approach is distinctive in terms of achieving excellent accuracy based on 97% training accuracy with a validation accuracy of 97% over20 epochs. In its pursuit to precision agriculture, this research allows quick interventions for crop health management through early disease detection-an efficient and lightweight choice.

articleTitle: Transforming Agricultural Supply Chains: The Power of Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Implementing blockchain technology in agricultural supply chains has the potential to revolutionize and increase transparency, efficiency and trust between all parties. A variation of the white paper discussed how blockchain can be a transformative tech in addressing major challenges especially on traceability, fraud prevention and sustainability on agriculture. Blockchain (for those hearing about this for the first time) can provide a system where every step of even complex supply chains is perfectly recorded, enabling transactions to take place in a secure way and offering transparency, immutability, accountability. Case studies and real-world examples showcased throughout the paper depict how blockchain could enhance operational efficiencies, boost food safety, authenticate products, and cut waste across agriculture. While very promising, the implementation of blockchain technology in agriculture is not without its own issues; this includes obligatory industry standards as well as highly costly technical implementations. The paper also highlights the potential for blockchain to contribute to sustainable agriculture by allowing better tracking of environmental footprints and ethical sourcing. In summary, we propose that the flexibility of blockchain technology renders it an ideal approach to revolutionizing supply chains in the agriculture sector, as we continue down a trajectory towards increased levels of visibility and productivity with improved environmental outcomes. This paper contributes towards a more comprehensive understanding of the role of blockchain in scenario-based selection as it addresses both opportunities and challenges due to adoption of block chain which gives technology and agriculture a new future(directions).

articleTitle: Stock Price Forecasting via Recurrent Neural Networks and Key Technical Indicators
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This research endeavor is centered on enhancing the predictability of stock prices through the application of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) in conjunction with technical indicators such as Exponential Moving Averages (EMA_5 and EMA_10). The adjusted closing prices were judiciously employed throughout the modeling framework to address the challenges of autocorrelation, a prevalent phenomenon in time series data. The model underwent training utilizing a comprehensive dataset encompassing one year of historical stock information, featuring preprocessing methodologies to calculate the requisite indicators and facilitate data preparation for the RNN. The model's architecture incorporates optimized layers subjected to training over 50 iterations. Critical evaluation metrics, including Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), and Coefficient of Determination (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), were leveraged to gauge effectiveness, culminating in an impressive prediction accuracy of 0.9981 R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. This methodological approach demonstrated substantial efficiency in forecasting the subsequent day’s stock closing price, thereby furnishing significant insights for traders engaged in short-term decision-making. Furthermore, the study encompasses visual representations such as actual versus predicted price graphs and error analysis plots to underscore the model's precision and dependability.

articleTitle: Machine learning assisted prediction of creep life in Ni-based alloys: An ensemble-based stacking regressor approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Creep deformation beyond the design tolerance is a major cause of material fracture in the hot end components of aviation engines, which limits their service life. So, creep-oriented alloy design has always been crucial to prevent the material fracture caused by creep failure. But creep testing is time-consuming and costly, limiting the use of trial-and-error approaches for alloy design. To address this issue, this study establishes a Machine Learning (ML) based model known as Hybrid Ensemble Regressor (HER) which employs a stacking ensemble architecture combining Decision Tree (DT), Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) and Gaussian Process Regressor (GPR) as base models. The predictions of these three base models are then fed into a linear regression meta-model. This approach enhances the creep rupture life prediction accuracy in high-performance alloys by leveraging the strength of each individual model, thus reducing overfitting and improving generalization. This yielded coefficient of determination ( ), Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) and Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error (SMAPE) values of 0.980, 0.319 and 0.473 respectively which were best when compared among other machine learning models such as GPR, Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM), LightGBM, Support Vector Regressor (SVR), Ridge, Lasso, Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), DT, Random Forest (RF) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN), thus demonstrating the significance of HER model. The HER model’s R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> value is 0.980, close to 1 represents the accuracy of the model outperforming previous researches highlighting its relevance.

articleTitle: 4T2M RAM and PMA MTJ MRAM as a memory element
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The traditional memory hierarchies of Flash memory, DRAM, and SRAM are changing as the memory industry diversifies. These systems are now being created to close the performance and cost gaps, which leads to more specialised memory solutions. Stable system architectures that maintain their state even after the power is turned off will be made possible by the non-volatile memory, which will also improve the current memory subsystems. The memory industry is seeking cost-effective solutions that offer higher latency at a lower price, such as PCRAM and ReRAM, while also striving for DRAM-like performance with low latency but higher costs, exemplified by STT-MRAM. This work focuses on developing a 1-bit memory cell utilizing the innovative Memristor based 4T2M and Magneto-resistive based PMAMTJ MRAM. One of the objectives is to implement a memristor using Verilog-A and creating the 4T2M RAM along with performing its read/write operations. The other objective is to incorporate the effects of thermal fluctuations in magnetization on stochastic switching of PMAMTJ MRAM. The effect of resistance fluctuation brought about by manufacturing errors, such as oxide layer and free layer thickness, was also taken into consideration. Variations in tunnel magneto-resistance (TMR) within a ±1% range were considered to assess their effect on MTJ performance. The outcomes of the design process and read/write operations were recorded. This work is implemented in 28nm technology node which contributes to the evolution of memory technologies, offering insights into energy-efficient and high-performance solutions for future applications [11] [12].

articleTitle: AI-Powered DeepFake Defense
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Deepfake technology, known for its ability to produce convincingly face-swapped videos, presents significant risks to privacy, security, and public trust. Misuse of this technology for spreading misinformation, defamation, and influencing politics is on the rise, creating a pressing need for more effective detection mechanisms. As deepfake generation methods continue to advance, conventional detection techniques are increasingly unable to keep up, often falling short in accuracy and adaptability. This project aims to create an AI-driven detection system specialized in identifying face-swap deepfakes. The system focuses on subtle irregularities in facial details, movements, and the synchronization between audio and visuals. Employing neural network models such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and Capsule Networks, it pinpoints anomalies like unnatural expressions, atypical skin textures, and lighting inconsistencies. The system achieves high reliability with metrics including accuracy (96%), precision (95%), recall (94%), and F1 score (95%), showing marked improvement compared to traditional techniques. It outperforms existing methods such as XceptionNet (92%) on the Celeb-DF dataset, underscoring its superior generalizability and robustness. This scalable solution has broad applications in media, law enforcement, and cybersecurity, reinforcing efforts to combat deepfake threats and fostering improved trust and security across various sectors.

articleTitle: Density-Based Traffic Signal Control System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The Density-Based Traffic Signal Control System (DB-TSCS) is an innovative approach to manage traffic flow at intersections. Incorporating advanced sensor technologies and intelligent algorithms, the system adjusts the signal timings dependent on the traffic density at a particular point in time. This provides improvements in the flow of traffic while reducing the level of traffic congestion and improving the use of the transportation system in general. The central control unit uses density-based algorithms to analyze traffic conditions, generating optimized signal timings that prioritize congested directions while minimizing delays in low-density areas. The system also incorporates adaptive learning and can be integrated with smart city infrastructure for communication and real-time traffic updates.

articleTitle: A Novel Framework Combining CNN, LSTM, and Meta-Learning for Real-Time Monitoring of Anesthetic-Induced Brain States
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In order to improve our understanding of brain function, monitoring the depth of unconsciousness during anesthesia is essential for both clinical practice and neuroscience research. The electroencephalogram (EEG) is a frequently used objective instrument for monitoring the changed states of the brain caused by anesthesia in real time. The effects of various general anesthetics on brain electrical activity are not the same. However, because of the low Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) of EEG data, traditional machine learning models have difficulty with it, particularly in office-based anesthetic settings. Applications of Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) for pattern recognition and classification have seen a rise in the use of deep learning models, which are renowned for their great generalization and resilience in the face of noise. Deep learning has shown effective in a number of BCI applications, although its use in categorizing brain states while anesthesia is still relatively new. This research presents a unique framework to characterize brain states under anesthesia that combines deep neural networks and meta-learning. The framework uses a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to capture temporal relationships, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to extract power spectrum features, and a meta-learning technique to address large cross-subject variability.

articleTitle: IoT Based Energy Meter
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Energy conservation is becoming increasingly important due to the growing demand for electricity in modern households and businesses. This project presents an IoT-based energy meter system designed to automate the process of monitoring and managing energy consumption. The system is built using an Arduino microcontroller and a Wi-Fi module to transmit real-time energy usage data to a web interface. By this user interface, users are can track their energy consumption in watts, analyze usage patterns, and make inform the decisions to reduce power wastage. The system eliminates the need for manual readings and provides consumers with a convenient way to access the data at any location. Additionally, advanced analytics help users to identify the potential area to energy savings by detecting anomalies and offering suggestions. This IoT-based solution not only improves energy management but also supports sustainable practices, making it a valuable tool for both residential and commercial applications.

articleTitle: Epilepsy Seizure Detection based on EEG Signals using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Seizure detection is a critical aspect of epilepsy management, and accurate identification can significantly improve patient outcomes. This study explores the application of machine learning techniques, specifically the Random Forest classifier, for the detection of seizures using electroencephalogram (EEG) data. By employing a systematic approach that includes feature extraction and channel reduction, we enhanced the model’s performance. Relevant features were extracted from EEG signals, including time-domain statistics and frequency-domain characteristics, which are vital for effective classification. The model was evaluated using standard classification metrics such as precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy, yielding high performance, particularly in identifying non-seizure events. These findings highlight the potential of ensemble learning methods for real-time seizure monitoring and underscore the importance of this research in developing reliable diagnostic tools. Overall, our results demonstrate that machine learning approaches can significantly contribute to improved patient outcomes in epilepsy management, paving the way for future advancements in clinical applicability.

articleTitle: Queen's Web Sanctuary
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: One of the key aspects that affects women globally is their insecurity in their environment. Especially the most enduring such as sexual harassment, threats through digital morphing, acid attacks, rapes, and the list is boundless. Though there are punishments and imprisonment, their crime rate is still a non-decreasing one. On the other side, the victims are becoming hesitant to share their difficulties. They are hesitant to give a complaint against the troublemaker. It has its consequences on the environment and the individual both physically and mentally. In order to address this issue, this paper aimed to create a platform for sharing their inner emotions and handling them technically. Here the government of police and the NGOs are linked in the website. For instance, when someone (who is affected by the digital morphing of fake images raises a request on our website, the appropriate measures such as removing the images from the social media, providing psychological support, and if needed medical and financial too. The complaint against the troublemaker will be made and handled confidentially. The financial supports are provided by the NGOs. Hence the website emerges as a sustained way to tackle the problems that are not exposed.

articleTitle: Securing ML Models on Websites: Face Recognition and Spoof Detection via IPFS Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper presents a secure framework for deploying ML models client-side, addressing challenges like unauthorized access, reverse engineering, and spoofing. The proposed solution combines encryption, obfuscation, and integrity verification, using JIT encryption to protect models by decrypting only as needed, minimizing exposure. Cryptographic signatures and MediaPipe ensure secure transmission and model integrity, while Hoffmann compression reduces the model size to 5-7 MB, optimizing load times without sacrificing functionality. Blockchain-based IPFS secures data storage, utilizing content-addressable storage to prevent reverse engineering and ensure data integrity. Efficient caching strategies, like HTTP caching and browser requests, enhance accessibility and reduce latency. Liveness detection verifies the user’s face by capturing 100-200 frames in 2 seconds for spoofing protection. Dynamic key encryption adapts with each transaction, countering replay attacks and reinforcing model security. The framework leverages Kubernetes for scalable, reliable deployment in large-scale applications. Edge AI enables sensitive biometric data processing on-device, maintaining high accuracy and low latency, which is ideal for real-time web and mobile uses. This comprehensive, scalable approach combines encryption, blockchain, and AI to secure client-side ML models, addressing evolving security needs in modern applications.

articleTitle: Blockchain in Electronic Voting: A Systematic Review of Security, Scalability, and Emerging Technologies
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Blockchain technology has emerged as a promising solution for enhancing the security, transparency, and efficiency of electronic voting systems. This review paper presents a comprehensive analysis of recent research papers, examining various cryptographic techniques, consensus mechanisms, and blockchain frameworks designed to address critical issues such as voter anonymity, coercion resistance, and election integrity.
